title: Let's Learn English · Level 1
zh: 跟着安娜在华盛顿生活：52 个美国日常情景对话，适合零基础到初级。
credit: 听力内容来自 VOA Learning English《Let's Learn English – Level 1》，公共领域，learningenglish.voanews.com

lessons.title: Welcome!
lessons.zh: 欢迎！安娜来到华盛顿的新公寓

lines.en: Hi! Are you Anna?
lines.zh: 嗨！你是安娜吗？

lines.en: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?
lines.zh: 对！你好！你是皮特吗？

lines.en: I am Pete.
lines.zh: 我是皮特。

lines.en: Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。

lines.en: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 我们再来一遍。我是安娜，很高兴认识你。

lines.en: I'm Pete. "Anna" Is that A-N-A?
lines.zh: 我是皮特。“Anna”，是 A-N-A 吗？

lines.en: No. A-N-N-A
lines.zh: 不是，是 A-N-N-A。

lines.en: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
lines.zh: 好吧，两个 n 的安娜……欢迎来到……欧文街 1400 号！

lines.en: My new apartment! Yes!
lines.zh: 我的新公寓！太好了！

qs.q: What is the woman's name?
qs.why: 她说 I'm Anna，拼写是 A-N-N-A。

qs.q: How do you spell her name?
qs.why: Anna with two "n's"——两个 n。

qs.q: What is at 1400 Irving Street?
qs.why: 欧文街 1400 号是安娜的新公寓。

lessons.title: Hello, I'm Anna!
lessons.zh: 你好，我是安娜！认识新邻居

lines.en: Hey, Pete! Who's your friend?
lines.zh: 嘿，皮特！你朋友是谁？

lines.en: She is Anna. She is new to D.C.
lines.zh: 她叫安娜，刚来华盛顿。

lines.en: Where are you from?
lines.zh: 你是哪里人？

lines.en: I am from a small town.
lines.zh: 我来自一个小镇。

lines.en: Well, welcome to D.C.
lines.zh: 那么，欢迎来到华盛顿。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: I am Jonathan. I am in apartment B4.
lines.zh: 我是乔纳森，住在 B4 公寓。

lines.en: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
lines.zh: 我住 C2 公寓，玛莎是我的室友。

lines.en: I know Marsha. She is nice.
lines.zh: 我认识玛莎，她人很好。

lines.en: And I am in Apartment D7. I have to go now.
lines.zh: 我住 D7 公寓。我得走了。

lines.en: Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you're here.
lines.zh: 记得给玛莎单位打个电话，告诉她你到了。

lines.en: Right, thanks, Pete. Nice to meet you!
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢你，皮特。很高兴认识你！

lines.en: You too, Bye.
lines.zh: 我也是，再见。

lines.en: Apartment C2, here I come!
lines.zh: C2 公寓，我来啦！

qs.q: Where is Anna from?
qs.why: "I am from a small town."

qs.q: Who is Anna's roommate?
qs.why: "Marsha is my roommate."

qs.q: What apartment is Jonathan in?
qs.why: "I am in apartment B4."

lessons.title: I'm Here!
lessons.zh: 我到啦！打错电话和找超市

lines.en: I am in my new apartment! Great!
lines.zh: 我在我的新公寓里！太好了！

lines.en: I live with Marsha. We're roommates.
lines.zh: 我和玛莎住在一起，我们是室友。

lines.en: I want to cook dinner. Oh! Hmmm. Is there a supermarket near here?
lines.zh: 我想做晚饭。哦！嗯……这附近有超市吗？

lines.en: Marsha knows. Marsha's work number is 555-8986.
lines.zh: 玛莎知道。玛莎的单位电话是 555-8986。

lines.en: Hello.
lines.zh: 喂。

lines.en: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
lines.zh: 喂，是玛莎吗？我是安娜。

lines.en: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.
lines.zh: 对不起，你打错了。

lines.en: Oh. Is this 555-8986?
No. This is 555-8689.
Oh. Excuse me!
lines.zh: 哦，不好意思！

lines.en: Okay. 'Bye.
lines.zh: 没事，再见。

lines.en: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.
lines.zh: 再打一次，555-8986。拜托是玛莎。

lines.en: Hello. This is Marsha.
lines.zh: 喂，我是玛莎。

lines.en: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.
lines.zh: 对，玛莎，我想做晚饭。

lines.en: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?
lines.zh: 什么？安娜？是你吗？

lines.en: Oh, yes. I am here!
lines.zh: 哦，是我，我到啦！

lines.en: Good. You are there.
lines.zh: 好，你到家了。

lines.en: I want to find a supermarket.
lines.zh: 我想找一家超市。

lines.en: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
lines.zh: 哦，好的。超市在欧文街 1500 号，离公寓很近。

lines.en: Great! Goodbye!
lines.zh: 太好了！再见！

lines.en: Goodbye, Anna.
lines.zh: 再见，安娜。

lines.en: (Later)
lines.zh: （后来）

lines.en: There is a big supermarket on our street. And Marsha says I am a good cook! Until next time! Bye!
lines.zh: 我们这条街上有一家大超市。玛莎还说我很会做饭！下次见！拜拜！

qs.q: Why does Anna call Marsha?
opts: She wants to find a supermarket.
She wants to go to work.
qs.a: She wants to find a supermarket.
qs.why: 安娜想做晚饭，要找超市。

qs.q: What is wrong with Anna's first call?
qs.why: "You have the wrong number."

qs.q: Where is the supermarket?
qs.why: "The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street."

lessons.title: What Is It?
lessons.zh: 这是什么？安娜的包里什么都有

lines.en: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!
lines.zh: 皮特，嗨！嗨，我们在这儿！

lines.en: Hi, Anna! Hi, Marsha!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！嗨，玛莎！

lines.en: Hi!
lines.zh: 嗨！

lines.en: How are you two?
lines.zh: 你们俩好吗？

lines.en: I am great!
lines.zh: 我很好！

lines.en: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，皮特，我刚来华盛顿，这城市好大。

lines.en: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How's the new apartment?
lines.zh: 是啊，不过你每天都会多了解一点。新公寓怎么样？

lines.en: The new apartment is great! Let's get coffee!
lines.zh: 新公寓棒极了！我们去喝咖啡吧！

lines.en: Anna, do you have a pen?
lines.zh: 安娜，你有笔吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.
lines.zh: 有，我包里有支笔。

lines.en: I have a …
lines.zh: 我有一个……

lines.en: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
lines.zh: 这不是笔，是一本书，一本很大的书。

lines.en: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though…
lines.zh: 对，对，没错，皮特。可我知道我有笔……

lines.en: I have a ....
lines.zh: 我有一个……

lines.en: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?
lines.zh: 这不是笔，安娜……是个玩具？

lines.en: I have a ....
lines.zh: 我有一个……

lines.en: And it is a pillow!
lines.zh: 还有个枕头！

lines.en: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
lines.zh: 皮特，玛莎，我知道我有笔。

lines.en: Anna, it is a map.
lines.zh: 安娜，这是一张地图。

lines.en: Why do you have a map of the world?
lines.zh: 你为什么带着一张世界地图？

lines.en: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
lines.zh: 皮特，玛莎，这回我确定我有笔。

lines.en: And now you have a lamp.
lines.zh: 现在你又多了一盏台灯。

lines.en: Anna.
lines.zh: 安娜。

lines.en: I have a pen! Let's get coffee!
lines.zh: 我有笔！我们去喝咖啡吧！

qs.q: What does Marsha want?
qs.why: "Anna, do you have a pen?"

qs.q: Which thing is NOT in Anna's bag?
qs.why: 包里拿出了书、玩具、枕头、地图、台灯，最后才是笔。

qs.q: What is the map of?
qs.why: "Why do you have a map of the world?"

lessons.title: Where Are You?
lessons.zh: 你在哪儿？参观朋友的漂亮房子

lines.en: Hello, everyone! Today my friend Marsha is at her friend's house. She says it is beautiful. I want to see this house! Here we are!
lines.zh: 大家好！今天我朋友玛莎在她朋友家。她说那房子很漂亮。我想去看看！我们到了！

lines.en: Marsha, I am in the kitchen! It is a beautiful kitchen!
lines.zh: 玛莎，我在厨房！好漂亮的厨房！

lines.en: It is beautiful. We cook in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 是很漂亮。我们在厨房做饭。

lines.en: I eat in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 我在厨房吃饭。

lines.en: We relax in the living room.
lines.zh: 我们在客厅休息。

lines.en: I relax in the living room. Marsha, let's go upstairs!
lines.zh: 我在客厅休息。玛莎，我们上楼吧！

lines.en: Anna? Where are you?
lines.zh: 安娜？你在哪儿？

lines.en: Marsha, I am in the bathroom! I wash in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 玛莎，我在浴室！我在浴室洗漱。

lines.en: I am in the bedroom. We sleep in the bedroom.
lines.zh: 我在卧室。我们在卧室睡觉。

lines.en: I sleep in the bedroom!
lines.zh: 我在卧室睡觉！

qs.q: Where do they cook?
qs.why: "We cook in the kitchen."

qs.q: Where do they relax?
qs.why: "We relax in the living room."

qs.q: Where is Marsha at the end?
qs.why: "I am in the bedroom."

lessons.title: Where Is the Gym?
lessons.zh: 健身房在哪儿？问路记方位

lines.en: Hi there! I'm Anna and I live in Washington, D.C. Every day I learn more about this great city. People in Washington like to work out! Oh, hi, Pete. How's it going?
lines.zh: 大家好！我是安娜，住在华盛顿。每天我都更了解这座很棒的城市。华盛顿人爱健身！哦，嗨，皮特，最近怎么样？

lines.en: Hi, Anna. It's going great. How's it going with you?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜，挺好的。你呢？

lines.en: Things are awesome! Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
lines.zh: 好极了！皮特，我想锻炼一下。健身房在哪儿？

lines.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It's next to the mailroom. Go that way.
lines.zh: 健身房在休息室对面，挨着收发室。往那边走。

lines.en: Thanks, Pete!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，皮特！

lines.en: (Anna walks away)
lines.zh: （安娜走开了）

lines.en: No, Anna! Not that way! Go that way!
lines.zh: 不对，安娜！不是那边！是那边！

lines.en: (In the mailroom)
lines.zh: （在收发室）

lines.en: Oh, Pete. This is not the gym.
lines.zh: 哦，皮特，这不是健身房。

lines.en: That's right, Anna. This is the mailroom.
lines.zh: 没错，安娜，这是收发室。

lines.en: The gym is across from … what?
lines.zh: 健身房在……什么的对面？

lines.en: The gym is across from the lounge.
lines.zh: 健身房在休息室对面。

lines.en: Across from the lounge. Right. Thanks!
lines.zh: 休息室对面。好，谢谢！

lines.en: (In the lounge)
lines.zh: （在休息室）

lines.en: Pete! This is not the gym!
lines.zh: 皮特！这不是健身房！

lines.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.
lines.zh: 健身房在休息室对面，在大堂后面。

lines.en: Right. Right. See you.
lines.zh: 好，好，回头见。

lines.en: See you, Anna!
lines.zh: 回头见，安娜！

lines.en: See you.
lines.zh: 回头见。

lines.en: See you, Anna.
lines.zh: 回头见，安娜。

lines.en: (In the garage)
lines.zh: （在车库）

lines.en: This is not the gym. This is a parking garage.
lines.zh: 这不是健身房，这是停车库。

lines.en: Hello? Pete?
lines.zh: 喂？皮特？

lines.en: (On the rooftop)
lines.zh: （在楼顶）

lines.en: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.
lines.zh: 这不是健身房，这是楼顶。

lines.en: (In the gym)
lines.zh: （在健身房）

lines.en: Pete! Pete?
lines.zh: 皮特！皮特？

lines.en: I want to work out too! Join me!
lines.zh: 我也想锻炼！一起来吧！

lines.en: I'm good.
lines.zh: 我不用了。

qs.q: Where is the gym?
qs.why: "The gym is across from the lounge."

qs.q: What is next to the gym?
qs.why: "It's next to the mailroom."

qs.q: Who is in the gym at the end?
qs.why: "I want to work out too! Join me!"

lessons.title: What Are You Doing?
lessons.zh: 你在做什么？上班第一天

lines.en: Come in.
lines.zh: 请进。

lines.en: Well, Anna, welcome.
lines.zh: 嗯，安娜，欢迎。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: I am your boss, Caty Weaver. But, please call me Caty.
lines.zh: 我是你的上司凯蒂·韦弗。不过，叫我凯蒂就好。

lines.en: Thank you, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 谢谢您，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Just Caty.
lines.zh: 叫凯蒂就行。

lines.en: Sure thing, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 没问题，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Okay then. Are you excited?
lines.zh: 好吧。你兴奋吗？

lines.en: Yes, I am excited!
lines.zh: 是的，我很兴奋！

lines.en: So sorry, but I am busy. Please meet your co-workers. But remember, they are busy working.
lines.zh: 真抱歉，我很忙。去认识一下你的同事吧。不过记住，他们都在忙着工作。

lines.en: Sure. Thanks, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢您，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Hi there! I'm Anna.
lines.zh: 嗨！我是安娜。

lines.en: Hi, Anna. I'm Anne.
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜，我是安妮。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. What are you doing?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。你在做什么？

lines.en: Um, I'm writing.
lines.zh: 嗯，我在写东西。

lines.en: You are writing! You are writing a lot!
lines.zh: 你在写东西！你写了好多！

lines.en: (Spills papers) Oh! Oh dear.
lines.zh: （把文件弄洒了）哦！哎呀。

lines.en: No! No! That's okay.
lines.zh: 不！不！没关系。

lines.en: I am sorry!
lines.zh: 对不起！

lines.en: That's okay. Really.
lines.zh: 没关系，真的。

lines.en: I am sorry!
lines.zh: 对不起！

lines.en: Please. Please. Please stop. Please.
lines.zh: 拜托，拜托，别弄了，拜托。

lines.en: Sorry. Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉，抱歉。

lines.en: (in the studio) "and people all around the world are waiting to hear news about the next president…"
lines.zh: （在录音室）“全世界的人都在等待下一任总统的消息……”

lines.en: Jonathan, hi! Remember me? I live in your building.
lines.zh: 乔纳森，嗨！还记得我吗？我住在你们楼。

lines.en: Oh. Uh. Hi, Anna.
lines.zh: 哦，呃，嗨，安娜。

lines.en: What are you doing?
lines.zh: 你在做什么？

lines.en: I am doing my show!
lines.zh: 我在录我的节目！

lines.en: Oh, sorry. Are you recording?
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉。你在录音吗？

lines.en: Yes! And, now I have to record again!
lines.zh: 是啊！现在我得重录了！

lines.en: Sorry. Have a good show.
lines.zh: 抱歉，节目顺利。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉。

lines.en: The word of the day is social. Social -
lines.zh: 今天的单词是 social。Social——

lines.en: Oh! Hi!
lines.zh: 哦！嗨！

lines.en: - is an adjective.
lines.zh: ——是个形容词。

lines.en: Hi! I'm Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨！我是安娜！

lines.en: Hi. I'm Amelia.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是阿米莉亚。

lines.en: Nice to meet you!
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你！

lines.en: What are you doing?
lines.zh: 你在做什么？

lines.en: I'm reading.
lines.zh: 我在读稿。

lines.en: Are you reading the news? Hi!
lines.zh: 你在读新闻吗？嗨！

lines.en: No, I'm reading for my show.
lines.zh: 不是，我在为我的节目读稿。

lines.en: (to camera person) Can I read again?
lines.zh: （对摄像师）我能再读一遍吗？

lines.en: Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉。

lines.en: This day is not going well.
lines.zh: 今天真不顺。

lines.en: Anna! Hi! What're you doing?
lines.zh: 安娜！嗨！你在做什么？

lines.en: I am bothering people, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 我在打扰别人，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Let's go to my office and talk.
lines.zh: 我们去我办公室谈谈吧。

lines.en: I like to talk with you, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 我喜欢和您聊天，韦弗女士。

lines.en: It's Caty.
lines.zh: 叫凯蒂。

lines.en: Right. Thanks ... Ms. Weaver
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢……韦弗女士。

qs.q: Who is Caty Weaver?
qs.why: "I am your boss, Caty Weaver."

qs.q: What is Jonathan doing?
qs.why: "I am doing my show!" 他在录节目。

qs.q: Why does Anna say "This day is not going well"?
qs.why: 她一直打扰同事工作。

lessons.title: Are You Busy?
lessons.zh: 你忙吗？向同事道歉

lines.en: Hello, everyone. Here I am at my new job! Yesterday at my first day of work … Well, let's not talk about yesterday. Today is a new day! Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.
lines.zh: 大家好。我在新工作这儿！昨天上班第一天……嗯，昨天的事就不提了。今天是新的一天！今天我想向同事们道歉。

lines.en: Hi, Anne. Are you busy?
lines.zh: 嗨，安妮。你忙吗？

lines.en: Hi, Anna. Yes. At 10 a.m. I am writing. Every day I do my morning show. Sorry!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。是的，上午 10 点我在写稿。每天我都做早间节目。抱歉！

lines.en: Okay. See you later, maybe.
lines.zh: 好吧。也许回头见。

lines.en: Maybe I'll see you later.
lines.zh: 也许回头见吧。

lines.en: Hi, Jonathan. Are you busy?
lines.zh: 嗨，乔纳森。你忙吗？

lines.en: Yes, I'm busy. When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.
lines.zh: 是的，我很忙。录音室的灯亮着时，我就在录晚间节目。

lines.en: Right. Sorry about yesterday.
lines.zh: 好的。昨天的事很抱歉。

lines.en: No worries.
lines.zh: 没事。

lines.en: May I see the studio?
lines.zh: 我能看看录音室吗？

lines.en: Um, maybe another time? Right now I am busy.
lines.zh: 嗯，改天吧？现在我很忙。

lines.en: Sure. Okay, 'bye.
lines.zh: 好的，那拜拜。

lines.en: 'Bye.
lines.zh: 拜拜。

lines.en: Hi, Amelia! Are you busy?
lines.zh: 嗨，阿米莉亚！你忙吗？

lines.en: I'm a little busy.
lines.zh: 有点忙。

lines.en: I want to say I'm sorry for yesterday.
lines.zh: 我想为昨天的事说声对不起。

lines.en: It's okay, Anna.
lines.zh: 没关系，安娜。

lines.en: Well, I am sorry.
lines.zh: 嗯，我真的很抱歉。

lines.en: It's okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.
lines.zh: 没关系，安娜。今天下午过来坐坐吧。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好的。

lines.en: Anna.
lines.zh: 安娜。

lines.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 是的，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Are you busy?
lines.zh: 你忙吗？

lines.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I am busy.
lines.zh: 是的，韦弗女士，我很忙。

lines.en: My office. 5:00 p.m.
lines.zh: 我办公室，下午 5 点。
下午 5 点。

lines.en: Come in.
lines.zh: 请进。

lines.en: Surprise!
lines.zh: 惊喜！

lines.en: A party! Awesome! And I still have my job! Phew! Until next time!
lines.zh: 一个派对！太棒了！而且我的工作还在！呼！下次见！

qs.q: What does Anna want to do today?
qs.why: "Today I want to apologize to my co-workers."

qs.q: When the studio light is on, Jonathan is ___.
qs.why: "When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show."

qs.q: What is in Ms. Weaver's office at 5:00 p.m.?
qs.why: 同事们喊 Surprise!——是个惊喜派对。

lessons.title: Is It Cold?
lessons.zh: 冷吗？问手机天气预报

lines.en: Oh, hi, everyone! Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often. One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast. Hello, Phone? What is today's temperature?
lines.zh: 哦，嗨，大家好！华盛顿的天气变化很快。这天又冷又刮风，第二天就暖和晴朗了！所以我每天都查天气预报。你好，手机？今天多少度？

lines.en: Today it is 18 degrees ...
lines.zh: 今天 18 度……

lines.en: Eighteen degrees! That is cold!
lines.zh: 18 度！好冷！

lines.en: … eighteen degrees Celsius.
Oh, Celsius. That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That's warm.
lines.zh: 哦，摄氏度。那是华氏 65 度，挺暖和的。

lines.en: Yes, Anna. It is warm.
lines.zh: 是的，安娜，很暖和。

lines.en: Excuse me, Phone. Is it windy today?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，手机，今天刮风吗？

lines.en: No, it is not windy today.
lines.zh: 不，今天不刮风。

lines.en: Is it sunny today?
lines.zh: 今天晴天吗？

lines.en: Yes, Anna. It is sunny.
lines.zh: 是的，安娜，晴天。

lines.en: Excuse me, Phone?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，手机？

lines.en: Yes, Anna.
lines.zh: 在，安娜。

lines.en: Is it snowy today?
lines.zh: 今天下雪吗？

lines.en: No, Anna. It is not snowy.
lines.zh: 不，安娜，不下雪。

lines.en: Thank you, Phone!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，手机！

lines.en: Today the weather is warm and sunny -- great for seeing Washington, D.C.
lines.zh: 今天天气暖和晴朗——正适合逛华盛顿。

lines.en: Phone! It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!
lines.zh: 手机！一点也不暖和晴朗！又冷又刮风还下雪！

lines.en: Anna, it is not cold, windy, or snowy. It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.
lines.zh: 安娜，不冷、不刮风、也不下雪。暖和又晴朗的是……墨西哥的墨西哥城。

lines.en: Oh. I see. Mexico.
lines.zh: 哦，明白了，墨西哥。

lines.en: Washington weather changes often. Remember to check the forecast -- the right forecast.
lines.zh: 华盛顿的天气变化很快。记得查天气预报——查对的地方。

lines.en: Yes, Anna. Next time remember to check the right fore…
lines.zh: 是的，安娜。下次记得查对的天气预……

lines.en: Okay, thank you Phone. Goodbye, Phone.
lines.zh: 好了，谢谢你，手机。再见，手机。

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: Eighteen degrees Celsius is about ___ degrees Fahrenheit.
qs.why: "That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit."

qs.q: What is the weather really like in Washington?
qs.why: 她出门发现又冷又刮风还下雪。

qs.q: Why is the phone wrong?
opts: It checks the weather in Mexico City.
qs.a: It checks the weather in Mexico City.
qs.why: 手机查的是墨西哥城的天气。

lessons.title: Come Over to My Place
lessons.zh: 来我家吧！给朋友指路

lines.en: Hi! Today, my friend Ashley, is coming over. I am showing her my new apartment! Oh! That's Ashley calling.
lines.zh: 嗨！今天我的朋友阿什莉要过来。我要带她看我的新公寓！哦！是阿什莉打来的。

lines.en: Hi Ashley!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

lines.en: Hi Anna! I'm coming to your apartment. Where is your apartment?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！我正去你的公寓。你的公寓在哪儿？

lines.en: My apartment is near the Columbia Heights Metro.
lines.zh: 我的公寓在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近。

lines.en: It is near the Columbia Heights Metro?
lines.zh: 在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近？

lines.en: Yes. Exit the Metro and turn right. Then at the bus station turn left. Then walk straight ahead.
lines.zh: 对。出地铁后右转，到公交站再左转，然后一直往前走。

lines.en: Okay. Exit Metro, turn right, turn left, then go straight ahead?
lines.zh: 好的。出地铁，右转，左转，然后直走？

lines.en: Yes. My apartment is near a coffee shop.
lines.zh: 对。我的公寓在一家咖啡店附近。

lines.en: Okay. See you soon!
lines.zh: 好的，一会儿见！

lines.en: Hi, Ashley.
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉。

lines.en: Anna, Which coffee shop? There are three coffee shops.
lines.zh: 安娜，哪家咖啡店？这儿有三家咖啡店。

lines.en: Okay, my apartment is across from a big department store.
lines.zh: 好吧，我的公寓在一家大百货商店对面。

lines.en: A big department store? Ah, I see it!
lines.zh: 大百货商店？啊，我看到了！

lines.en: Okay! Bye, Ashley. See you soon!
lines.zh: 好！拜拜，阿什莉，一会儿见！

lines.en: Okay. See you soon.
lines.zh: 好的，一会儿见。

lines.en: Ashley! Ashley! Ashley! Over here! It's Anna! It's Anna! Hi!
lines.zh: 阿什莉！阿什莉！阿什莉！这边！是我安娜！是安娜！嗨！

lines.en: I love having my friends over. Come on!
lines.zh: 我喜欢请朋友来家里玩。来吧！

lines.en: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

qs.q: Where is Anna's apartment?
qs.why: "My apartment is near the Columbia Heights Metro."

qs.q: After Ashley exits the Metro, she turns ___.
qs.why: "Exit the Metro and turn right."

qs.q: Why is "near a coffee shop" not helpful?
qs.why: "There are three coffee shops."

lessons.title: This Is My Neighborhood
lessons.zh: 这是我的街区：寄信、取钱、吃冰淇淋

lines.en: Hello! DC is a city for walking. In our neighborhood, I can do all my errands. Marsha, before we get ice cream, I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿是个适合走路的城市。在我们街区，我所有的杂事都能办完。玛莎，吃冰淇淋之前，我得去图书馆还三本书。图书馆在哪儿？

lines.en: It is on this street on the corner.
lines.zh: 就在这条街的拐角。

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: Let's go!
lines.zh: 走吧！

lines.en: Marsha, I can return the books here.
lines.zh: 玛莎，我可以在这儿还书。

lines.en: Anna, what are those in the books?
lines.zh: 安娜，书里夹的是什么？

lines.en: Marsha, these are letters to my family and friends back home … four letters! Is there a post office near here?
lines.zh: 玛莎，这些是写给老家家人和朋友的信……四封！这附近有邮局吗？

lines.en: Um, no. The post office is far from here. But there is a mailbox across from the store.
lines.zh: 嗯，没有。邮局离这儿很远。不过商店对面有个邮筒。

lines.en: Awesome! Let's go!
lines.zh: 太好了！走吧！

lines.en: (At the mailbox)
lines.zh: （在邮筒旁）

lines.en: Marsha, now I need to buy stamps.
lines.zh: 玛莎，现在我得买邮票。

lines.en: Do you have cash?
lines.zh: 你有现金吗？

lines.en: No. Is there a bank near here?
lines.zh: 没有。这附近有银行吗？

lines.en: There is a bank behind you.
lines.zh: 银行就在你身后。

lines.en: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，玛莎。你对我们街区真熟。

lines.en: Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
lines.zh: 现在我有现金了，可以买邮票了。

lines.en: That store sells stamps.
lines.zh: 那家店卖邮票。

lines.en: Wait here.
lines.zh: 在这儿等我。

lines.en: I have stamps.
lines.zh: 我买到邮票了。

lines.en: Wow, you're fast.
lines.zh: 哇，你真快。

lines.en: Thank you, thank you letters, for sending my words… my love … to my family and friends -
lines.zh: 谢谢你，谢谢你们这些信，把我的话……我的爱……带给家人和朋友——

lines.en: Do you have more cash?
lines.zh: 你还有现金吗？

lines.en: I do!
lines.zh: 有！

lines.en: Ice cream!!
lines.zh: 冰淇淋！！

lines.en: I love my new neighborhood! Everything is near our apartment! Even hair salons, and ice cream!
lines.zh: 我爱我的新街区！什么都离我们公寓很近！连美发店和冰淇淋都有！

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: Where does Anna return her books?
qs.why: "I need to return three books to the library."

qs.q: Why does Anna go to the bank?
opts: She needs cash to buy stamps.
qs.a: She needs cash to buy stamps.
qs.why: 买邮票需要现金，所以去银行。

qs.q: What do Anna and Marsha get at the end?
qs.why: "Ice cream!!"

lessons.title: Meet My Family
lessons.zh: 认识我的家人：安娜想家了

lines.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many beautiful parks. In fact, this park reminds me of my home very far away.
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿有很多漂亮的公园。说实话，这个公园让我想起了很远很远的老家。

lines.en: Anna, here's your coffee.
lines.zh: 安娜，你的咖啡。

lines.en: Thanks, Marsha.
lines.zh: 谢谢，玛莎。

lines.en: What's wrong?
lines.zh: 怎么了？

lines.en: I'm thinking about my family. I'm feeling homesick.
lines.zh: 我在想我的家人，我想家了。

lines.en: Do you want to talk about it?
lines.zh: 想聊聊吗？

lines.en: Sure! I have some photos.
lines.zh: 好啊！我有些照片。

lines.en: Yes. Yes, you do!
lines.zh: 是啊，你还真有不少！

lines.en: Photos really help.
lines.zh: 看照片真的有用。

lines.en: This is my mother and this is my father. They are rodeo clowns.
lines.zh: 这是我妈妈，这是我爸爸。他们是牛仔竞技小丑。

lines.en: What do rodeo clowns do?
lines.zh: 牛仔竞技小丑是做什么的？

lines.en: They make jokes at a rodeo. They make people laugh.
lines.zh: 他们在牛仔竞技表演上讲笑话，逗大家笑。

lines.en: That-That';s very different.
lines.zh: 那……那可真特别。

lines.en: Who is that woman in the picture?
lines.zh: 照片里那位女士是谁？

lines.en: That is my Aunt Lavender. She is my mom's sister. She loves gardening and makes spoons.
lines.zh: 那是我的薰衣草姨妈，她是我妈妈的妹妹。她喜欢园艺，还会做勺子。

lines.en: She makes spoons?
lines.zh: 她做勺子？

lines.en: Of course.
lines.zh: 当然。

lines.en: That, too, is very different.
lines.zh: 那也挺特别的。

lines.en: Oh! This is my Uncle John. He is my father's brother.
lines.zh: 哦！这是我的约翰叔叔，他是我爸爸的弟弟。

lines.en: What does Uncle John do?
lines.zh: 约翰叔叔是做什么的？

lines.en: He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars. He's awesome, and I'm his favorite niece.
lines.zh: 他是养鸡的农民，还会做吉他。他很棒，我是他最喜欢的侄女。

lines.en: Who are they?
lines.zh: 他们是谁？

lines.en: They are my cousins. They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.
lines.zh: 他们是我的堂兄妹，是约翰叔叔的女儿和儿子。

lines.en: What do they do?
lines.zh: 他们做什么？

lines.en: They raise sheep and make sweaters.
lines.zh: 他们养羊，织毛衣。

lines.en: Yeah, that's not a surprise.
lines.zh: 嗯，这倒不意外。

lines.en: Thanks for showing me your family photos. Your family is very different.
lines.zh: 谢谢你给我看家人的照片。你的家人真的很特别。

lines.en: I do feel better. Thanks for listening. I have many more photos!
lines.zh: 我确实感觉好多了。谢谢你听我说。我还有好多照片呢！

lines.en: Yeah. Yeah, you do.
lines.zh: 是啊，是啊，你还真有。

lines.en: Washington, DC is my new home. But I like remembering my old home, too.
lines.zh: 华盛顿是我的新家，不过我也喜欢回忆我的老家。

qs.q: Why is Anna sad?
qs.why: "I'm feeling homesick."

qs.q: Who is Aunt Lavender?
qs.why: "She is my mom's sister."

qs.q: What does Uncle John make?
qs.why: "He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars."

lessons.title: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare!
lessons.zh: 莎士比亚生日快乐！做点不寻常的事

lines.en: Hello! In Washington D.C. there are many things to do on a Sunday afternoon. I like to exercise. I like to shop. I like to garden. But today I feel bored. When I feel bored I always look for something unusual to do! I hear music. Let's go see! What is going on here?
lines.zh: 你好！在华盛顿，周日下午有很多事可做。我喜欢运动，喜欢购物，喜欢种花草。可今天我觉得无聊。我一无聊就会找点不寻常的事做！我听到音乐了，去看看！这儿在干什么？

lines.en: It's a big birthday party for the writer William Shakespeare.
lines.zh: 这是作家威廉·莎士比亚的盛大生日派对。

lines.en: This is a party for William Shakespeare?
lines.zh: 这是给威廉·莎士比亚办的派对？

lines.en: Yes!
lines.zh: 是的！

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.en: This is a drum band. I never listen to a drum band. But today I am listening to a drum band because it's Shakespeare's birthday!
lines.zh: 这是个鼓乐队。我从来不听鼓乐队，可今天我在听，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

lines.en: This is a puppet show. I never watch puppet shows. But today I am watching a puppet show because it's Shakespeare's birthday!
lines.zh: 这是木偶戏。我从来不看木偶戏，可今天我在看，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

lines.en: My clothes are usual. His clothes are unusual.
lines.zh: 我的衣服很平常，他的衣服很不寻常。

lines.en: In Washington, D.C. seeing a politician or even the President is usual. Seeing the Queen of England is very unusual! Your majesty!
lines.zh: 在华盛顿，见到政客甚至总统都很平常。见到英国女王可就非常不寻常了！女王陛下！

lines.en: This is sword fighting. I never sword fight. But today I am sword fighting because it's Shakespeare's birthday!
lines.zh: 这是击剑。我从来不击剑，可今天我在击剑，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

lines.en: There are many things to do in Washington, D.C. -- some usual, some unusual.
lines.zh: 华盛顿有很多事可做——有平常的，也有不寻常的。

lines.en: Today, I am not bored because … it is William Shakespeare's birthday!
lines.zh: 今天我不无聊，因为……今天是威廉·莎士比亚的生日！

qs.q: How does Anna feel at the start?
qs.why: "But today I feel bored."

qs.q: Whose birthday party is it?
qs.why: "a big birthday party for the writer William Shakespeare."

qs.q: Which thing does Anna NOT do at the party?
qs.why: 她听鼓乐队（listen），但没有自己打鼓。

lessons.title: How About This?
lessons.zh: 这件怎么样？杂志精灵帮安娜挑衣服

lines.en: Hi, there! In Washington, D.C. people do many things in the evening. They go listen to music. They eat at a restaurant. They go to the theater.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！在华盛顿，人们晚上会做很多事：去听音乐，去餐厅吃饭，去看戏。

lines.en: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends. But I don't know what clothes to wear. Maybe this magazine can help.
lines.zh: 今晚我要和朋友去剧院，可我不知道穿什么。也许这本杂志能帮上忙。

lines.en: Her clothes are beautiful! I really want a friend like her to help me.
lines.zh: 她的衣服真漂亮！我真想有个她这样的朋友帮我。

lines.en: Who are you?
lines.zh: 你是谁？

lines.en: I am Genie! You want help. I am here to help you find the right clothes!
lines.zh: 我是精灵！你需要帮助，我来帮你挑合适的衣服！

lines.en: Awesome! How about jeans and a t-shirt?
lines.zh: 太棒了！牛仔裤配 T 恤怎么样？

lines.en: No! Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?
lines.zh: 不行！牛仔裤和 T 恤太随便了。来点正式一点的怎么样？

lines.en: Sure!
lines.zh: 好啊！

lines.en: Wow! Genie, this dress is beautiful. But it's not the right size. It's too small.
lines.zh: 哇！精灵，这条裙子真漂亮。可尺码不对，太小了。

lines.en: Yes, it is too small. But green looks great on you.
lines.zh: 是啊，太小了。不过绿色很适合你。

lines.en: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Take off the green dress. Let's try a green shirt and a skirt.
lines.zh: 把绿裙子脱了，试试绿衬衫配半身裙。

lines.en: Oh, Genie! This green shirt is too large and this orange skirt is too orange.
lines.zh: 哦，精灵！这件绿衬衫太大了，这条橙色裙子也太橙了。

lines.en: Yes, the right size for you is medium. Let's try again.
lines.zh: 是的，你合适的尺码是中号。我们再试试。

lines.en: Oh, I don't like this outfit.
lines.zh: 哦，我不喜欢这身。

lines.en: No. That does not match.
lines.zh: 不行，这不搭。

lines.en: Nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都不合适。

lines.en: These clothes are formal: a suit jacket, a dress shirt and a tie! They look great!
lines.zh: 这些衣服很正式：西装外套、正装衬衫，还有领带！看起来很棒！

lines.en: Those clothes look great … for a man! Something is wrong.
lines.zh: 这些衣服看起来很棒……给男人穿的话！有点不对劲。

lines.en: Let me see.
lines.zh: 让我看看。

lines.en: There. Now try.
lines.zh: 好了，现在试试。

lines.en: Oh. Thanks! Now these clothes look great on you!
lines.zh: 哦，谢谢！现在这些衣服穿在你身上很好看！

lines.en: They do! Um, Genie, can you put on a gold belt?
lines.zh: 是啊！嗯，精灵，你能系一条金色腰带吗？

lines.en: Sure!
lines.zh: 当然！

lines.en: That looks great.
lines.zh: 看起来很棒。

lines.en: Can you put on a jacket?
lines.zh: 你能穿件外套吗？

lines.en: Why not?
lines.zh: 为什么不呢？

lines.en: I love the jacket! How about a hat?
lines.zh: 我爱这件外套！再戴顶帽子怎么样？

lines.en: Why not?
lines.zh: 为什么不呢？

lines.en: Mm, take off the hat. That's better.
lines.zh: 嗯，把帽子摘了吧，这样更好。

lines.en: Genie, these clothes look and feel great! Let's go to the theater!
lines.zh: 精灵，这身衣服看着好、穿着也舒服！我们去剧院吧！

lines.en: Sorry, Anna. I have to help other friends. Go to the magazine if you want me to help again.
lines.zh: 抱歉，安娜，我得去帮别的朋友了。你想让我再帮忙就去看杂志吧。

lines.en: Thanks, Genie. Sure thing. Goodbye!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，精灵。没问题，再见！

lines.en: Goodbye!
lines.zh: 再见！

lines.en: There are many places in DC to go for a great evening out! And it's nice to have a friend to help me look my best. Until next time! Bye!
lines.zh: 华盛顿有很多好地方可以晚上出去玩！有个朋友帮我打扮得漂漂亮亮真好。下次见！拜拜！

qs.q: Where is Anna going tonight?
qs.why: "Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends."

qs.q: Why are jeans and a t-shirt not OK?
qs.why: "Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual."

qs.q: What is Anna's right size?
qs.why: "the right size for you is medium."

lessons.title: I Love People-Watching!
lessons.zh: 我爱看路人：描述外貌

lines.en: Hello! People from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. When I'm at work, I love eating lunch outside. I like to watch people walking by. They all look very different. Today, my friend Ashley is eating lunch with me.
lines.zh: 你好！世界各地的人都来华盛顿。上班时，我喜欢在外面吃午饭，看着人们走过。他们长得都很不一样。今天我的朋友阿什莉和我一起吃午饭。

lines.en: Ashley, today the weather is beautiful, isn't it?
lines.zh: 阿什莉，今天天气真好，是吧？

lines.en: Yes, it is. Ahh. Ooh, we have to return to work!
lines.zh: 是啊。啊。哦，我们得回去上班了！

lines.en: No, we have time! Let's people-watch a little more.
lines.zh: 不，还有时间！再看会儿人吧。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: Oh, I know her. She works in my office! Keyana, hi! Come and join us!
lines.zh: 哦，我认识她，她在我们办公室上班！琪亚娜，嗨！过来一起坐！

lines.en: Hi Anna, how are you?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜，你好吗？

lines.en: I'm doing great! Keyana, this is my friend Ashley.
lines.zh: 我很好！琪亚娜，这是我的朋友阿什莉。

lines.en: Hi, Ashley!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

lines.en: We need to return to work. But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!
lines.zh: 我们得回去上班了。可天气这么好，看人又这么好玩！

lines.en: I love people-watching too!
lines.zh: 我也爱看人！

lines.en: Well, have a seat! It is fun to see how people are different or the same.
lines.zh: 那就坐下吧！看看人们哪里不同、哪里相同，很有意思。

lines.en: It is. For example, Anna, you are tall. But Ashley and I are short.
lines.zh: 是啊。比如安娜，你个子高，可阿什莉和我个子矮。

lines.en: And Keyana, you and Ashley have brown eyes; I have blue eyes.
lines.zh: 还有琪亚娜，你和阿什莉是棕色眼睛，我是蓝眼睛。

lines.en: You two have light skin and I have dark skin.
lines.zh: 你们俩皮肤白，我皮肤黑。

lines.en: Ashley, you have straight hair. Keyana and I have curly hair.
lines.zh: 阿什莉，你是直发。琪亚娜和我是卷发。

lines.en: You have very curly hair, Anna.
lines.zh: 你的头发特别卷，安娜。

lines.en: I need to return to work. See you, Anna! Nice to meet you Ashley!
lines.zh: 我得回去上班了。回头见，安娜！很高兴认识你，阿什莉！

lines.en: Bye, Keyana!
lines.zh: 拜拜，琪亚娜！

lines.en: Anna, I have to go, too. Are you returning to work?
lines.zh: 安娜，我也得走了。你要回去上班吗？

lines.en: I still have time. And this sun feels so good!
lines.zh: 我还有时间。这太阳晒着真舒服！

lines.en: Um, Anna, what does your boss look like?
lines.zh: 嗯，安娜，你的上司长什么样？

lines.en: She is short. She has straight, light hair.
lines.zh: 她个子矮，金色直发。

lines.en: Does she wear glasses?
lines.zh: 她戴眼镜吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, she does.
lines.zh: 戴，她戴眼镜。

lines.en: Is she wearing a blue sweater today?
lines.zh: 她今天穿蓝毛衣吗？

lines.en: How do you know that?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道？

lines.en: She's coming this way.
lines.zh: 她正朝这边走过来。

lines.en: Oh no! Hide me!
lines.zh: 哦不！快把我藏起来！

lines.en: Um, bye, Anna. Call me later.
lines.zh: 呃，拜拜，安娜。回头给我打电话。

lines.en: Bye, Ashley! Talk to you later!
lines.zh: 拜拜，阿什莉！回头聊！

lines.en: Anna? Is that you?
lines.zh: 安娜？是你吗？

lines.en: Ms. Weaver! Hi!
lines.zh: 韦弗女士！嗨！

lines.en: What are you doing behind that bench?
lines.zh: 你在长椅后面干什么？

lines.en: I am looking for my, my … stick. Here it is.
lines.zh: 我在找我的，我的……树枝。找到了。

lines.en: I am people-watching. Oh! But it's time to return to work!
lines.zh: 我在看路人。哦！该回去上班了！

lines.en: No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let's sit!
lines.zh: 不用急。我也爱看人！坐吧！

lines.en: Sure! Ahh.
lines.zh: 好啊！啊。

lines.en: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
lines.zh: 今天天气真好，是吧？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, it is, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 是啊，是啊，韦弗女士。

lines.en: People-watching in D.C. is fun. It makes me forget the time!
lines.zh: 在华盛顿看路人真好玩，让我都忘了时间！

lines.en: Until next time! Ahh.
lines.zh: 下次见！啊。

qs.q: What does Anna love to do at lunch?
qs.why: "I like to watch people walking by."

qs.q: Who has curly hair?
qs.why: "Keyana and I have curly hair."

qs.q: What is Anna's boss wearing today?
qs.why: "Is she wearing a blue sweater today?"

lessons.title: Where Are You From?
lessons.zh: 你是哪里人？采访各国游客

lines.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many tourists! People from different countries come here. Today, my job is to interview tourists. I have to learn why they come here. This is very exciting! Excuse me. I'm Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for an interview?
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿有很多游客，不同国家的人都来这里。今天我的工作是采访游客，了解他们为什么来这儿。真让人兴奋！打扰一下，我是《新闻》的安娜·马泰奥。您有时间接受采访吗？

lines.en: Sure, I have time.
lines.zh: 当然，我有时间。

lines.en: What is your name?
lines.zh: 您叫什么名字？

lines.en: My name is Sabrina.
lines.zh: 我叫萨布丽娜。

lines.en: What country are you from?
lines.zh: 您来自哪个国家？

lines.en: I'm from Bangladesh.
lines.zh: 我来自孟加拉国。

lines.en: So, you are Bangladeshi.
lines.zh: 所以您是孟加拉人。

lines.en: That's right! My nationality is Bangladeshi.
lines.zh: 没错！我的国籍是孟加拉。

lines.en: Do you like Washington, D.C.?
lines.zh: 您喜欢华盛顿吗？

lines.en: Yes! The city is very beautiful!
lines.zh: 喜欢！这座城市非常漂亮！

lines.en: What do you like to do in Washington D.C.?
lines.zh: 您在华盛顿喜欢做什么？

lines.en: I like history. So, I like walking around and looking at all the monuments and memorials. They make history come alive!
lines.zh: 我喜欢历史，所以喜欢四处走走，看看各种纪念碑和纪念堂。它们让历史活了起来！

lines.en: Washington has many monuments and memorials. The Washington Monument is behind us! Which is your favorite?
lines.zh: 华盛顿有很多纪念碑和纪念堂，华盛顿纪念碑就在我们身后！您最喜欢哪个？

lines.en: I really like Lincoln Memorial. It is very beautiful. And it feels like Abraham Lincoln is still alive.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢林肯纪念堂。它很美，感觉亚伯拉罕·林肯好像还活着。

lines.en: Awesome. Thank you for your time, Sabrina!
lines.zh: 太棒了。谢谢您抽时间，萨布丽娜！

lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.zh: 不客气。

lines.en: Let's find another tourist.
lines.zh: 我们再找一位游客。

lines.en: Oh! Excuse me. I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for a couple of questions?
lines.zh: 哦！打扰一下，我是《新闻》的安娜·马泰奥。您有时间回答几个问题吗？

lines.en: Sure!
lines.zh: 当然！

lines.en: Are you from Washington, D.C.?
lines.zh: 您是华盛顿人吗？

lines.en: No, I'm not.
lines.zh: 不，我不是。

lines.en: What is your name and where are you from?
lines.zh: 您叫什么名字，来自哪里？

lines.en: My name is Louis. And I'm from China.
lines.zh: 我叫路易斯，来自中国。

lines.en: What languages do you speak?
lines.zh: 您说什么语言？

lines.en: I speak Chinese and English.
lines.zh: 我说中文和英语。

lines.en: What do you like about Washington DC?
lines.zh: 您喜欢华盛顿的什么？

lines.en: I like the museums. I really like the art museums.
lines.zh: 我喜欢博物馆，特别喜欢艺术博物馆。

lines.en: Many of the museums are free.
lines.zh: 很多博物馆是免费的。

lines.en: I like that too!
lines.zh: 这点我也喜欢！

lines.en: Awesome! Thanks for your time, Louis.
lines.zh: 太棒了！谢谢您抽时间，路易斯。

lines.en: You're very welcome. Bye!
lines.zh: 不客气，再见！

lines.en: Now, let's find another tourist!
lines.zh: 现在，再找一位游客！

lines.en: Hello! I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time to answer a couple of questions?
lines.zh: 您好！我是《新闻》的安娜·马泰奥。您有时间回答几个问题吗？

lines.en: Sure!
lines.zh: 当然！

lines.en: What is your name and where're you from?
lines.zh: 您叫什么名字，来自哪里？

lines.en: My name is Mehrnoush. I am from Iran. I'm Iranian.
lines.zh: 我叫梅尔努什，来自伊朗，我是伊朗人。

lines.en: What language do they speak in Iran? Is it Persian?
lines.zh: 伊朗说什么语言？是波斯语吗？

lines.en: They speak Farsi.
lines.zh: 说法尔西语（即波斯语）。

lines.en: What do you like to do in Washington DC?
lines.zh: 您在华盛顿喜欢做什么？

lines.en: Well, I like learning about government and politics.
lines.zh: 嗯，我喜欢了解政府和政治。

lines.en: Washington has many politicians!
lines.zh: 华盛顿有很多政客！

lines.en: It does! I want to see the U.S. Capitol.
lines.zh: 是啊！我想去看美国国会大厦。

lines.en: Look, you are very near.
lines.zh: 看，您离它很近了。

lines.en: I am!
lines.zh: 是啊！

lines.en: Have fun!
lines.zh: 玩得开心！

lines.en: Thanks!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.en: There you have it. Tourists from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. They all like doing and seeing different things in the city. This is Anna Matteo reporting for The News. Until next time!
lines.zh: 就是这样。世界各地的游客都来华盛顿，他们在这座城市喜欢做的事、喜欢看的东西各不相同。安娜·马泰奥为《新闻》报道。下次见！

lines.en: Is that okay? Awesome! Now, I want to do my favorite thing in the city … ride the carousel!
lines.zh: 这样可以吗？太棒了！现在我要做我在这座城市最喜欢的事……坐旋转木马！

qs.q: Where is Sabrina from?
qs.why: "I'm from Bangladesh."

qs.q: What does Louis like in Washington?
qs.why: "I really like the art museums."

qs.q: What language do people speak in Iran?
qs.why: "They speak Farsi."

lessons.title: Are You Free on Friday?
lessons.zh: 你周五有空吗？约看电影

lines.en: This city is very interesting, I really like my job, and I have some good friends! Speaking of friends … I see one now! Marsha! Hi!
lines.zh: 这座城市很有意思，我很喜欢我的工作，还有几个好朋友！说到朋友……我现在就看到一个！玛莎！嗨！

lines.en: Hi, Anna. What's going on?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。最近怎么样？

lines.en: Not much. How about you?
lines.zh: 没什么特别的。你呢？

lines.en: Busy as usual. Hey, do you wanna see a movie with me?
lines.zh: 老样子，很忙。嘿，你想和我去看电影吗？

lines.en: Sure! I never have time to see a movie. When?
lines.zh: 好啊！我从来没时间看电影。什么时候？

lines.en: Are you busy this Thursday at 6pm?
lines.zh: 你这周四下午 6 点忙吗？

lines.en: Let's see …. I'm busy. I am going to tap dance with my friends Thursday night.
lines.zh: 我看看……我忙。周四晚上我要和朋友跳踢踏舞。

lines.en: Tap dancing? That sounds fun!
lines.zh: 踢踏舞？听起来很好玩！

lines.en: I'm still learning. But it is fun!
lines.zh: 我还在学，不过很好玩！

lines.en: Are you busy on Friday night?
lines.zh: 你周五晚上忙吗？

lines.en: Yes. Friday nights are when I visit my parents.
lines.zh: 忙。周五晚上我都去看我爸妈。

lines.en: What do you and your family do together?
lines.zh: 你和家人一起做什么？

lines.en: We always eat dinner together and sometimes we play board games.
lines.zh: 我们总是一起吃晚饭，有时候玩桌游。

lines.en: Playing board games is fun, too! The word game Scrabble is my favorite.
lines.zh: 玩桌游也很好玩！拼字游戏 Scrabble 是我的最爱。

lines.en: I like Connect Four!
lines.zh: 我喜欢四子棋！

lines.en: I'm not busy Monday night. Are you?
lines.zh: 我周一晚上不忙。你呢？

lines.en: I am busy on Monday night. I'm going to jog in the park with my friend. Do you jog?
lines.zh: 我周一晚上忙，我要和朋友去公园慢跑。你慢跑吗？

lines.en: Oh! I always jog. Well, sometimes I jog. Okay, I never jog. But I will try because it is good for you.
lines.zh: 哦！我总是慢跑。嗯，有时候慢跑。好吧，我从不慢跑。不过我会试试，因为对身体好。

lines.en: I always feel great after I jog.
lines.zh: 我每次慢跑完都感觉很棒。

lines.en: How about on Wednesday night?
lines.zh: 周三晚上怎么样？

lines.en: Wednesday night I am not busy. Oh, no, wait. This Wednesday night I will be busy.
lines.zh: 周三晚上我不忙。哦，不对，等等。这周三晚上我会很忙。

lines.en: What are you doing?
lines.zh: 你要做什么？

lines.en: I'm going to teach children how to play the ukulele.
lines.zh: 我要教孩子们弹尤克里里。

lines.en: Now, children, play "C." Good. I like your "C."
lines.zh: 好，孩子们，弹 C 和弦。很好，我喜欢你们的 C。

lines.en: The world does need more ukulele players.
lines.zh: 这世界确实需要更多弹尤克里里的人。

lines.en: Marsha, it looks like we'll never have time to see a movie.
lines.zh: 玛莎，看来我们永远没时间去看电影了。

lines.en: Wait a minute. Are you busy now?
lines.zh: 等一下。你现在忙吗？

lines.en: It's Saturday afternoon. This is always when I do my errands.
lines.zh: 现在是周六下午，我总是这时候办杂事。

lines.en: Okay, but the new Star Wars movie is gonna start in 30 minutes.
lines.zh: 好吧，可新的《星球大战》电影 30 分钟后就开始了。

lines.en: I'll do my errands on Sunday. Let's go!
lines.zh: 我周日再办杂事吧。走！

lines.en: Most days of the week, people are really busy. But it's important to find time to be with your friends!
lines.zh: 一周里大多数日子，人们都很忙。但抽时间和朋友在一起很重要！

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: What does Marsha do on Friday nights?
qs.why: "Friday nights are when I visit my parents."

qs.q: How often does Anna really jog?
qs.why: "Okay, I never jog."

qs.q: When do they see the movie?
qs.why: "It's Saturday afternoon." 她们马上去看了。

lessons.title: She Always Does That
lessons.zh: 她总是这样：播新闻不能带感情

lines.en: Hello, from Washington, D.C.! Today at work I am reading the news for the first time. I am really nervous. But my boss, Ms. Weaver, is here to help me.
lines.zh: 华盛顿向大家问好！今天上班我第一次播新闻，我好紧张。不过我的上司韦弗女士在这儿帮我。

lines.en: Now, Anna, remember. When we read the news we are always reading facts. We never show our feelings.
lines.zh: 安娜，记住，播新闻时我们读的永远是事实，从不表露感情。

lines.en: Sure thing, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 没问题，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Great. Are you ready?
lines.zh: 很好。准备好了吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 好了。

lines.en: Okay, let's try the first story!
lines.zh: 好，我们试试第一条新闻！

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to The News.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《新闻》。

lines.en: A new book is very popular with children and families. This is it.
lines.zh: 一本新书很受孩子和家庭的欢迎，就是这本。

lines.en: It is about a lost duckling. The duck's mother cannot find him.
lines.zh: 讲的是一只走丢的小鸭子，鸭妈妈找不到它。

lines.en: Stop! Anna, when you say the words "duck" and "duckling" you look really sad.
lines.zh: 停！安娜，你说到“鸭子”和“小鸭子”时看起来特别难过。

lines.en: I do?
lines.zh: 是吗？

lines.en: Yes. Sad is a feeling.
lines.zh: 是的。难过是一种感情。

lines.en: Sad is not a fact. Sorry. Let me try again.
lines.zh: 难过不是事实。抱歉，让我再试一次。

lines.en: Okay, she's trying again! And go.
lines.zh: 好，她再试一次！开始。

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to The News. A new book is very popular with children and families. This is it.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《新闻》。一本新书很受孩子和家庭的欢迎，就是这本。

lines.en: It is about a lost duckling. The duck's mother can not find 'im. But a family gives him a home.
lines.zh: 讲的是一只走丢的小鸭子，鸭妈妈找不到它。不过一户人家收留了它。

lines.en: Stop! Anna, you are doing it again.
lines.zh: 停！安娜，你又这样了。

lines.en: This story is very sad.
lines.zh: 这个故事太让人难过了。

lines.en: I have an idea. Let's read the second story. She's reading the second story. And … go!
lines.zh: 我有个主意，我们读第二条吧。她在读第二条新闻……开始！

lines.en: Hello , and welcome to The News. In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《新闻》。在印第安纳州，一位奶奶成为第一位赢得 500 英里赛车赛的 80 岁女性。

lines.en: That is awesome!
lines.zh: 太厉害了！

lines.en: Stop! Stop! Anna, please -- no feelings.
lines.zh: 停！停！安娜，拜托——不要带感情。

lines.en: Right. But it is awesome that an 80-year-old grandmother wins a car race.
lines.zh: 好的。可 80 岁的奶奶赢了赛车，真的很厉害。

lines.en: Just the facts, Anna.
lines.zh: 只说事实，安娜。

lines.en: Right.
lines.zh: 好的。

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to The News. In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《新闻》。在印第安纳州，一位奶奶成为第一位赢得 500 英里赛车赛的 80 岁女性。

lines.en: She rarely talks to reporters. But when she does, she often says, "Nothing can stop me now!"
lines.zh: 她很少接受记者采访。不过接受采访时，她常说：“现在什么都挡不住我！”

lines.en: I am very happy for her!
lines.zh: 我真为她高兴！

lines.en: Stop, stop, stop!! Anna, you cannot say you are happy.
lines.zh: 停，停，停！！安娜，你不能说你高兴。

lines.en: But I am happy.
lines.zh: 可我就是高兴啊。

lines.en: But you can't say it.
lines.zh: 可你不能说出来。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: This is the News. Happy and sad are feelings. You can't have them in The News.
lines.zh: 这是新闻。高兴和难过都是感情，新闻里不能有。

lines.en: Okay. I got it.
lines.zh: 好的，我明白了。

lines.en: Okay. Let's try the third story. She's reading the third story!
lines.zh: 好，我们试试第三条。她在读第三条新闻！

lines.en: Hello and welcome to The News.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《新闻》。

lines.en: City politicians in Big Town are using city money to have a big party on a cruise ship. They are taking the money for the party from the children's library.
lines.zh: 大城镇的市政官员正在用市里的钱在游轮上办大派对，派对的钱是从儿童图书馆拿的。

lines.en: What?! That makes me very angry.
lines.zh: 什么？！这让我非常生气。

lines.en: No, no, no! Anna, you cannot say you are angry! This is The News!!!
lines.zh: 不不不！安娜，你不能说你生气！这是新闻！！！

lines.en: What can I do, Ms. Weaver? Take out my feelings and put them here … on the news desk?
lines.zh: 那我能怎么办，韦弗女士？把我的感情拿出来放在这儿……新闻台上？

lines.en: Yes. Yes. That's right! Now you've got it!
lines.zh: 对，对，没错！你终于明白了！

lines.en: Let's repeat the first story.
lines.zh: 我们把第一条再来一遍。

lines.en: This is going to be a very long day.
lines.zh: 今天会很漫长。

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: What must Anna NOT do when she reads the news?
qs.why: "We never show our feelings."

qs.q: Who wins the car race?
qs.why: "a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win."

qs.q: Why is Anna angry in the third story?
opts: Politicians take money from the children's library.
qs.a: Politicians take money from the children's library.
qs.why: 官员拿儿童图书馆的钱办派对。

lessons.title: When Do I Start?
lessons.zh: 我什么时候开始？好消息和坏消息

lines.en: Hi there! Summer in Washington, D.C. is hot and sunny. I always ride the Metro to work. Riding the Metro is cool and fast. But today it's closed. So, I am walking to work.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！华盛顿的夏天又热又晴。我总是坐地铁上班，坐地铁凉快又快。可今天地铁停运了，所以我走路去上班。

lines.en: (On the phone) Ms. Weaver, I am late this morning. The Metro is closed. So, I am walking to work.
lines.zh: （打电话）韦弗女士，我今早要迟到了。地铁停运了，我在走路去上班。

lines.en: That's too bad. It's really hot today.
lines.zh: 真糟糕。今天真的很热。

lines.en: Yes it is.
lines.zh: 是啊。

lines.en: When you arrive, please come to my office. I have important news to tell you.
lines.zh: 你到了就来我办公室。我有重要的消息告诉你。

lines.en: Of course. Good-bye. My boss has news for me. The question is: Is it good news or bad news?
lines.zh: 好的，再见。我的上司有消息告诉我。问题是：是好消息还是坏消息？

lines.en: (At work)
lines.zh: （在公司）

lines.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver.
lines.zh: 您好，韦弗女士。

lines.en: Anna, I have good news and I have bad news. Which do you want to hear first?
lines.zh: 安娜，我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。你想先听哪个？

lines.en: The good news. No … okay, the bad news.
lines.zh: 好消息。不……好吧，坏消息。

lines.en: The bad news is you are not good at reading the news.
lines.zh: 坏消息是，你不擅长播新闻。

lines.en: Oh. I am very sorry to hear that.
lines.zh: 哦，听到这个我很难过。

lines.en: So, starting next month you will not read the news.
lines.zh: 所以，从下个月起你不播新闻了。

lines.en: Next month is July. You are firing me in July.
lines.zh: 下个月是七月。您要在七月开除我。

lines.en: No. I am not firing you in July … or in August or in September. That is the good news.
lines.zh: 不，我七月不开除你……八月、九月也不会。这就是好消息。

lines.en: Okay. You are not firing me. I am not reading the news. What will I be doing?
lines.zh: 好吧，您不开除我，我也不播新闻了。那我要做什么？

lines.en: Well, you are good at asking questions. You are good at talking to people. You are good at showing your feelings. And you are great at being silly.
lines.zh: 嗯，你擅长提问，擅长和人聊天，擅长表达感情，而且你特别会搞笑。

lines.en: Thank you, Ms. Weaver. But what does all that mean?
lines.zh: 谢谢您，韦弗女士。可这些是什么意思？

lines.en: I have a new assignment for you! Your skills are perfect for a new show … a children's show.
lines.zh: 我给你安排了新任务！你的这些本事正适合一个新节目……儿童节目。

lines.en: A children's show ... That is awesome! When do I start?
lines.zh: 儿童节目……太棒了！我什么时候开始？

lines.en: You start next month. Start thinking of ideas for the show.
lines.zh: 下个月开始。开始想想节目的点子吧。

lines.en: I have tons of ideas! I can show children what it's like in outer space ...
lines.zh: 我有一大堆点子！我可以带孩子们看看外太空是什么样……

lines.en: Great …
lines.zh: 很好……

lines.en: … or in the deep, dark ocean …
lines.zh: ……或者深邃黑暗的海底……

lines.en: Those are great ideas, Anna. Please go think of more … at your desk.
lines.zh: 这些点子都很好，安娜。请回你的座位……再多想一些。

lines.en: Yes. What other things can I show them? Mt. Everest! Everyone has different skills. You have skills. I have skills. The important thing is to know what you are good at. Until next time!
lines.zh: 好的。我还能给他们看什么？珠穆朗玛峰！每个人都有不同的本事。你有，我也有。重要的是知道自己擅长什么。下次见！

qs.q: Why is Anna walking to work?
qs.why: "But today it's closed. So, I am walking to work."

qs.q: What is the bad news?
opts: She is not good at reading the news.
qs.a: She is not good at reading the news.
qs.why: "you are not good at reading the news."

qs.q: What is Anna's new job?
qs.why: "a new show … a children's show."

lessons.title: What Can You Do?
lessons.zh: 你会做什么？帮皮特找工作

lines.en: Hi, there! Washington, D.C. is a great place to work. Many people here work in government and politics. But there are many other jobs. You can work at a hospital; a university. You can work in a coffee shop. Wait a minute, I think I see a friend of mine. Pete? Is that you?
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！华盛顿是个工作的好地方。这里很多人在政府和政界工作，不过也有很多别的工作。你可以在医院、大学工作，也可以在咖啡店工作。等一下，我好像看到一个朋友。皮特？是你吗？

lines.en: Hi, Anna.
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。

lines.en: You look different. Your beard … is really big.
lines.zh: 你看起来不一样了。你的胡子……好大啊。

lines.en: You don't like it, do you?
lines.zh: 你不喜欢，对吧？

lines.en: No, no. You just look … different.
lines.zh: 不，不是。你只是看起来……不一样。

lines.en: (To server) Thank you. So, what's wrong? You look sad.
lines.zh: （对服务员）谢谢。那么，怎么了？你看起来很难过。

lines.en: I don't have a job.
lines.zh: 我没有工作。

lines.en: Sorry, I can't hear you.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我没听清。

lines.en: I do not have a job!
lines.zh: 我没有工作！

lines.en: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that, Pete.
lines.zh: 哦，听到这个我很难过，皮特。

lines.en: I don't have a skill.
lines.zh: 我没有一技之长。

lines.en: Everyone has a skill. You need to find yours.
lines.zh: 每个人都有一技之长，你得找到你的。

lines.en: I don't know, Anna.
lines.zh: 我不知道，安娜。

lines.en: Pete, I am good at asking questions. Let me ask you some.
lines.zh: 皮特，我很会提问。让我问你几个问题。

lines.en: Really, Anna? Can you help me?
lines.zh: 真的吗，安娜？你能帮我吗？

lines.en: Yes, I can. Let me help.
lines.zh: 能，让我来帮你。

lines.en: Sure, Anna. Maybe you can help.
lines.zh: 好吧，安娜，也许你能帮上忙。

lines.en: Can you write code?
lines.zh: 你会写代码吗？

lines.en: Sure, c-o-l-d. How is this going to help?
lines.zh: 当然，c-o-l-d（冷）。这有什么用？

lines.en: No, not "cold." Code; you know, for making phone apps, or websites. You can make tons of money writing code.
lines.zh: 不是“冷”，是代码，就是用来做手机应用或网站的。写代码能赚很多钱。

lines.en: Tons of money? But I can't code.
lines.zh: 很多钱？可我不会写代码。

lines.en: Next question. Can you drive?
lines.zh: 下一个问题。你会开车吗？

lines.en: Do you mean drive a race car? It's really hard to be a race car driver. First, you need a race car ...
lines.zh: 你是说开赛车？当赛车手可难了。首先你得有辆赛车……

lines.en: No, I mean drive a taxi or drive a bus.
lines.zh: 不，我是说开出租车或开公交车。

lines.en: No, I always fall asleep when I drive.
lines.zh: 不会，我一开车就睡着。

lines.en: Oh, that's not good. Next question. Can you teach? You can be a teacher in a school.
lines.zh: 哦，那可不好。下一个问题。你会教书吗？你可以去学校当老师。

lines.en: No, I cannot teach.
lines.zh: 不，我不会教书。

lines.en: Can you cook? You can be a chef in a restaurant.
lines.zh: 你会做饭吗？你可以去餐厅当厨师。

lines.en: No, I can't code! I can't teach! I can't cook! Anna, I can't do anything. This is sad. I'm gonna write about my feelings in my blog.
lines.zh: 不，我不会写代码！不会教书！不会做饭！安娜，我什么都不会。真难过。我要把我的感受写到我的博客里。

lines.en: You write a blog?
lines.zh: 你写博客？

lines.en: Yeah, I write a blog.
lines.zh: 是啊，我写博客。

lines.en: How many followers do you have?
lines.zh: 你有多少粉丝？

lines.en: I don't know … 59,538.
Pete, that's a lot of followers! You can make money writing!
lines.zh: 皮特，那是很多粉丝！你可以靠写作赚钱！

lines.en: Writing is easy. Everyone can write.
lines.zh: 写作很容易，谁都会写。

lines.en: Not everyone can write well. You can be a writer!
lines.zh: 不是谁都能写得好。你可以当作家！

lines.en: I can be a writer. I can be a writer! I can be a writer! Thanks, Anna.
lines.zh: 我可以当作家。我可以当作家！我可以当作家！谢谢你，安娜。

lines.en: Hi, Pete. Hi, Anna.
lines.zh: 嗨，皮特。嗨，安娜。

lines.en: Hi, Marsha. Excuse me, I have to go.
lines.zh: 嗨，玛莎。不好意思，我得走了。

lines.en: Where are you going?
lines.zh: 你去哪儿？

lines.en: I'm going to be a writer!
lines.zh: 我要去当作家！

lines.en: Good luck, Pete!
lines.zh: 祝你好运，皮特！

lines.en: (To Anna) He does know that it's not easy to be a writer, doesn't he?
lines.zh: （对安娜）他知道当作家不容易的，对吧？

lines.en: There are many different jobs you can have in Washington, D.C. Pete wants to be a writer. I wish him luck. Lots of luck. Until next time!
lines.zh: 在华盛顿，你可以做很多不同的工作。皮特想当作家，我祝他好运，非常好的运气。下次见！

qs.q: What is Pete's problem?
qs.why: "I do not have a job!"

qs.q: Why can't Pete drive a bus?
opts: He falls asleep when he drives.
qs.a: He falls asleep when he drives.
qs.why: "I always fall asleep when I drive."

qs.q: What job does Pete want at the end?
qs.why: "I'm going to be a writer!"

lessons.title: Can You Come to the Party?
lessons.zh: 你能来参加派对吗？安娜想表演节目

lines.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has some great coffee shops. My favorite is this one -- Busboys & Poets.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！华盛顿有不少很棒的咖啡店，我最喜欢这家——Busboys & Poets。

lines.en: Actually it's more than a coffee shop. It's also a bookstore, a restaurant and a theater!
lines.zh: 其实它不只是咖啡店，还是书店、餐厅和剧场！

lines.en: Marsha and I love coming here.
lines.zh: 玛莎和我都爱来这儿。

lines.en: Hey, Anna, my friend is having a party on Saturday. Can you come with me?
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜，我朋友周六办派对。你能和我一起去吗？

lines.en: Sorry, I can't come with you. I have to get my driver's license.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我去不了。我得去考驾照。

lines.en: Will you be busy all day?
lines.zh: 你一整天都忙吗？

lines.en: I don't know. First, I have to take a test on the computer. Then I have to take a test in the car.
lines.zh: 不知道。先要在电脑上考笔试，然后还要上车考路考。

lines.en: But you have to take the test during the day, don't you?
lines.zh: 可你是白天考试，对吧？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: The party is at night.
lines.zh: 派对是晚上。

lines.en: Oh. Then I can come with you to the party on Saturday night.
lines.zh: 哦，那我周六晚上可以和你一起去派对。

lines.en: Great! I have to help my friend with the party. Can you help me?
lines.zh: 太好了！我得帮朋友张罗派对。你能帮我吗？

lines.en: Sure. That sounds like fun.
lines.zh: 当然，听起来很好玩。

lines.en: Everyone has to bring something or do something. You can bring food, or you can perform.
lines.zh: 每个人都得带点东西或者做点什么。你可以带吃的，也可以表演节目。

lines.en: Really, I can perform?
lines.zh: 真的？我可以表演？

lines.en: You can! Can you?
lines.zh: 可以！你会什么？

lines.en: Yes! I can recite poetry. (Anna is in a club reciting a poem)
lines.zh: 会！我会朗诵诗。（安娜在俱乐部朗诵诗）

lines.en: - A poem -
lines.zh: ——一首诗——

lines.en: Light dark
lines.zh: 光 暗

lines.en: Light dark
lines.zh: 光 暗

lines.en: Darkness
lines.zh: 黑暗

lines.en: Dark
lines.zh: 暗

lines.en: In this country, nobody recites poetry at parties. Um … can you do anything else?
lines.zh: 在这个国家，没人在派对上朗诵诗。嗯……你还会别的吗？

lines.en: Hmm, yes. I can do a card trick. (Anna is doing a card trick)
lines.zh: 嗯，会。我会变扑克牌魔术。（安娜在变魔术）

lines.en: Your card is the 10 of diamonds! No?
lines.zh: 你的牌是方块 10！不是？

lines.en: Pick a card. Any card.
lines.zh: 抽一张牌，随便哪张。

lines.en: Here, just pick this one.
lines.zh: 来，就抽这张吧。

lines.en: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: Anna, maybe you can just bring food.
lines.zh: 安娜，也许你还是带吃的吧。

lines.en: No, I can't cook. And I really want to perform. You know, there is one thing I can do. (Anna plays a song on the ukulele and sings)
lines.zh: 不行，我不会做饭。而且我真的很想表演。你知道吗，有一样我会。（安娜弹尤克里里唱歌）

lines.en: Trouble in mind. I'm blue...
lines.zh: 心里有烦恼，我很忧郁……

lines.en: But I won't be blue always
lines.zh: 但我不会一直忧郁，

lines.en: The sun's gonna shine in my back door some day.
lines.zh: 总有一天阳光会照进我的后门。

lines.en: That's it! You can sing at the party. Now, I have to go shopping for food.
lines.zh: 就是它了！你可以在派对上唱歌。现在我得去买吃的了。

lines.en: Can I help? I'm not busy right now.
lines.zh: 我能帮忙吗？我现在不忙。

lines.en: Sure, let's go!
lines.zh: 当然，走吧！

lines.en: We have to go. I have to help Marsha shop. And I have to practice my song! Trouble in mind. I'm blue...
lines.zh: 我们得走了。我得帮玛莎买东西，还得练习我的歌！心里有烦恼，我很忧郁……

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: Why can't Anna go with Marsha during the day?
opts: She has to get her driver's license.
qs.a: She has to get her driver's license.
qs.why: "I have to get my driver's license."

qs.q: What does Marsha say about reciting poetry?
opts: Nobody does it at parties here.
qs.a: Nobody does it at parties here.
qs.why: "nobody recites poetry at parties."

qs.q: What will Anna do at the party?
qs.why: "You can sing at the party."

lessons.title: Next Summer...
lessons.zh: 明年夏天……策划儿童节目

lines.en: Washington, D.C. has four seasons: winter, spring, summer and autumn or fall. My favorite season is summer because of summer vacation! Hey, that will be a great subject for my new work assignment -- the children's show. I can teach what families in the U.S. do during summer vacation. Today, I'm planning the show with Amelia. This is the first time we are working together. I hope we can work well together. Hi, Amelia!
lines.zh: 华盛顿有四个季节：冬、春、夏、秋（autumn 或 fall）。我最喜欢夏天，因为有暑假！嘿，这正好可以做我新任务——儿童节目的主题。我可以讲讲美国家庭暑假都做什么。今天我和阿米莉亚一起策划节目，这是我们第一次合作，希望合作愉快。嗨，阿米莉亚！

lines.en: Hi, Anna! So, what are we going to talk about on the first show?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！那第一期节目我们聊什么？

lines.en: I want to talk about summer vacation.
lines.zh: 我想聊暑假。

lines.en: That will be fun! Are you going on vacation this summer?
lines.zh: 那会很有意思！你今年夏天去度假吗？

lines.en: No. This summer I am too busy.
lines.zh: 不去，今年夏天我太忙了。

lines.en: That's too bad.
lines.zh: 真遗憾。

lines.en: It's okay. I can go on vacation next summer. This show will be a lot of fun too!
lines.zh: 没关系，我可以明年夏天去度假。这个节目也会很好玩！

lines.en: So, Anna, what's the plan for the show?
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，节目怎么安排？

lines.en: First, we're going to introduce the subject. Then we can show pictures and video.
lines.zh: 首先，我们介绍主题，然后放照片和视频。

lines.en: We can show tons of video!
lines.zh: 我们可以放好多视频！

lines.en: Right! We can interview children and have guests, too.
lines.zh: 对！我们还可以采访孩子、请嘉宾。

lines.en: Kids can ask us questions.
lines.zh: 孩子们可以向我们提问。

lines.en: Great idea! Finally, we can read the questions and tell them where to learn more.
lines.zh: 好主意！最后，我们可以读出问题，再告诉他们去哪儿了解更多。

lines.en: Okay, let's try it!
lines.zh: 好，我们试一次！

lines.en: Let's do it!
lines.zh: 开始吧！

lines.en: Hi there! And welcome to … Amelia, we don't have a name for the show.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！欢迎收看……阿米莉亚，我们的节目还没有名字。

lines.en: We'll think of a name later. For now, we'll call it "The Show."
lines.zh: 名字以后再想。现在就先叫它“节目”吧。

lines.en: Great. Hi there! And welcome to "The Show."
lines.zh: 好。嗨，大家好！欢迎收看《节目》。

lines.en: Today we are going to take you on a summer vacation! You will see popular things to do on vacation!
lines.zh: 今天我们带你去过暑假！你会看到度假时最受欢迎的活动！

lines.en: One is camping. When you go camping, you cook, sleep and play outdoors!
lines.zh: 其中一个是露营。露营时，你在户外做饭、睡觉、玩耍！

lines.en: When I go camping, Anna, I like to go hiking and fishing.
lines.zh: 安娜，我去露营时喜欢徒步和钓鱼。

lines.en: Me, too. Those are fun things to do when you go camping!
lines.zh: 我也是。那些都是露营时好玩的事！

lines.en: These people are hiking.
lines.zh: 这些人在徒步。

lines.en: Okay, let's talk about the next vacation.
lines.zh: 好，我们聊下一种度假。

lines.en: Another popular summer vacation is going to an amusement park. At an amusement park, you go on rides and eat lots of fun food!
lines.zh: 另一种很受欢迎的暑假活动是去游乐园。在游乐园你可以玩各种游乐设施，吃很多好吃的！

lines.en: I love cotton candy … !
lines.zh: 我爱棉花糖……！

lines.en: and rollercoasters!
lines.zh: 还有过山车！

lines.en: This show is going to be a lot of fun.
lines.zh: 这个节目会很好玩的。

lines.en: I know!
lines.zh: 可不是嘛！

lines.en: This is riding a rollercoaster!
lines.zh: 这就是坐过山车！

lines.en: Whoooo! What is the last vacation?
lines.zh: 呜呼！最后一种度假是什么？

lines.en: One of the most popular vacations is … going to the beach!
lines.zh: 最受欢迎的度假之一是……去海滩！

lines.en: I love the beach!
lines.zh: 我爱海滩！

lines.en: When I see that blue ocean, I want to leave Washington, D.C. immediately and go to the beach!
lines.zh: 我一看到那片蓝色的大海，就想马上离开华盛顿去海滩！

lines.en: Maybe next summer.
lines.zh: 也许明年夏天吧。

lines.en: But right now, it's time to work!
lines.zh: 不过现在，该工作了！

lines.en: Right. Until next time ...
lines.zh: 没错。下次见……

qs.q: Why isn't Anna going on vacation this summer?
qs.why: "This summer I am too busy."

qs.q: What do they call the show for now?
qs.why: "For now, we'll call it 'The Show.'"

qs.q: Which is NOT a vacation on the show?
qs.why: 节目里讲了露营、游乐园和海滩，没有滑雪。

lessons.title: What Do You Want?
lessons.zh: 你想要什么？在美食车上环游世界

lines.en: Washington, D.C. has great food from all over the world.
lines.zh: 华盛顿有来自世界各地的美食。

lines.en: Today I'm having lunch with my boss. Ms. Weaver says we're going on a trip around the world. But she knows I only have an hour for lunch! Silly woman.
lines.zh: 今天我和上司一起吃午饭。韦弗女士说我们要来一趟环球旅行，可她知道我午饭只有一个小时！真逗。

lines.en: Hi, Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！

lines.en: Hi Jonathan! Hey, we are meeting Ms. Weaver for lunch at noon, aren't we?
lines.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！嘿，我们中午十二点要和韦弗女士吃午饭，对吧？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: What time is it now?
lines.zh: 现在几点？

lines.en: 11:50! We have to go!
lines.zh: 11 点 50！我们得走了！

lines.en: So, where is this world food restaurant?
lines.zh: 那么，这家世界美食餐厅在哪儿？

lines.en: We're not eating at a restaurant.
lines.zh: 我们不去餐厅吃。

lines.en: Where are we eating?
lines.zh: 那我们在哪儿吃？

lines.en: We are eating at ... food trucks!
lines.zh: 我们去……美食车吃！

lines.en: Food trucks … awesome! What's a food truck?
lines.zh: 美食车……太棒了！什么是美食车？

lines.en: These are food trucks!
lines.zh: 这些就是美食车！

lines.en: Wow!
lines.zh: 哇！

lines.en: Whoa!
lines.zh: 哇哦！

lines.en: Okay, Jonathan, you will buy the first dish. Here is $10. Surprise us!
lines.zh: 好，乔纳森，你买第一道菜。给你 10 美元，给我们个惊喜！

lines.en: Okay, I'll be back in 15 minutes.
lines.zh: 好，我 15 分钟后回来。

lines.en: What country do I want to visit?
lines.zh: 我想去哪个国家呢？

lines.en: Anna, you pick the second country. Here is $10.
lines.zh: 安娜，你选第二个国家。给你 10 美元。

lines.en: I want chicken.
lines.zh: 我想吃鸡肉。

lines.en: The food truck, over there, has great chicken.
lines.zh: 那边那辆美食车的鸡肉很棒。

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: After you buy your food, meet me here.
lines.zh: 买完吃的就回这儿找我。

lines.en: Excuse me, I'll have the shrimp.
lines.zh: 你好，我要虾。

lines.en: Oh, you're out of shrimp. Okay, I'll have the beef then.
lines.zh: 哦，虾卖完了。好吧，那我要牛肉。

lines.en: Hello. I want the chicken dish.
lines.zh: 你好，我要那道鸡肉。

lines.en: We're out of chicken.
lines.zh: 鸡肉卖完了。

lines.en: You're out of chicken.
lines.zh: 鸡肉卖完了。

lines.en: Yep.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: I'll try another food truck. Thanks!
lines.zh: 我去别的美食车看看。谢谢！

lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.zh: 不客气。

lines.en: Okay, here is your change. The dish is $7. So, here is 1, 2, 3 dollars back from your 10.
lines.zh: 好，这是找您的零钱。这道菜 7 美元，所以从 10 美元里找您 1、2、3 美元。

lines.en: Great.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.en: Where's Anna? Is she dancing by that food truck?
lines.zh: 安娜呢？她在那辆美食车旁边跳舞吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, she is.
lines.zh: 是的，是的，她在跳。

lines.en: Ms. Weaver, here is your change. The dish costs $5. So - $5 back.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士，这是找您的零钱。这道菜 5 美元，所以找您 5 美元。

lines.en: Thanks, Anna. But where is the food?
lines.zh: 谢谢，安娜。可吃的呢？

lines.en: I'm eating it. The Peruvian chicken is delicious! Try some!
lines.zh: 我在吃呢。秘鲁烤鸡太好吃了！尝尝！

lines.en: (Caty and Jonathan shake their heads "no")
lines.zh: （凯蒂和乔纳森摇头说“不要”）

lines.en: Well, we still have $8! What do you want now?
lines.zh: 嗯，我们还剩 8 美元！现在你想要什么？

lines.en: We can buy dessert!
lines.zh: 我们可以买甜点！

lines.en: I'll buy dessert.
lines.zh: 甜点我来买。

lines.en: In Washington, D.C., you can travel around the world … with food trucks! And it does not cost a lot.
lines.zh: 在华盛顿，你可以靠美食车……环游世界！而且花不了多少钱。

lines.en: Until next time!
lines.zh: 下次见！

qs.q: Where do they eat lunch?
qs.why: "We are eating at ... food trucks!"

qs.q: How much is Jonathan's dish?
qs.why: "The dish is $7."

qs.q: What does Anna buy?
qs.why: "The Peruvian chicken is delicious!"

lessons.title: Yesterday Was Amazing!
lessons.zh: 昨天太精彩了！给朋友写信

lines.en: Yesterday was the most amazing day. I want to tell my friend back home about it. So, I am writing her a letter!
lines.zh: 昨天是最精彩的一天。我想告诉老家的朋友，所以我在给她写信！

lines.en: Dear Penelope,
lines.zh: 亲爱的佩内洛普：

lines.en: Life in Washington, D.C. is interesting. I see something new every day -- like yesterday. Yesterday started like a usual work day.
lines.zh: 华盛顿的生活很有意思，我每天都能看到新鲜事——比如昨天。昨天开始时就像平常的工作日。

lines.en: I said, "Yesterday started like a usual work day."
lines.zh: 我说，“昨天开始时就像平常的工作日。”

lines.en: I was at work. And I wanted a break. So, I walked and walked … and walked. Then, I saw something! It was a festival -- a big festival!
lines.zh: （安娜的旁白）我在上班，想休息一下。于是我走啊走……走啊走。然后，我看到了一样东西！是个节日——一个大型节日！

lines.en: It is the Smithsonian Folklife Festival.
lines.zh: 这是史密森民俗节。

lines.en: Yes. It was the Smithsonian Folklife Festival. Every year the festival shows different cultures. This year one of the cultures was the Basque culture.
lines.zh: （旁白）是的，那是史密森民俗节。这个节日每年展示不同的文化，今年其中一个是巴斯克文化。

lines.en: There was dancing and food and games!"
lines.zh: 有舞蹈、美食和游戏！

lines.en: I am dancing a traditional Basque dance.
lines.zh: 我在跳传统的巴斯克舞。

lines.en: At the festival, I danced a traditional Basque dance!
lines.zh: （旁白）在节日上，我跳了传统的巴斯克舞！

lines.en: They are cooking traditional Basque food.
lines.zh: 他们在做传统的巴斯克菜。

lines.en: They cooked a lot of traditional Basque food.
lines.zh: （旁白）他们做了很多传统的巴斯克菜。

lines.en: They are playing a game. It's a kind of handball. What do they call it? They call it pilota!
lines.zh: 他们在玩一种游戏，是一种手球。他们叫它什么？叫 pilota！

lines.en: They played a game with their hands and a small ball. It's a kind of handball. But this game is called pilota.
lines.zh: （旁白）他们用手和一个小球玩游戏，是一种手球，不过这种游戏叫 pilota。

lines.en: This is beautiful! This is traditional Basque art.
lines.zh: 真漂亮！这是传统的巴斯克艺术。

lines.en: They are making a traditional Basque ship. This festival is a lot of fun!
lines.zh: 他们在造一艘传统的巴斯克船。这个节日真好玩！

lines.en: The whole day was a lot of fun!
lines.zh: （旁白）一整天都非常好玩！

lines.en: Who said that? I want to write my friends and tell them about my day!
lines.zh: 谁说的？我要给朋友们写信，告诉他们我这一天！

lines.en: … So, I wanted to tell you about my day! Please, my friend, come visit Washington, D.C. soon. There is a lot to do! Until next time … Anna.
lines.zh: ……所以，我想跟你讲讲我这一天！我的朋友，请快点来华盛顿玩吧。这里有很多事可做！下次再聊……安娜。

qs.q: Who is Anna writing to?
qs.why: "Dear Penelope,"

qs.q: What culture was at the festival this year?
qs.why: "one of the cultures was the Basque culture."

qs.q: What is pilota?
qs.why: "It's a kind of handball... called pilota."

lessons.title: Watch Out!
lessons.zh: 小心！玩手机寻宝游戏学总统

lines.en: Hello from Washington, DC! This city has many monuments and memorials.
lines.zh: 华盛顿向大家问好！这座城市有很多纪念碑和纪念堂。

lines.en: Today I am visiting the ones built in memory of our Presidents: Washington, Jefferson, Lincoln and Roosevelt.
lines.zh: 今天我要参观为纪念总统们修建的那些：华盛顿、杰斐逊、林肯和罗斯福。

lines.en: I want to learn more about them.
lines.zh: 我想多了解他们。

lines.en: Hey! Watch out!
lines.zh: 嘿！小心！

lines.en: Sorry! I didn't see you.
lines.zh: 对不起！我没看见你。

lines.en: You were not looking. You should be more careful.
lines.zh: 你没看路。你应该更小心点。

lines.en: I know I should be more careful. But this game is really fun.
lines.zh: 我知道我应该更小心。可这游戏真的很好玩。

lines.en: What kind of game?
lines.zh: 什么游戏？

lines.en: You have to find things that aren't really there.
lines.zh: 你得找到实际上并不存在的东西。

lines.en: How can you find things that aren't really there?
lines.zh: 怎么能找到实际不存在的东西？

lines.en: They're in your phone. See?
lines.zh: 它们在手机里。看到了吗？

lines.en: I see. It's like a scavenger hunt.
lines.zh: 明白了，就像寻宝游戏。

lines.en: That's right!
lines.zh: 没错！

lines.en: I don't have time for games. I want to learn about U.S. presidents.
lines.zh: 我没时间玩游戏。我想了解美国总统。

lines.en: Then you should play this game! When you find an American symbol, you win points and a Fun Fact about a U.S. President.
lines.zh: 那你应该玩这个游戏！你找到一个美国象征，就能得分，还能得到一条美国总统的趣闻。

lines.en: I have time for this game!
lines.zh: 这个游戏我有时间玩！

lines.en: Here are the symbols that I caught: the Statue of Liberty for 20 points, Uncle Sam for 40 points and the American flag for 60 points.
lines.zh: 这些是我抓到的象征：自由女神像 20 分，山姆大叔 40 分，美国国旗 60 分。

lines.en: What symbol are you looking for now?
lines.zh: 你现在在找什么象征？

lines.en: I am looking for the bald eagle. That is 100 points! It should be near the Washington Monument.
lines.zh: 我在找白头海雕，那可是 100 分！应该就在华盛顿纪念碑附近。

lines.en: This game is awesome.
lines.zh: 这游戏太棒了。

lines.en: You ought to buy the app right now. It's called "Catch Americana."
lines.zh: 你应该现在就下载这个应用，叫“Catch Americana”。

lines.en: Got it. Catch Americana.
lines.zh: 记住了，Catch Americana。

lines.en: Thanks! Good luck!
lines.zh: 谢谢！祝你好运！

lines.en: Good luck to you too!
lines.zh: 也祝你好运！

lines.en: This is the Jefferson Memorial. I know that Thomas Jefferson signed the Declaration of Independence! Now, where is that symbol?
lines.zh: 这是杰斐逊纪念堂。我知道托马斯·杰斐逊签署了《独立宣言》！那么，象征在哪儿呢？

lines.en: Here it is! My first one. It's an American flag! I won 60 points!
lines.zh: 在这儿！我的第一个，是美国国旗！我得了 60 分！

lines.en: An American flag works well for Thomas Jefferson. I see lots of American flags on Independence Day!
lines.zh: 美国国旗和托马斯·杰斐逊很配。独立日那天我能看到很多美国国旗！

lines.en: Where is my Jefferson Fun Fact?
lines.zh: 我的杰斐逊趣闻在哪儿？

lines.en: In his lifetime, Thomas Jefferson wrote about 19,000 letters!
lines.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊一生写了大约 19,000 封信！

lines.en: I did not know that. Where is the next symbol?
lines.zh: 我还真不知道。下一个象征在哪儿？

qs.q: Why does Anna say "Watch out!"?
opts: Dan is not looking where he is going.
qs.a: Dan is not looking where he is going.
qs.why: "You were not looking."

qs.q: How many points is the bald eagle?
qs.why: "I am looking for the bald eagle. That is 100 points!"

qs.q: About how many letters did Thomas Jefferson write?
qs.why: "Thomas Jefferson wrote about 19,000 letters!"

lessons.title: This Game Is Fun!
lessons.zh: 这游戏真好玩！继续找美国象征

lines.en: This is the Roosevelt Memorial. Where is the symbol?
lines.zh: 这是罗斯福纪念堂。象征在哪儿？

lines.en: Anna remembers that Dan said: You have to find things that aren't really there. ... When you find an American symbol, you win points and a Fun Fact about a U.S. President.
lines.zh: 安娜想起丹说过：你得找到实际上并不存在的东西……找到一个美国象征，就能得分，还能得到一条美国总统的趣闻。

lines.en: Yay! I found Uncle Sam and I won another 40 points! What is the Fun Fact?
lines.zh: 耶！我找到了山姆大叔，又得了 40 分！趣闻是什么？

lines.en: Franklin Roosevelt was the first to fly in a plane as president!
lines.zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福是第一位在任时坐飞机的总统！

lines.en: I didn't know that. This is a really beautiful memorial.
lines.zh: 我还真不知道。这座纪念堂真美。

lines.en: This is the Lincoln Memorial! Where is the symbol?
lines.zh: 这是林肯纪念堂！象征在哪儿？

lines.en: I found it! The Statue of Liberty! Please give me my Fun Fact.
lines.zh: 找到了！自由女神像！请给我我的趣闻。

lines.en: Abraham Lincoln was a great wrestler!
lines.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯是个摔跤好手！

lines.en: I didn't know that. Lincoln wanted freedom for all people. So, the Statue of Liberty works well.
lines.zh: 我还真不知道。林肯希望所有人都自由，所以自由女神像很配。

lines.en: And I won 20 points! Time to find the next symbol.
lines.zh: 我还得了 20 分！该找下一个象征了。

lines.en: Hey! Look out!
lines.zh: 嘿！小心！

lines.en: Sorry. Hey, it's you! Now, I should be more careful.
lines.zh: 对不起。嘿，是你！这回该我更小心了。

lines.en: That's okay.
lines.zh: 没关系。

lines.en: This game is a lot of fun. Hey, what's your name?
lines.zh: 这游戏真好玩。嘿，你叫什么名字？

lines.en: Dan. What's yours?
lines.zh: 丹。你呢？

lines.en: Anna.
lines.zh: 安娜。

lines.en: Like Americana!
lines.zh: 就像 Americana！

lines.en: Yeah, I guess so.
lines.zh: 是啊，大概吧。

lines.en: Did you find any symbols?
lines.zh: 你找到象征了吗？

lines.en: Yes, I found three and won 120 points!
lines.zh: 找到了，找到三个，得了 120 分！

lines.en: Me too. But, did you find the bald eagle?
lines.zh: 我也是。不过你找到白头海雕了吗？

lines.en: No. Did you?
lines.zh: 没有。你呢？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: First one to find it wins?
lines.zh: 谁先找到谁赢？

lines.en: Anna, look out for that tree!
lines.zh: 安娜，小心那棵树！

lines.en: I learned a lot about presidents with this game. But I ought to be more careful. Until next time …!
lines.zh: 通过这个游戏，我学到了很多关于总统的知识。不过我真该更小心点。下次见……！

qs.q: Which president was the first to fly in a plane as president?
qs.why: "Franklin Roosevelt was the first to fly in a plane as president!"

qs.q: What fun fact does Anna learn about Lincoln?
qs.why: "Abraham Lincoln was a great wrestler!"

qs.q: How many points does Anna have now?
qs.why: "I found three and won 120 points!"

lessons.title: I Can't Come In
lessons.zh: 我去不了公司：生病请假和看医生

lines.en: Hello! I am sure that today, in Washington, D.C,. there are a lot of great things to do. But I am not doing any of them. I am sick. Right now, I'm going to call my boss and tell her I cannot come in to work.
lines.zh: 你好！我相信今天华盛顿有很多好玩的事，可我一件都做不了。我生病了。现在我要给上司打电话，告诉她我不能去上班。

lines.en: Hello?
lines.zh: 喂？

lines.en: Ms. Weaver, Hi. I can't come to work today.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士，您好。我今天不能去上班了。

lines.en: Why not? What is wrong?
lines.zh: 为什么？怎么了？

lines.en: Well, yesterday I felt fine.
lines.zh: 嗯，昨天我感觉还挺好的。

lines.en: In the morning, I painted for hours. In the afternoon, I cut wood. Then, I built a fire.
lines.zh: 上午我刷了几个小时的漆，下午我劈了木头，然后生了一堆火。

lines.en: Anna, what do you mean? Why can't you come to work today?
lines.zh: 安娜，你在说什么？你今天为什么不能来上班？

lines.en: I do not feel well. I think I'm sick.
lines.zh: 我不舒服，我想我生病了。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. I was sick last week, too. I had the flu.
lines.zh: 听到这个我很难过。我上周也病了，得了流感。

lines.en: (sneezes) What did you do?
lines.zh: （打喷嚏）您是怎么做的？

lines.en: I slept a lot and I drank a lot of water. Do you have a doctor?
lines.zh: 我睡了很多觉，喝了很多水。你有医生吗？

lines.en: Yes, I do.
lines.zh: 有。

lines.en: You should call your doctor. And get lots of rest!
lines.zh: 你应该给医生打电话，还要多休息！

lines.en: Thanks, Ms. Weaver. I'll call right now. I'm calling my doctor.
lines.zh: 谢谢您，韦弗女士。我现在就打。我在给医生打电话。

lines.en: (to herself) Now, where does this thing go?
lines.zh: （自言自语）这东西放哪儿来着？

lines.en: Hello. This is Dr. Bennett. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 你好，我是贝内特医生。有什么可以帮你？

lines.en: Hello, Dr. Bennett. This is Anna.
lines.zh: 您好，贝内特医生，我是安娜。

lines.en: Oh, Hi, Anna. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 哦，嗨，安娜。有什么可以帮你？

lines.en: I think I'm sick.
lines.zh: 我想我生病了。

lines.en: Let me ask you a couple of questions. Do you have a sore throat?
lines.zh: 我问你几个问题。你嗓子疼吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have a sore throat.
lines.zh: 是的，我嗓子疼。

lines.en: Do you have a cough?
lines.zh: 你咳嗽吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have a cough.
lines.zh: 是的，我咳嗽。

lines.en: When did you start feeling sick?
lines.zh: 你什么时候开始不舒服的？

lines.en: This morning. Yesterday I felt great. In the morning I painted, for hours - in the afternoon I cut wood -
lines.zh: 今天早上。昨天我感觉好极了。上午我刷了几个小时漆，下午我劈木头——

lines.en: Excuse me, Anna. But I don't need to know all that. Do you have a fever?
lines.zh: 抱歉，安娜，这些我不需要知道。你发烧吗？

lines.en: Oh. My thermometer says 125 degrees?! What??
lines.zh: 哦。我的体温计显示 125 度？！什么？？

lines.en: Yeah, that's not right.
lines.zh: 嗯，这不对。

lines.en: Oh. Wait. The thermometer was in my hot cup of coffee.
lines.zh: 哦，等等，体温计刚才泡在我的热咖啡里了。

lines.en: Please take it again, Anna.
lines.zh: 请再量一次，安娜。

lines.en: Okay, the thermometer says 100.5 degrees.
lines.zh: 好的，体温计显示 100.5 度。

lines.en: 100.5 degrees is not too high. I want you to drink lots of water. Rest in bed and get lots of sleep.
lines.zh: 100.5 度不算太高。你要多喝水，卧床休息，多睡觉。

lines.en: That is what my boss said to do. Um, Dr. Bennett, when can I go to work?
lines.zh: 我上司也是这么说的。嗯，贝内特医生，我什么时候能去上班？

lines.en: Don't go to work for a couple of days.
lines.zh: 这两天别去上班。

lines.en: Yes! I mean, I don't want to make my co-workers sick.
lines.zh: 好耶！我是说，我不想把同事们传染了。

lines.en: That's right. Call me back in a couple of days.
lines.zh: 没错。过两天再给我打电话。

lines.en: I will, Dr. Bennett. And thanks.
lines.zh: 好的，贝内特医生，谢谢您。

lines.en: Well, you heard the doctor – no work for a couple of days. I need water, sleep and um … lots of movies! Well, the doctor didn't say anything about movies. But it can't hurt! Until next time!
lines.zh: 好啦，你们也听到医生说的了——这两天不用上班。我需要喝水、睡觉，还有嗯……看好多电影！医生可没说电影的事，不过看看也无妨！下次见！

qs.q: What does Anna have?
opts: a sore throat and a cough
qs.a: a sore throat and a cough
qs.why: "I have a sore throat." "I have a cough."

qs.q: Why did the thermometer say 125 degrees?
opts: It was in her hot coffee.
She had a very high fever.
qs.a: It was in her hot coffee.
qs.why: "The thermometer was in my hot cup of coffee."

qs.q: What does the doctor tell Anna to do?
qs.why: "drink lots of water. Rest in bed and get lots of sleep."

lessons.title: I Passed It!
lessons.zh: 我考过了！驾照考试

lines.en: Hello! Guess what this is? This is my driver's license! I passed my driving test!
lines.zh: 你好！猜猜这是什么？这是我的驾照！我通过驾驶考试了！

lines.en: Today, I rented a car so I can drive around Washington, D.C. You can see more of the city this way. Marsha!
lines.zh: 今天我租了辆车，可以开车逛华盛顿了。这样能看到城市的更多地方。玛莎！

lines.en: Anna, did you get your driver's license?
lines.zh: 安娜，你拿到驾照了？

lines.en: I did! But it was not easy.
lines.zh: 拿到了！不过可不容易。

lines.en: Why? What happened?
lines.zh: 为什么？发生什么了？

lines.en: Well, you know, I can drive farm equipment really well. But I was really nervous driving in Washington, D.C. traffic!
lines.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我开农用机械可熟练了。可在华盛顿的车流里开车，我真的很紧张！

lines.en: Did you pass the test the first time?
lines.zh: 你第一次就考过了吗？

lines.en: Well…no. But I did pass the second time.
lines.zh: 嗯……没有。不过第二次考过了。

lines.en: What happened during the first test?
lines.zh: 第一次考试发生了什么？

lines.en: It started fine.
lines.zh: 开始还挺好的。

lines.en: Okay … Anna. Is your seatbelt buckled?
lines.zh: 好……安娜。安全带系好了吗？

lines.en: Yes, sir!
lines.zh: 系好了，先生！

lines.en: Great. Please start the car.
lines.zh: 很好。请启动车子。

lines.en: (to herself) Okay, Anna, start the car. Started the car. Good job, Anna.
lines.zh: （自言自语）好，安娜，启动车子。启动了。干得好，安娜。

lines.en: Why are you talking to yourself?
lines.zh: 你为什么自言自语？

lines.en: I am a little nervous. When I'm nervous, I talk to myself.
lines.zh: 我有点紧张。我一紧张就自言自语。

lines.en: You don't need to be nervous.
lines.zh: 你不用紧张。

lines.en: Listen to that engine!
lines.zh: 听听这发动机的声音！

lines.en: Please, stop pushing the gas pedal!
lines.zh: 请别再踩油门了！

lines.en: Sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: Okay, when you are ready, turn.
lines.zh: 好，准备好了就转弯。

lines.en: Great!
lines.zh: 好嘞！

lines.en: Not now! You almost hit that car!
lines.zh: 不是现在！你差点撞上那辆车！

lines.en: You said "turn!"
lines.zh: 您说“转弯”的！

lines.en: Look first! There were cars in the street.
lines.zh: 先看路！街上有车。

lines.en: Please don't yell at me!
lines.zh: 请别冲我吼！

lines.en: I'm sorry! I was afraid.
lines.zh: 对不起！我是吓坏了。

lines.en: You were yelling.
lines.zh: 您刚才在吼。

lines.en: Look out for that car! Brake! Brake!!
lines.zh: 小心那辆车！刹车！刹车！！

lines.en: Ahhh!
Why is everyone honking at us?
lines.zh: 为什么大家都冲我们按喇叭？

lines.en: You were driving too slow! Anna, stay on the street!
lines.zh: 你开得太慢了！安娜，别开出马路！

lines.en: Hands on the wheel, Anna.
lines.zh: 手放在方向盘上，安娜。

lines.en: What's that sound?
lines.zh: 那是什么声音？

lines.en: That, Anna, is the police.
lines.zh: 那个，安娜，是警察。

lines.en: That sounds awful.
lines.zh: 听起来太糟了。

lines.en: Yes, it did not go well. But, I practiced and passed the second time!
lines.zh: 是啊，考得很不顺。不过我练习了，第二次就考过了！

lines.en: Do you know where you want to take your first drive in Washington, D.C.?
lines.zh: 你知道第一次在华盛顿开车想去哪儿吗？

lines.en: Yes! Let's go!
lines.zh: 知道！走吧！

lines.en: There it is … the White House!
lines.zh: 到了……白宫！

lines.en: Anna, you do know you can't drive up to the White House, don't you?
lines.zh: 安娜，你知道车不能开到白宫跟前，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. No. I didn't know. I guess we walk from here!
lines.zh: 知道。不，我不知道。看来我们得从这儿走过去了！

lines.en: Sometimes you can see more of Washington, D.C. in a car. If you want to see the White House, you need to walk. Until next time … !
lines.zh: 有时候开车能看到华盛顿的更多地方。如果你想看白宫，就得走路。下次见……！

qs.q: Did Anna pass the test the first time?
opts: No, she passed the second time.
qs.a: No, she passed the second time.
qs.why: "But I did pass the second time."

qs.q: What does Anna do when she is nervous?
qs.why: "When I'm nervous, I talk to myself."

qs.q: Where do they want to go on their first drive?
qs.why: "There it is … the White House!"

lessons.title: A Long Time Ago
lessons.zh: 很久以前：童年的梦想

lines.en: Hello! In Washington, D.C., there are many places that bring history to life. But people who live here often do not have time to see them. They are too busy with work -- like me. Hi, Marsha!
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿有很多让历史活起来的地方，可住在这儿的人常常没时间去看，他们工作太忙了——就像我。嗨，玛莎！

lines.en: Hi, Anna! Have a seat.
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！坐吧。

lines.en: Thanks. This was a good idea. Working outdoors is nice.
lines.zh: 谢谢。这主意真好，在户外工作挺舒服的。

lines.en: Um-hum, it is.
lines.zh: 嗯，是啊。

lines.en: I am tired. Today was a busy day at work. And I still have work to do!
lines.zh: 我好累。今天上班很忙，可我还有活要干！

lines.en: Hmm, that's too bad.
lines.zh: 嗯，真糟糕。

lines.en: How are you these days?
lines.zh: 你最近怎么样？

lines.en: I'm really busy too, Anna. Let's get to work.
lines.zh: 我也很忙，安娜。我们开始干活吧。

lines.en: Marsha, look! That bus has a photo of Abraham Lincoln!
lines.zh: 玛莎，看！那辆公交车上有亚伯拉罕·林肯的照片！

lines.en: That's an advertisement for Ford's Theatre. They have a new show.
lines.zh: 那是福特剧院的广告，他们有部新剧。
