lines.en: They have shows where Abraham Lincoln died?
lines.zh: 林肯遇害的地方还在演戏？

lines.en: Yeah, it's a working theater and a museum.
lines.zh: 是啊，那既是一家照常营业的剧院，也是博物馆。

lines.en: I love Lincoln. You know, Marsha, that advertisement reminds me of something.
lines.zh: 我爱林肯。你知道吗，玛莎，那个广告让我想起一件事。

lines.en: Um-hum. What's that?
lines.zh: 嗯，什么事？

lines.en: When I was a little girl … When I was a little girl … I was not like other children.
lines.zh: 我小时候……我小时候……和别的孩子不一样。

lines.en: Um-hum, I can believe that.
lines.zh: 嗯，这我信。

lines.en: I was a tall, serious child. At the playground the other children played silly games. They played with dart guns. They played on the swings, the slide and the teeter-totter. They also played ball But not me. I loved to read serious books about U.S. presidents.
lines.zh: （安娜的旁白）我是个高个子、很严肃的孩子。在游乐场，别的孩子玩些傻游戏：玩飞镖枪，荡秋千，滑滑梯，玩跷跷板，还玩球。可我不玩。我爱读关于美国总统的严肃的书。

lines.en: In fact, I wanted to be … don't laugh … President of the United States.
lines.zh: 说实话，我想当……别笑……美国总统。

lines.en: (laughs)
Stop! I know it's a silly childhood dream.
lines.zh: 别笑了！我知道这是个傻乎乎的童年梦想。

lines.en: I'm sorry. It's not silly. Guess what I wanted to be?
lines.zh: 对不起，这不傻。猜猜我小时候想当什么？

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: I wanted to be... an astronaut.
lines.zh: 我想当……宇航员。

lines.en: Really?
lines.zh: 真的？

lines.en: When I was a kid, I studied the stars and planets. I wanted to fly into outer space!
lines.zh: （玛莎的旁白）我小时候研究星星和行星，想飞到外太空去！

lines.en: You know, Marsha, childhood dreams are really important.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，玛莎，童年的梦想真的很重要。

lines.en: They are. And it's good to remember them.
lines.zh: 是啊，记住它们是件好事。

lines.en: Hey! I have an idea. Let's go.
lines.zh: 嘿！我有个主意。走吧。

lines.en: Go where?
lines.zh: 去哪儿？

lines.en: Let's go make our childhood dreams come true.
lines.zh: 我们去实现童年的梦想。

lines.en: We're going to the Air & Space Museum! Yes!
lines.zh: 我们要去航空航天博物馆！太好了！

lines.en: No. We're going to see a show at Ford's Theatre just like Abraham Lincoln did when he died! It's not far from here.
lines.zh: 不是。我们要去福特剧院看戏，就像亚伯拉罕·林肯遇害那天一样！离这儿不远。

lines.en: Uh huh. That is your childhood dream.
lines.zh: 呃，那是你的童年梦想。

lines.en: Good point. Okay, next week, we'll come here and be astronauts.
lines.zh: 说得对。好吧，下周我们来这儿当宇航员。

lines.en: Honestly?
lines.zh: 真的？

lines.en: Honestly.
lines.zh: 真的。

lines.en: Tonight we are seeing a show at Ford's Theatre, where a man shot President Abraham Lincoln. This is history come to life … and a childhood dream come true! Until next time ...
lines.zh: 今晚我们在福特剧院看戏，就是林肯总统中枪的地方。这是让历史活起来……也是实现童年的梦想！下次见……

qs.q: What did Anna want to be as a child?
qs.why: "I wanted to be … President of the United States."

qs.q: What did Marsha want to be?
qs.why: "I wanted to be... an astronaut."

qs.q: Where do they go tonight?
qs.why: "Tonight we are seeing a show at Ford's Theatre."

lessons.title: Rolling on the River
lessons.zh: 在河上漂：去海鲜市场买菜

lines.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. sits on the Potomac River. This river is important to the history and culture of the city. Today, I am at an outdoor seafood market near the Potomac River. Some say it is the oldest outdoor seafood market in the United States! I am here to buy seafood. Let's see what they have!
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿坐落在波托马克河畔，这条河对这座城市的历史和文化很重要。今天我在波托马克河边的一个露天海鲜市场，有人说这是美国最古老的露天海鲜市场！我来这儿买海鲜，看看有什么吧！

lines.en: Excuse me. Can you help me?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，能帮我个忙吗？

lines.en: Sure! What do you need?
lines.zh: 当然！你需要什么？

lines.en: Pete!
lines.zh: 皮特！

lines.en: Anna!
lines.zh: 安娜！

lines.en: What are you doing here?
lines.zh: 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: I work here. You know, it's not easy to be a writer.
lines.zh: 我在这儿工作。你知道，当作家可不容易。

lines.en: Yeah, I heard that. Sorry.
lines.zh: 是啊，我听说了。真遗憾。

lines.en: But this job is great. I work outside by the river. And I can eat all the free seafood I want!
lines.zh: 不过这份工作很棒。我在河边的户外工作，海鲜还能随便免费吃！

lines.en: That is great, Pete. In fact, I am here to buy some seafood for my dinner party.
lines.zh: 那太好了，皮特。其实我是来给我的晚宴买海鲜的。

lines.en: You came to the right place. They have the freshest seafood in town. How much money can you spend?
lines.zh: 你来对地方了，这儿的海鲜是全城最新鲜的。你能花多少钱？

lines.en: I can only spend $50.
lines.zh: 我只能花 50 美元。

lines.en: Okay. What do you want?
lines.zh: 好。你想要什么？

lines.en: First, I want to buy some shrimp.
lines.zh: 首先，我想买些虾。

lines.en: Sure thing. Follow me. How much shrimp do you want?
lines.zh: 没问题，跟我来。你要多少虾？

lines.en: How much do I need for five people?
lines.zh: 五个人需要多少？

lines.en: (yells to co-worker) Give her a pound of shrimp!
lines.zh: （对同事喊）给她来一磅虾！

lines.en: Ok, now I want to buy some crabs.
lines.zh: 好，现在我想买些螃蟹。

lines.en: The crabs here are delicious! They are the best because they come from the nearby Chesapeake Bay! Walk this way.
lines.zh: 这里的螃蟹很好吃！是最好的，因为都来自附近的切萨皮克湾！这边走。

lines.en: How many crabs do you want?
lines.zh: 你要多少螃蟹？

lines.en: I want a dozen crabs.
lines.zh: 我要一打螃蟹。

lines.en: You should get the larger crabs. They have the most meat.
lines.zh: 你应该买大一点的螃蟹，肉最多。

lines.en: Then I want a dozen large crabs, please!
lines.zh: 那我要一打大螃蟹，谢谢！

lines.en: Is that everything you need?
lines.zh: 你需要的都齐了吗？

lines.en: Let's see … I have shrimp and crabs. And a friend is bringing a salad and many ears of corn-on-the-cob.
lines.zh: 我看看……我有虾和螃蟹。一个朋友会带沙拉和好多根玉米。

lines.en: Is that all the seafood that you need?
lines.zh: 海鲜就要这些吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: That'll be $49.95. Cash or credit?
lines.zh: 一共 49.95 美元。现金还是刷卡？

lines.en: Credit, please.
lines.zh: 刷卡，谢谢。

lines.en: Anna, you love to eat seafood. Did you grow up on the water?
lines.zh: 安娜，你爱吃海鲜。你是在水边长大的吗？

lines.en: No, I didn't. But I love the water. And I love being on the water.
lines.zh: 不是。不过我爱水，也爱待在水上。

lines.en: You know how to sail?
lines.zh: 你会开帆船？

lines.en: Well … this afternoon I am going on a boat.
lines.zh: 嗯……今天下午我要去坐船。

lines.en: You are full of surprises. What kind of boat? Is it a motorboat or a sailboat?
lines.zh: 你真是处处让人惊喜。什么船？摩托艇还是帆船？

lines.en: It's a special boat, Pete. Well, thanks for your help. See you later!
lines.zh: 是一种特别的船，皮特。好了，谢谢你帮忙。回头见！

lines.en: See you, Anna! Wow, Anna's a sailor! Who knew?
lines.zh: 回头见，安娜！哇，安娜是个水手！谁想得到呢？

lines.en: Yes, rivers are important to the history and culture of Washington, D.C. And now I am part of this city's interesting waterfront culture. Until next time!
lines.zh: 是的，河流对华盛顿的历史和文化很重要。现在我也成了这座城市有趣的滨水文化的一部分。下次见！

qs.q: Why is Pete working at the market?
opts: It's not easy to be a writer.
qs.a: It's not easy to be a writer.
qs.why: "You know, it's not easy to be a writer."

qs.q: How much does Anna spend?
qs.why: "That'll be $49.95."

qs.q: Where do the crabs come from?
qs.why: "they come from the nearby Chesapeake Bay!"

lessons.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
lessons.zh: 带我去看棒球赛：怎么去最快？

lines.en: Hi, there, sports fans! Baseball is America's sport. Today, I am going to Nationals Park. It is home to Washington, D.C.'s baseball team -- the Washington Nationals!
lines.zh: 嗨，体育迷们！棒球是美国的国民运动。今天我要去国民公园球场，那是华盛顿棒球队——华盛顿国民队的主场！

lines.en: Hi, Jonathan!
lines.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！

lines.en: Hi, Anna! Where are you going?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！你去哪儿？

lines.en: I am taking a bus to a Nationals baseball game!
lines.zh: 我要坐公交去看国民队的棒球赛！

lines.en: Don't take the bus. A taxi is faster than a bus.
lines.zh: 别坐公交，出租车比公交快。

lines.en: Oh, good idea. You know I love baseball.
lines.zh: 哦，好主意。你知道我爱棒球。

lines.en: That's great. Have fun.
lines.zh: 那太好了，玩得开心。

lines.en: In fact, I wanted to be a baseball player.
lines.zh: 说实话，我以前想当棒球运动员。

lines.en: Is this one of your memories? I'm really busy.
lines.zh: 这是你又一段回忆吗？我真的很忙。

lines.en: This won't take long. I can see it now... I am at home plate. I wait for the pitch. The ball comes. I swing. It's a hit! I run to first base, second base, third base, then home plate. It's a home run! The crowd cheers! Woo hoo!
lines.zh: 不会很久的。我能想象出来……我站在本垒，等着投球。球来了，我挥棒，击中了！我跑向一垒、二垒、三垒，然后回到本垒。全垒打！观众欢呼！呜呼！

lines.en: You really love baseball. Have fun at the game, Anna.
lines.zh: 你真爱棒球。看球玩得开心，安娜。

lines.en: Thanks, Jonathan. Taxi!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，乔纳森。出租车！

lines.en: Hi, Anna. Where are you going?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜，你去哪儿？

lines.en: Hi, Ashley. I am going to see a Nationals baseball game!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉。我要去看国民队的棒球赛！

lines.en: What time is the game?
lines.zh: 比赛几点？

lines.en: 7 o'clock.
Do you have a ticket?
lines.zh: 你有票吗？

lines.en: No, not yet.
lines.zh: 还没有。

lines.en: Anna, you should go a lot earlier than 7 o'clock.
lines.zh: 安娜，你应该比 7 点早得多去。

lines.en: That is why I'm taking a taxi. Taxi!
lines.zh: 所以我才打出租车啊。出租车！

lines.en: Anna, Anna, that's not a good idea. A bicycle is faster than a taxi.
lines.zh: 安娜，安娜，这可不是好主意。自行车比出租车快。

lines.en: Oh, Ashley. Ashley, Ashley, Ashley. A car is faster than your bicycle.
lines.zh: 哦，阿什莉，阿什莉，阿什莉，阿什莉。汽车比你的自行车快。

lines.en: In D.C. traffic sometimes a bicycle is faster than a car. And right now, there is a lot of traffic.
lines.zh: 在华盛顿的车流里，有时自行车比汽车快。现在路上正堵得厉害。

lines.en: Good point. But I don't have a bicycle.
lines.zh: 有道理。可我没有自行车。

lines.en: Okay, Anna, you can use my bicycle.
lines.zh: 好吧，安娜，你可以用我的自行车。

lines.en: Thanks! I really want to learn how to ride one.
lines.zh: 谢谢！我真想学学怎么骑。

lines.en: What do you mean, learn how to ride a bike? Oh, Anna! Anna, Anna!
lines.zh: 什么叫学怎么骑自行车？哦，安娜！安娜，安娜！

lines.en: You know, Anna, the Metro is faster than a taxi and a bicycle. You ought to take the Metro. It's that way.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，地铁比出租车和自行车都快。你应该坐地铁，往那边走。

lines.en: Good idea.
lines.zh: 好主意。

lines.en: OK.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: See you later!
lines.zh: 回头见！

lines.en: Bye, Anna!
lines.zh: 拜拜，安娜！

lines.en: Bye!
lines.zh: 拜拜！

lines.en: The Metro was a lot faster than a bus, taxi or bike. And now I'm at Nationals Park! Look at all these fans! So many people like to watch baseball. There's the ticket window. What? The tickets are sold out? Nooooooo! Nooooooo! But I really want to watch a baseball game. Does anyone have an extra ticket?
lines.zh: 地铁比公交、出租车或自行车都快多了。现在我到国民公园球场了！看这么多球迷！好多人喜欢看棒球。那是售票窗口。什么？票卖完了？不——！不——！可我真的很想看棒球赛。有人有多余的票吗？

lines.en: Next time, you should buy your ticket online.
lines.zh: 下次你应该网上买票。

lines.en: Thanks. Thanks a lot. It is good advice. Being early is better than being late. Until next time …
lines.zh: 谢谢，太谢谢了。这是个好建议。早到总比晚到好。下次见……

qs.q: Which is the fastest way to the game?
qs.why: "The Metro was a lot faster than a bus, taxi or bike."

qs.q: What time is the game?
qs.why: "7 o'clock."

qs.q: Why can't Anna buy a ticket?
qs.why: "The tickets are sold out?"

lessons.title: Welcome to the Treehouse!
lessons.zh: 欢迎来到树屋！儿童节目第一集

lines.en: Hello! Today is a big day. My first children's show is on television! Woo-hoo! I'm excited and nervous.
lines.zh: 你好！今天是个大日子，我的第一期儿童节目要上电视了！呜呼！我又兴奋又紧张。

lines.en: Hello, Anna.
lines.zh: 你好，安娜。

lines.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver!
lines.zh: 您好，韦弗女士！

lines.en: Some people are going to watch your children's show. After they watch it, they'll tell me what they liked, and what they didn't like.
lines.zh: 会有一些人看你的儿童节目。看完后，他们会告诉我喜欢什么、不喜欢什么。

lines.en: Oh, dear.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。

lines.en: They're in the conference room. They're in the conference room.
lines.zh: 他们在会议室，他们在会议室。

lines.en: Hello, everyone. I'm Anna, and thanks for coming!
lines.zh: 大家好，我是安娜，谢谢大家来！

lines.en: Today you are going to watch my new show. I hope you like it
lines.zh: 今天你们要看我的新节目，希望你们喜欢。

lines.en: What is the show about?
lines.zh: 节目讲什么？

lines.en: It's a children's show.
lines.zh: 是个儿童节目。

lines.en: But we are not children!
lines.zh: 可我们不是小孩！

lines.en: This children's show is different. I hope.
lines.zh: 这个儿童节目不一样。希望如此。

lines.en: I don't really like children's shows.
lines.zh: 我不太喜欢儿童节目。

lines.en: Shhh, please. The show is starting!
lines.zh: 嘘，拜托，节目开始了！

lines.en: Oh, hi! Just give me one minute ….oops! Oh well. I can fix that later.
lines.zh: 哦，嗨！给我一分钟……哎呀！算了，那个我以后再修。

lines.en: Hello, I'm Anna! Welcome to "The Time Traveling Treehouse!" This is not a usual treehouse. It can time travel! That is why it's called "The Time Traveling Treehouse."
lines.zh: 你好，我是安娜！欢迎来到《时空旅行树屋》！这可不是一般的树屋，它能穿越时空！所以叫《时空旅行树屋》。

lines.en: Anna, do not forget me.
lines.zh: 安娜，别忘了我。

lines.en: Of course not! This is my partner, MINDY!
lines.zh: 当然不会！这是我的搭档，敏迪！

lines.en: My name means Massive Information Navigation Device, for You!
lines.zh: 我的名字意思是“为你服务的超级信息导航装置”！

lines.en: That means we can travel to many places and learn many things. Kids from all over the world ask us questions. We find them answers!
lines.zh: 也就是说我们能去很多地方，学很多东西。世界各地的孩子向我们提问，我们帮他们找答案！

lines.en: Woo-hoo! That is right, Anna.
lines.zh: 呜呼！说得对，安娜。

lines.en: MINDY, what is our first question?
lines.zh: 敏迪，我们的第一个问题是什么？

lines.en: Layla asks us this question.
lines.zh: 莱拉问了我们这个问题。

lines.en: Hello, Anna! Hello, MINDY! I'd like to know -- how do you play baseball?
lines.zh: 你好，安娜！你好，敏迪！我想知道——棒球怎么打？

lines.en: That is a great question! MINDY, we need to find her an answer!
lines.zh: 好问题！敏迪，我们得帮她找到答案！

lines.en: I know that we can find it, Anna!
lines.zh: 我知道我们能找到，安娜！

lines.en: Where am I now? MINDY, now I am on a snowy mountain!
lines.zh: 我现在在哪儿？敏迪，我在一座雪山上！

lines.en: That is a good place to learn how to ski.
lines.zh: 那里很适合学滑雪。

lines.en: Yes, MINDY, but it cannot teach us about baseball! And I don't know how to ski!
lines.zh: 是啊，敏迪，可这里教不了我们打棒球！而且我不会滑雪！

lines.en: Sorry, Anna. Let's try again.
lines.zh: 对不起，安娜，我们再试一次。

lines.en: Where I am now!? MINDY, I am in the ocean! An ocean cannot teach us about baseball!
lines.zh: 我现在在哪儿？！敏迪，我在海里！大海教不了我们打棒球！

lines.en: Please don't yell, Anna. The ocean can teach us about surfing.
lines.zh: 别喊，安娜。大海能教我们冲浪。

lines.en: Yes, MINDY, it can teach us about surfing … and sharks! Ahhh!
lines.zh: 是啊，敏迪，它能教我们冲浪……还有鲨鱼！啊——！

lines.en: Anna, please wait. I need to fix my navigation device
lines.zh: 安娜，请等等，我得修一下我的导航装置。

lines.en: MINDY, please fix it faster. And get me out of here … now!
lines.zh: 敏迪，快点修好，把我弄出去……马上！

lines.en: Whoa! Is Anna going to be lost forever? Next week, you can watch part two of "The Time Traveling Treehouse!"
lines.zh: 哇！安娜会永远迷路吗？下周请收看《时空旅行树屋》第二集！

lines.en: Aw, man! Will the shark eat her?
lines.zh: 啊，不是吧！鲨鱼会吃了她吗？

lines.en: Will Anna find the answer?
lines.zh: 安娜能找到答案吗？

lines.en: Please tell me the ending!
lines.zh: 告诉我结局吧！

lines.en: So, you liked it?
lines.zh: 那么，你们喜欢吗？

lines.en: Yes!
lines.zh: 喜欢！

lines.en: Well, you can watch the ending next week!
lines.zh: 那下周就能看到结局了！

lines.en: Noooooo!
Don't forget to watch next week!
lines.zh: 别忘了下周收看！

qs.q: What is the name of Anna's show?
qs.why: "Welcome to 'The Time Traveling Treehouse!'"

qs.q: What does Layla want to know?
qs.why: "how do you play baseball?"

qs.q: Where is Anna at the end of the show?
qs.why: "I am in the ocean!" ……还有鲨鱼。

lessons.title: Learning America's Sport
lessons.zh: 学打美国的国民运动：棒球

lines.en: Last time on "The Time Traveling Treehouse," Anna was lost, really lost. She wants to learn about baseball. But her computer, MINDY, sent her to many wrong places.
lines.zh: 上回《时空旅行树屋》讲到，安娜迷路了，彻底迷路了。她想了解棒球，可她的电脑敏迪把她送到了很多错的地方。

lines.en: MINDY! Help me! I am in the ocean with a shark!
lines.zh: 敏迪！救命！我在海里，旁边有鲨鱼！

lines.en: I will try one more time, Anna.
lines.zh: 我再试一次，安娜。

lines.en: Please try harder, MINDY!
lines.zh: 请再努力点，敏迪！

lines.en: Now, where am I? I am at a playground with a baseball field! Yes! I can teach children about baseball here! MINDY, MINDY, it took you a long time. But you did it!
lines.zh: 我现在在哪儿？我在一个有棒球场的游乐场！太好了！我可以在这儿教孩子们打棒球！敏迪，敏迪，你花了好长时间，不过你做到了！

lines.en: Thanks, Anna. Give me a call when you find the answer.
lines.zh: 谢谢，安娜。找到答案就给我打电话。

lines.en: Okay. Come with me. Let's learn how to play baseball! This is a baseball field. This is a pitcher's mound. This is first base! This is second base! This is third base! This is home plate!
lines.zh: 好的。跟我来，我们来学打棒球！这是棒球场，这是投手丘，这是一垒！这是二垒！这是三垒！这是本垒！

lines.en: To play baseball, you really only need a bat, a ball and a glove. Each team has many players.
lines.zh: 打棒球其实只需要一根球棒、一个球和一只手套。每个队有很多队员。

lines.en: Pitchers pitch the ball.
lines.zh: 投手投球。

lines.en: Catchers catch the ball.
lines.zh: 接手接球。

lines.en: Batters bat the ball.
lines.zh: 击球手击球。

lines.en: Runners run the bases.
lines.zh: 跑垒员跑垒。

lines.en: Fielders field the ball.
lines.zh: 外野手接守击出的球。

lines.en: First, the pitcher pitches the ball to the batter. The batter bats the ball. Then, the runner runs to first base.
lines.zh: 首先，投手把球投给击球手，击球手击球，然后跑垒员跑向一垒。

lines.en: Each time a batter bats, the runners run around the bases. Each time a runner runs across home plate, they score a run! There are nine innings in a game. The team with the most runs at the end of nine innings wins the game!
lines.zh: 每次击球手击球，跑垒员就绕着垒跑。每当跑垒员跑过本垒，就得一分！一场比赛有九局，九局结束时得分最多的队获胜！

lines.en: MINDY, MINDY, we found the answer! It's time to return to the treehouse.
lines.zh: 敏迪，敏迪，我们找到答案了！该回树屋了。

lines.en: Good job! That was fast.
lines.zh: 干得好！真快。

lines.en: Good job Anna. You know, I still don't like children's shows, but I like this children's show.
lines.zh: 干得好，安娜。你知道吗，我还是不喜欢儿童节目，但我喜欢这个儿童节目。

lines.en: I liked the time travel.
lines.zh: 我喜欢时空旅行。

lines.en: But time travel is not real. You're so silly, Anna.
lines.zh: 可时空旅行不是真的。你真逗，安娜。

lines.en: Yeah, time travel is so silly. Thanks, goodbye. Bye, thank you.
lines.zh: 是啊，时空旅行太傻了。谢谢，再见。拜拜，谢谢。

lines.en: Hello, MINDY? Are you there?
lines.zh: 你好，敏迪？你在吗？

lines.en: Hello, Anna.
lines.zh: 你好，安娜。

lines.en: MINDY, I want to go to China! Until next time …
lines.zh: 敏迪，我想去中国！下次见……

qs.q: What do you need to play baseball?
opts: a bat, a ball and a glove
qs.a: a bat, a ball and a glove
qs.why: "you really only need a bat, a ball and a glove."

qs.q: How many innings are in a game?
qs.why: "There are nine innings in a game."

qs.q: How does a team score a run?
opts: A runner runs across home plate.
qs.a: A runner runs across home plate.
qs.why: "Each time a runner runs across home plate, they score a run!"

lessons.title: What Will I Do?
lessons.zh: 我会做什么？万圣节读心术

lines.en: Hello! Halloween is very popular in the United States.
lines.zh: 你好！万圣节在美国很受欢迎。

lines.en: Children trick-or-treat. They ask people for candy. Children and adults wear costumes and go to parties!
lines.zh: 孩子们去“不给糖就捣蛋”，向人要糖。孩子和大人都穿上装扮服去参加派对！

lines.en: In fact, there is a Halloween party tonight. I need my friend, Genie. Genie!
lines.zh: 其实今晚就有个万圣节派对。我需要我的朋友精灵。精灵！

lines.en: Hi!
lines.zh: 嗨！

lines.en: Hi, Anna! What do you need?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！你需要什么？

lines.en: Tonight, there is a Halloween party.
lines.zh: 今晚有个万圣节派对。

lines.en: I love Halloween! Are you going?
lines.zh: 我爱万圣节！你去吗？

lines.en: I might go. I might not go. I don't have a costume. Can you help me?
lines.zh: 我可能去，也可能不去。我没有装扮服。你能帮我吗？

lines.en: Dress as a genie!
lines.zh: 扮成精灵吧！

lines.en: Great idea! I can do a genie trick like read minds!
lines.zh: 好主意！我可以表演精灵的把戏，比如读心术！

lines.en: Anna, be careful. Things might go wrong.
lines.zh: 安娜，小心点。事情可能会出岔子。

lines.en: What can go wrong?
lines.zh: 能出什么岔子？

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: Hey, look! I'm a genie! This is going to be fun!
lines.zh: 嘿，看！我是精灵！这会很好玩！

lines.en: Remember, Anna. Be careful!
lines.zh: 记住，安娜，小心点！

lines.en: Don't worry, Genie! I will!
lines.zh: 别担心，精灵！我会的！

lines.en: Excuse me, are you really a mind reader?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你真会读心术吗？

lines.en: I might be.
lines.zh: 可能会。

lines.en: Okay, tell me what I am thinking.
lines.zh: 好，那说说我在想什么。

lines.en: Sure! First, what do you do?
lines.zh: 没问题！首先，你是做什么的？

lines.en: I study. I'm a junior in college.
lines.zh: 我在上学，大学三年级。

lines.en: What do you study?
lines.zh: 你学什么？

lines.en: I study journalism.
lines.zh: 我学新闻。

lines.en: Okay. Wait. You are thinking … you will graduate from college in about one year.
lines.zh: 好。等等。你在想……你大概一年后大学毕业。

lines.en: Well, yeah. That's the plan. I told you, I'm a junior in college.
lines.zh: 嗯，是啊，计划是这样。我告诉过你我大三了。

lines.en: Right, um, wait. There's more. You are thinking … you might get a job writing the news.
lines.zh: 对，嗯，等等，还有。你在想……你可能会找到一份写新闻的工作。

lines.en: I MIGHT get a job writing the news? I MIGHT! That means I might not. And I'm studying really hard.
lines.zh: 我“可能”找到写新闻的工作？“可能”！那就是说可能找不到。我学得那么努力。

lines.en: No, no, no, no. Uh, no, you will! You WILL get a job writing the news.
lines.zh: 不不不不。呃，不，你会的！你“一定会”找到写新闻的工作。

lines.en: I will?
lines.zh: 我会？

lines.en: You will.
lines.zh: 你会。

lines.en: I will. I think.
lines.zh: 我会。我想是吧。

lines.en: 'Bye. Happy to help!
lines.zh: 拜拜。很高兴帮到你！

lines.en: Can you really read minds?
lines.zh: 你真的会读心术吗？

lines.en: I might.
lines.zh: 可能会。

lines.en: Well, today, I will ask my girlfriend to marry me. What am I thinking?
lines.zh: 好，今天我要向女朋友求婚。我在想什么？

lines.en: Wait. Wait, you are thinking ... you might have a wedding very soon!
lines.zh: 等等。等等，你在想……你可能很快就要办婚礼了！

lines.en: Might? MIGHT? She won't say "no," will she?
lines.zh: 可能？“可能”？她不会说“不”吧？

lines.en: No, no! She WILL say "yes"!
lines.zh: 不不！她一定会说“愿意”！

lines.en: I will have a wedding, won't I?
lines.zh: 我会办婚礼的，对吧？

lines.en: You will. You will!
lines.zh: 你会的，你会的！

lines.en: Thanks. I think.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我想是吧。

lines.en: Good luck!
lines.zh: 祝你好运！

lines.en: This is hard. Genie! Genie!
lines.zh: 这太难了。精灵！精灵！

lines.en: Anna, what's wrong?
lines.zh: 安娜，怎么了？

lines.en: I don't want to be a genie for Halloween. I might not go to the party.
lines.zh: 我不想万圣节扮精灵了。我可能不去派对了。

lines.en: Of course you will go. I have another costume for you!
lines.zh: 你当然要去。我给你准备了另一套装扮服！

lines.en: I'm a rock star! You read my mind!
lines.zh: 我是摇滚明星！你读懂了我的心思！

lines.en: No. You told me you like rock music.
lines.zh: 不是，是你告诉过我你喜欢摇滚乐。

lines.en: Oh, right. Well, I love it!
lines.zh: 哦，对。嗯，我太爱了！

lines.en: Have fun, Anna!
lines.zh: 玩得开心，安娜！

lines.en: Thanks, Genie!!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，精灵！！

lines.en: I am ready for the Halloween party! But I am not going to read minds. I might play some rock music! Or I might not. Until next time …
lines.zh: 我准备好去万圣节派对了！不过我不读心了。我可能会弹点摇滚乐！也可能不会。下次见……

qs.q: What does Anna first dress as?
qs.why: "Dress as a genie!" "Great idea!"

qs.q: What does Rebecca study?
qs.why: "I study journalism."

qs.q: Why are people unhappy with Anna's answers?
qs.why: “might”表示可能，也可能不会，所以他们不放心。

lessons.title: Let’s Make Dinner!
lessons.zh: 我们做晚饭吧！买错了购物清单

lines.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has many fun places to eat. But, sometimes it's more fun to cook. In fact, tonight Marsha and I are cooking for friends. Well, she is cooking. I am doing the shopping.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家好！华盛顿有很多好玩的吃饭地方。不过有时候自己做饭更有意思。其实今晚玛莎和我要给朋友们做饭。嗯，是她做饭，我负责买东西。

lines.en: (phone rings) It's Marsha. Hi, Marsha.
lines.zh: （电话响）是玛莎。嗨，玛莎。

lines.en: Hi, Anna. Do you have the shopping list?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。你拿着购物清单吗？

lines.en: Yes, I told you: I have the shopping list. Can you hear it?
lines.zh: 拿着，我跟你说过了：我拿着购物清单。你听得见吗？

lines.en: Okay, good. I hear the list. Anna, please buy all the ingredients on the list.
lines.zh: 好，很好，我听到清单的声音了。安娜，请把清单上的配料都买齐。

lines.en: Yes, Marsha, I will.
lines.zh: 好的，玛莎，我会的。

lines.en: And do not spend too much time shopping.
lines.zh: 还有，别在购物上花太多时间。

lines.en: No, Marsha, I won't. See you later.
lines.zh: 不会的，玛莎，我不会的。回头见。

lines.en: Sometimes, Marsha worries too much. I love shopping! And, I did not spend too much money. Oh, no! But I did spend too much time! I have to return home now!
lines.zh: 有时候玛莎担心太多了。我爱购物！而且我没花太多钱。哦不！可我确实花了太多时间！我现在得回家了！

lines.en: Anna, what took you so long? Our guests will be here soon!
lines.zh: 安娜，你怎么去了这么久？客人马上就到了！

lines.en: Don't worry, Marsha. I bought everything on the list.
lines.zh: 别担心，玛莎。清单上的东西我都买了。

lines.en: Let me see. You bought a bunch of bananas, a box of pancake mix, a bag of coffee … Anna, this is all wrong!
lines.zh: 我看看。你买了一串香蕉、一盒松饼粉、一袋咖啡……安娜，这全错了！

lines.en: What do you mean wrong? I bought a jar of peanut butter and a loaf of bread … no, wait … two loaves of bread.
lines.zh: 什么叫错了？我买了一罐花生酱和一条面包……不对，等等……两条面包。

lines.en: Anna, these are the wrong ingredients!
lines.zh: 安娜，这些配料都不对！

lines.en: These ingredients are all on the list! I took this list from the counter.
lines.zh: 这些配料清单上都有啊！我是从台面上拿的这张清单。

lines.en: Anna, this is the shopping list for breakfast. I said, take the shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
lines.zh: 安娜，这是早餐的购物清单。我说的是，拿冰箱上那张晚餐的购物清单！

lines.en: Marsha, there was no shopping list - on the refrigerator - for dinner!
lines.zh: 玛莎，冰箱上根本没有晚餐的购物清单！

lines.en: Oh no! It's on the floor!!
lines.zh: 哦不！它掉在地上了！！

lines.en: Ahh!!! Ahh!!!
What are we going to do?
lines.zh: 我们怎么办？

lines.en: When do our guests arrive?
lines.zh: 客人什么时候到？

lines.en: They arrive in 30 minutes!
lines.zh: 30 分钟后到！

lines.en: I can fix this. Do you trust me?
lines.zh: 我能搞定。你相信我吗？

lines.en: Do I have to?
lines.zh: 我必须相信吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: (The story continues next week)
lines.zh: （故事下周继续）

qs.q: What is Anna's job tonight?
qs.why: "She is cooking. I am doing the shopping."

qs.q: What is wrong with the shopping list Anna used?
opts: It is the list for breakfast.
qs.a: It is the list for breakfast.
qs.why: "this is the shopping list for breakfast."

qs.q: When will the guests arrive?
qs.why: "They arrive in 30 minutes!"

lessons.title: I Can Fix This!
lessons.zh: 我能搞定！早餐当晚餐

lines.en: Last time on Let's Learn English, Marsha and I invited friends to a dinner party but I shopped with the wrong list. Guests are coming soon. Marsha is worried but I have a plan. Let's see what it is.
lines.zh: 上回《Let's Learn English》讲到，玛莎和我请朋友来吃晚饭，可我拿错了购物清单。客人马上就到，玛莎很着急，不过我有个计划。看看是什么吧。

lines.en: I just need a couple of ingredients. Marsha, please hand me the flour.
lines.zh: 我只需要几样配料。玛莎，请把面粉递给我。

lines.en: Anna, where is the flour? It's not in the cabinets.
lines.zh: 安娜，面粉在哪儿？柜子里没有。

lines.en: I put the flour inside the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 我把面粉放冰箱里了。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: It's cold and dry in the refrigerator. See, it says: "Put in a cold, dry place." Okay, now, Marsha, please hand me the eggs.
lines.zh: 冰箱里又冷又干。看，上面写着：“放在阴凉干燥处。”好，现在，玛莎，请把鸡蛋递给我。

lines.en: Anna, where are the eggs?
lines.zh: 安娜，鸡蛋在哪儿？

lines.en: The eggs are inside the cabinet under the sink.
lines.zh: 鸡蛋在水槽下面的柜子里。

lines.en: Anna, why are the eggs in here?
lines.zh: 安娜，鸡蛋为什么在这儿？

lines.en: On the farm, we always put the eggs there. How else can the chickens see them? Okay. You clean the living room. I will make dinner.
lines.zh: 在农场我们总把鸡蛋放那儿，不然鸡怎么看得见？好了。你打扫客厅，我来做晚饭。

lines.en: What are you going to make with these ingredients?
lines.zh: 你要用这些配料做什么？

lines.en: I have a plan.
lines.zh: 我有个计划。

lines.en: Okay, the apartment is clean. The kitchen is not. What are you cooking?
lines.zh: 好了，公寓打扫干净了，厨房可没有。你在做什么？

lines.en: I made my favorite recipe: peanut-butter-banana pancakes!
lines.zh: 我做了我最拿手的菜：花生酱香蕉松饼！

lines.en: You made breakfast.
lines.zh: 你做的是早饭。

lines.en: Yes! I call it let's-eat-breakfast-for-dinner dinner!
lines.zh: 对！我管它叫“晚餐吃早餐”大餐！

lines.en: Anna! Mmm! Hey, this tastes good! Anna, you made it work!
lines.zh: 安娜！嗯！嘿，真好吃！安娜，你还真搞定了！

lines.en: That's our guests!
lines.zh: 客人到了！

lines.en: I'll answer the door.
lines.zh: 我去开门。

lines.en: I'll finish here.
lines.zh: 我把这儿收拾完。

lines.en: Like I said, sometimes Marsha worries too much. When something goes wrong with your plan, just change the plan! Till next time!
lines.zh: 我说过，有时候玛莎担心太多了。计划出岔子时，改计划就行！下次见！

qs.q: Where did Anna put the flour?
qs.why: "I put the flour inside the refrigerator."

qs.q: What does Anna make for dinner?
qs.why: "I made my favorite recipe: peanut-butter-banana pancakes!"

qs.q: What is Anna's advice?
opts: When your plan goes wrong, change the plan.
qs.a: When your plan goes wrong, change the plan.
qs.why: "When something goes wrong with your plan, just change the plan!"

lessons.title: Let's Agree to Disagree
lessons.zh: 求同存异：城市好还是乡村好？

lines.en: You know, I am from the country and sometimes I miss it. But I really like life in the city! I love the city. Oh, look. Someone lost a bag. Maybe it's theirs. Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
lines.zh: 你知道，我来自乡下，有时候挺想念的。不过我真的很喜欢城市生活！我爱城市。哦，看，有人丢了个包。也许是他们的。打扰一下，这包是您的吗？

lines.en: No. It's not mine. It might be hers.
lines.zh: 不，不是我的。可能是她的。

lines.en: Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这包是您的吗？

lines.en: No. It's not mine. It might be his.
lines.zh: 不，不是我的。可能是他的。

lines.en: Thank you. Hello. Is this bag yours?
lines.zh: 谢谢。您好，这包是您的吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's mine. These are all my travel things. Thank you, thank you!
lines.zh: 对，是我的！这些都是我的旅行用品。谢谢，谢谢！

lines.en: Are you okay? You seem ... nervous.
lines.zh: 您还好吗？您看起来……有点紧张。

lines.en: Well, this is my first visit to Washington, D.C. I'm from a small town in the country. I feel a little lost.
lines.zh: 嗯，这是我第一次来华盛顿。我来自乡下一个小镇，感觉有点迷茫。

lines.en: I am from the country too! And I understand. When I first came here, I felt lost ... all the time.
lines.zh: 我也来自乡下！我理解。我刚来这儿时，总是迷迷糊糊的。

lines.en: So, do you like living in the country or in the city?
lines.zh: 那么，你喜欢住乡下还是城市？

lines.en: I like to live in the city.
lines.zh: 我喜欢住城市。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: The city is exciting! It has more culture than the country. There are many museums and restaurants. Every night, there is theater and music. And, there are more jobs. That is why I'm here.
lines.zh: 城市让人兴奋！它比乡下更有文化氛围，有很多博物馆和餐厅，每晚都有戏剧和音乐。而且工作机会更多，所以我在这儿。

lines.en: Well, I agree. There is more culture in the city and there might be more jobs. But the country has more nature! It's peaceful and beautiful. There are more trees and mountains. The air is clean. You can go hiking and camping. The city is not beautiful. It's noisy and dirty.
lines.zh: 嗯，我同意，城市更有文化，工作也可能更多。可乡下有更多大自然！又宁静又美丽，树更多，山更多，空气干净，还能去徒步、露营。城市不美，又吵又脏。

lines.en: I disagree. I think all the different buildings are beautiful. And I like to watch all the different people.
lines.zh: 我不同意。我觉得各种各样的建筑都很美，我也喜欢看形形色色的人。

lines.en: That's another thing that is different. People in the country are friendly. They always say "hello!" Here, no one says "hello." I think city people are rude.
lines.zh: 这又是一个不同之处。乡下人很友好，总是说“你好！”这里没人打招呼。我觉得城里人很没礼貌。

lines.en: Well, I agree. Country people are friendly. But I don't think city people are rude. I think they're just busy.
lines.zh: 嗯，我同意乡下人很友好。不过我不觉得城里人没礼貌，我觉得他们只是忙。

lines.en: That's a good point.
lines.zh: 说得有道理。

lines.en: Look at me. I live in the city and I said "hello" to you.
lines.zh: 看看我，我住在城市，我也跟你打招呼了。

lines.en: But you are from the country.
lines.zh: 可你是乡下来的。

lines.en: I have an idea. Let's say "hello!" to people -- to many people!
lines.zh: 我有个主意。我们去跟人打招呼——跟很多很多人！

lines.en: What? Why?
lines.zh: 什么？为什么？

lines.en: Well, if we say "hello," maybe they will say "hello" to other people ... Hello!
lines.zh: 嗯，如果我们说“你好”，也许他们也会跟别人说“你好”……你好！

lines.en: ... and they will say "hello" to more people! That's a great idea! I'm glad you found my bag.
lines.zh: ……然后他们又跟更多人说“你好”！好主意！真高兴是你捡到了我的包。

lines.en: Come on. Let's go say "hello" to people.
lines.zh: 走吧，我们去跟人打招呼。

lines.en: We don't have to agree with people. They have their opinions. We have ours. And as we like to say, you can always agree to disagree! Until next time...! Hello!
lines.zh: 我们不必和别人意见一致。他们有他们的看法，我们有我们的。就像我们常说的：总可以求同存异！下次见……！你好！

qs.q: Whose bag is it?
qs.why: "Yes, that's mine." 是菲尔的。

qs.q: Why does Anna like the city?
opts: It is exciting and has more culture and jobs.
qs.a: It is exciting and has more culture and jobs.
qs.why: 城市让人兴奋，文化多，工作也多。

qs.q: What does Anna think about city people?
qs.why: "I don't think city people are rude. I think they're just busy."

lessons.title: She's My Best Friend!
lessons.zh: 她是我最好的朋友！老友来访

lines.en: Hello! I have great news. My best friend from my hometown is coming here -- to Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to catch up with her! Oh! I gotta go. Her train arrives in 10 minutes!
lines.zh: 你好！我有个好消息。我老家最好的朋友要来这儿——华盛顿！我等不及要和她叙旧了！哦！我得走了，她的火车 10 分钟后到！

lines.en: Penelope!
lines.zh: 佩内洛普！

lines.en: Anna! I am really happy to see you!
lines.zh: 安娜！见到你真高兴！

lines.en: Me too! How was your trip?
lines.zh: 我也是！一路上怎么样？

lines.en: It was fine.
lines.zh: 挺好的。

lines.en: Let me help you with your bags.
lines.zh: 我帮你拿包。

lines.en: I'm really excited to be in Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to hear about … everything!
lines.zh: 能来华盛顿我真兴奋！我等不及要听你讲……所有的事！

lines.en: I have so much to tell you. Let's go to my apartment. We can talk over a hot cup of tea.
lines.zh: 我有好多话要跟你说。我们去我的公寓吧，边喝热茶边聊。

lines.en: I love your apartment building, Anna. Is your rent expensive?
lines.zh: 我喜欢你住的公寓楼，安娜。房租贵吗？

lines.en: Well, I have a roommate. So, we split the rent.
lines.zh: 嗯，我有室友，我们分摊房租。

lines.en: Oh, that's right. Is your roommate nice?
lines.zh: 哦，对。你室友人好吗？

lines.en: Marsha is the nicest person I know in this city. Sometimes she worries too much. And she says I'm the messiest cook she knows. But we are great roommates.
lines.zh: 玛莎是我在这座城市认识的最好的人。有时候她担心太多，她还说我是她认识的做饭最乱的人。不过我们是很好的室友。

lines.en: So, Anna, is it hard to make friends in D.C.?
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，在华盛顿交朋友难吗？

lines.en: At first it was hard. But now, Marsha is a good friend. And there's Pete. Of all the people I know in D.C., Pete is the most serious and also the silliest.
lines.zh: 一开始挺难的。不过现在玛莎是好朋友。还有皮特。在我认识的华盛顿人里，皮特是最认真的，也是最傻的。

lines.en: He sounds … interesting.
lines.zh: 他听起来……挺有意思。

lines.en: Jonathan and Ashley are two other good friends of mine. In the city, they are the friendliest people I know. They always help me when I need it.
lines.zh: 乔纳森和阿什莉也是我的好朋友。在这座城市，他们是我认识的最友好的人，我需要帮忙时他们总会帮我。

lines.en: Your friends sound great! So, tell me about your job.
lines.zh: 你的朋友听起来都很棒！那么，跟我说说你的工作吧。

lines.en: I love my work! I make a children's show called the "Time Traveling Treehouse."
lines.zh: 我爱我的工作！我做一个叫《时空旅行树屋》的儿童节目。

lines.en: Anna, that is the best job for you! Do you remember when we were little? We played in that old treehouse behind my family's house for hours!
lines.zh: 安娜，这工作再适合你不过了！还记得我们小时候吗？我们在我家后面那个旧树屋里一玩就是好几个小时！

lines.en: I forgot about that! We thought it really time traveled! It is really good to talk to you. New friends are good. But old friends are the best.
lines.zh: 我都忘了！我们以为它真的能穿越时空！和你聊天真好。新朋友很好，但老朋友最好。

lines.en: I know. Our hometown isn't the same now. You are not there.
lines.zh: 我知道。我们的家乡现在不一样了，你不在那儿。

lines.en: No crying. No crying. Penelope, why don't you move here and live with me and Marsha?
lines.zh: 别哭，别哭。佩内洛普，你干嘛不搬来和我、玛莎一起住？

lines.en: Anna, I can't leave our hometown. You forget -- I love my job, too.
lines.zh: 安娜，我不能离开家乡。你忘了——我也爱我的工作。

lines.en: I didn't forget. You are the most famous turkey farmer I know!
lines.zh: 我没忘。你是我认识的最有名的火鸡农场主！

lines.en: Thanks, Anna.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，安娜。

lines.en: Come on. Let's go eat dinner at one of D.C.'s most famous restaurants.
lines.zh: 走吧，我们去华盛顿最有名的一家餐厅吃晚饭。

lines.en: Awesome!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.en: I have a great apartment. I love my work. And I have awesome friends. I am the luckiest woman in Washington, D.C.
lines.zh: 我有很棒的公寓，我爱我的工作，还有超棒的朋友。我是华盛顿最幸运的女人。

lines.en: (sound of thunder)
lines.zh: （打雷声）

lines.en: Until next time?
lines.zh: 下次见？

qs.q: Who is Penelope?
opts: Anna's best friend from her hometown
qs.a: Anna's best friend from her hometown
qs.why: "My best friend from my hometown is coming here."

qs.q: How does Anna pay her rent?
opts: She splits it with a roommate.
qs.a: She splits it with a roommate.
qs.why: "I have a roommate. So, we split the rent."

qs.q: What is Penelope's job?
qs.why: "You are the most famous turkey farmer I know!"

lessons.title: It’s Unbelievable!
lessons.zh: 难以置信！不靠谱的广告

lines.en: Hello! Winter weather in Washington, D.C. can be really windy. And wind messes up my hair. It is really windy today. Look at my hair. Will it be windy this weekend? I'll listen to the news. I am tired of my untidy hair.
lines.zh: 你好！华盛顿冬天风很大，风会把我的头发吹乱。今天风特别大，看我的头发。这周末会刮风吗？我听听新闻。我受够我这乱糟糟的头发了。

lines.en: Are you tired of your untidy hair?
lines.zh: 你受够乱糟糟的头发了吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, I am. And it's … uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 是的，是的，受够了。而且……很不舒服。

lines.en: Is it … uncomfortable?
lines.zh: 是……不舒服吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, it is! Hey, is that … Pete?
lines.zh: 是的，是的！嘿，那是……皮特？

lines.en: Hi. I'm Pete. And I have the perfect product for you -- Hair Be Good!
lines.zh: 嗨，我是皮特。我有一款完美的产品给你——“好头发”！

lines.en: Just spray Hair Be Good on your hair … wrap in a towel … and you are done! Hair Be Good works and it's inexpensive. One can costs only $10! So, go online and order your Hair Be Good today!
lines.zh: 只要把“好头发”喷在头发上……用毛巾裹起来……就搞定了！“好头发”有效又便宜，一罐只要 10 美元！快上网订购你的“好头发”吧！

lines.en: Hair Be Good sounds perfect! And I can trust Pete! I am buying some right now. Okay, I will order one can of Hair Be Good for $10. I'll pay with a credit card. My delivery will arrive in 2 days. Awesome!
lines.zh: “好头发”听起来很完美！而且我信得过皮特！我现在就买。好，我订一罐“好头发”，10 美元，用信用卡付。两天后送到。太棒了！

lines.en: It arrived! I'll use it before I go to work. Okay, Hair Be Good, make my untidy hair tidy! No, make it … fabulous!
lines.zh: 到货了！我上班前用一下。好，“好头发”，让我乱糟糟的头发变整齐！不，让它……美极了！

lines.en: Hi, Anna.
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。

lines.en: Hello, Amelia!
lines.zh: 你好，阿米莉亚！

lines.en: Anna, you look … different.
lines.zh: 安娜，你看起来……不太一样。

lines.en: Thanks! I used a new product called Hair Be Good.
lines.zh: 谢谢！我用了一款叫“好头发”的新产品。

lines.en: Well, it's not.
lines.zh: 嗯，它可不好。

lines.en: It's not what?
lines.zh: 不好什么？

lines.en: Good. Your hair does not look good.
lines.zh: 不好。你的头发看起来不好。

lines.en: Oh, no! This is not good.
lines.zh: 哦不！这可不好。

lines.en: Why don't you go home and take care of … this.
lines.zh: 你不如回家处理一下……这个。

lines.en: Good idea.
lines.zh: 好主意。

lines.en: Hi, Anna!
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜！

lines.en: Hello, Pete.
lines.zh: 你好，皮特。

lines.en: Is something wrong?
lines.zh: 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: This is wrong!
lines.zh: 这就是事！

lines.en: What did you do to your hair?
lines.zh: 你对你的头发做了什么？

lines.en: Hair Be Good did this to my hair.
lines.zh: “好头发”把我的头发弄成这样。

lines.en: Ah, you bought it!
lines.zh: 啊，你买了！

lines.en: Yes, I bought it. You said in your ad it was a perfect product. This is not perfect. This is imperfect!
lines.zh: 是，我买了。你在广告里说它是完美的产品，这可不完美。这是不完美！

lines.en: It's unbelievable!
lines.zh: 难以置信！

lines.en: I believed your ad, Pete. It was dishonest!
lines.zh: 我相信了你的广告，皮特。它不诚实！

lines.en: Anna, you don't believe everything you see in ads, do you?
lines.zh: 安娜，你不会广告里说什么都信吧？

lines.en: No, Pete. Just the ones with my friends.
lines.zh: 不会，皮特。只信我朋友拍的。

lines.en: Your hair will be okay. Just wash it ... a couple of times.
lines.zh: 你的头发会没事的，洗……几次就好了。

lines.en: Thanks. Thanks a lot, Pete! Here, here's your product! You should call it "Hair Be Really, Really Bad!" Until next time, Pete! Till next time.
lines.zh: 谢谢。太谢谢你了，皮特！给，你的产品还你！你应该叫它“头发真的真的很糟”！下次见，皮特！下次见。

qs.q: Why does Anna want Hair Be Good?
opts: Her hair is untidy in the wind.
qs.a: Her hair is untidy in the wind.
qs.why: "I am tired of my untidy hair."

qs.q: How much is one can?
qs.why: "One can costs only $10!"

qs.q: What does Pete tell Anna to do?
opts: Wash her hair a couple of times.
qs.a: Wash her hair a couple of times.
qs.why: "Just wash it ... a couple of times."

lessons.title: The Woods Are Alive
lessons.zh: 森林活了：试镜演话剧

lines.en: Happy New Year! Some people, at the start of a new year, make a resolution -- a promise to yourself to be better. I thought about my resolution carefully. I want to be an actor on the stage! Today I will audition for a show called "The Woods Are Alive!" Wish me luck!
lines.zh: 新年快乐！有些人在新年伊始会许个新年愿望——给自己的一个承诺，要变得更好。我认真想了想我的愿望：我想当舞台剧演员！今天我要去试镜一部叫《森林活了》的戏！祝我好运吧！

lines.en: Next! What is your name?
lines.zh: 下一位！你叫什么名字？

lines.en: My name is Anna Matteo.
lines.zh: 我叫安娜·马泰奥。

lines.en: Are you ready to audition?
lines.zh: 准备好试镜了吗？

lines.en: (warms up voice) Yes.
lines.zh: （开嗓）准备好了。

lines.en: Great. Let's begin on page 1. Here is the story. You are lost in the woods. You are searching desperately for a way out. Suddenly, you hear something.
lines.zh: 很好。我们从第 1 页开始。剧情是这样：你在森林里迷路了，拼命找出路。突然，你听到了什么。

lines.en: Now, say your line.
lines.zh: 现在，说你的台词。

lines.en: 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?'
lines.zh: “那是什么？你好，有人吗？”

lines.en: Anna, you are speaking too softly. Can you speak more loudly and a little more, um, seriously?
lines.zh: 安娜，你说得太小声了。能大声一点，再稍微……严肃一点吗？

lines.en: Yes, of course I can. 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?' Is that loud enough?
lines.zh: 当然可以。“那是什么？你好，有人吗？”这样够大声吗？

lines.en: Yes, that is loud enough. Let's turn to page 25. In this scene, you are moving slowly and quietly through the woods.
lines.zh: 够大声了。我们翻到第 25 页。这一场，你要慢慢地、悄悄地穿过森林。

lines.en: Anna. Anna! You are walking quickly and loudly. Walk slowly and quietly.
lines.zh: 安娜。安娜！你走得又快又吵。慢慢地、悄悄地走。

lines.en: I'm walking slowly and quietly. I am walking…
lines.zh: 我在慢慢地、悄悄地走。我在走……

lines.en: Anna. Anna. You don't need to say "slowly" and "quietly." Alright, let's try the last scene. Turn to page 48. I say my line first, then you say your line.
lines.zh: 安娜，安娜，你不用把“慢慢地”“悄悄地”说出来。好吧，我们试最后一场，翻到第 48 页。我先说我的台词，然后你说你的。

lines.en: 'You will never get out of these woods alive! Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha!'
lines.zh: “你永远别想活着走出这片森林！哇哈哈哈哈！哇哈哈哈哈！”

lines.en: 'Yes, I will.'
lines.zh: “不，我能。”

lines.en: Okay, Anna, you said that line -- you said that line really late. You need to say it earlier.
lines.zh: 好，安娜，你那句台词——说得太晚了。你得早一点说。

lines.en: Sorry. Sorry. Let me try again.
lines.zh: 抱歉，抱歉，让我再试一次。

lines.en: 'You will never …'
lines.zh: “你永远……”

lines.en: 'Yes, I will.'
lines.zh: “不，我能。”

lines.en: '… get out of the woods alive.'
lines.zh: “……别想活着走出这片森林。”

lines.en: I was too early, wasn't I?
lines.zh: 我说得太早了，是吧？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, you were.
lines.zh: 是的，是的，太早了。

lines.en: Director, how am I doing?
lines.zh: 导演，我表现得怎么样？

lines.en: You know, Anna. I think that I have the perfect part for you.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，安娜，我觉得我有个完美的角色给你。

lines.en: The costume is in the back. Please go try it on.
lines.zh: 戏服在后面，请去试穿一下。

lines.en: Awesome! (Anna returns as a tree.)
lines.zh: 太棒了！（安娜扮成一棵树回来了）

lines.en: Oh, Anna, that fits you perfectly!
lines.zh: 哦，安娜，这身太适合你了！

lines.en: I'm a tree. I'm a tree in … "The Woods Are Alive!" Yes!
lines.zh: 我是一棵树。我是《森林活了》里的一棵树！耶！

lines.en: My new year is starting awesomely! Excuse me, Director! I have a great idea for my tree. Oh, wait! Until next time!
lines.zh: 我的新年开了个好头！打扰一下，导演！我对我这棵树有个好主意。哦，等等！下次见！

qs.q: What is Anna's New Year's resolution?
opts: to be an actor on the stage
qs.a: to be an actor on the stage
qs.why: "I want to be an actor on the stage!"

qs.q: What is wrong with Anna's first line?
qs.why: "you are speaking too softly."

qs.q: What part does Anna get?
qs.why: "I'm a tree in … 'The Woods Are Alive!'"

lessons.title: Teamwork Works Best With a Team
lessons.zh: 团队合作要有团队：工作考评

lines.en: Hi. I am walking to work. Today my boss will tell me what she thinks of my work. Is it good? Or is it bad? Okay, time for work. I am going right now. Okay, okay, I'm going!
lines.zh: 嗨。我在走路去上班。今天我的上司要告诉我她对我工作的看法。是好？还是坏？好了，该上班了。我这就去。好了好了，我去了！

lines.en: Anna, hello.
lines.zh: 安娜，你好。

lines.en: Hello.
lines.zh: 您好。

lines.en: Sit down. As you know, at the start of a new year we have a work review.
lines.zh: 坐吧。你知道，每年年初我们都有工作考评。

lines.en: Yes. It's time for mine.
lines.zh: 是的，轮到我了。

lines.en: Yes. Anna, this chart shows the audience of The Time Traveling Treehouse. If you look at it, you will see something bad. Your audience is going down, down, DOWN!
lines.zh: 是的。安娜，这张图显示的是《时空旅行树屋》的观众数。你看，情况不妙：你的观众在下降、下降、一直下降！

lines.en: Ms. Weaver, I think the chart is upside down.
lines.zh: 韦弗女士，我觉得这张图拿倒了。

lines.en: Here, let's flip that around. Now, it's right-side up.
lines.zh: 来，我们把它翻过来。现在正过来了。

lines.en: Oh. If you look at this chart, you will see something good. Your audience is big.
lines.zh: 哦。你看这张图，情况不错：你的观众很多。

lines.en: Good!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: But not big enough.
lines.zh: 但还不够多。

lines.en: Not good.
lines.zh: 不太好。

lines.en: I want to see these numbers go up, and up, and UP!
lines.zh: 我想看到这些数字上升、上升、一直上升！

lines.en: How?
lines.zh: 怎么做？

lines.en: I have something -- idea posters!
lines.zh: 我有个东西——励志海报！

lines.en: (whispers) Idea posters.
lines.zh: （小声）励志海报。

lines.en: You really ought to think seriously about them. I like this one. Please read it.
lines.zh: 你真该好好想想它们。我喜欢这张，请读一下。

lines.en: "If at first you SUCCEED; you will be a success." Well, it's a cute cat.
lines.zh: “如果你一开始就成功，你就会成功。”嗯，这只猫真可爱。

lines.en: Here's another one. I like it.
lines.zh: 还有一张，我喜欢。

lines.en: "WORKING HARD looks hard because it really is hard." I see. It's another cute cat.
lines.zh: “努力工作看起来很难，因为它真的很难。”明白了。又是一只可爱的猫。

lines.en: This is my favorite.
lines.zh: 这是我最喜欢的。

lines.en: "TEAMWORK works best with a team." A team of cats. Look at all those cats!
lines.zh: “团队合作要有团队才最有效。”一队猫。看这么多猫！

lines.en: So, Anna, do you understand what I want?
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，你明白我想要什么了吗？

lines.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I understand.
lines.zh: 是的，韦弗女士，我明白了。

lines.en: Okay, team. There is a problem in the Treehouse.
lines.zh: 好了，团队。树屋出了个问题。

lines.en: Problem? What's the problem?
lines.zh: 问题？什么问题？

lines.en: Our audience is big.
lines.zh: 我们的观众很多。

lines.en: But that's a good thing.
lines.zh: 可那是好事啊。

lines.en: No, it is not big enough.
lines.zh: 不，还不够多。

lines.en: Please don't worry. I know what Ms. Weaver wants. Here's the plan. (whispers)
lines.zh: 别担心，我知道韦弗女士想要什么。计划是这样的。（小声说）

lines.en: Is that what she wants?
lines.zh: 那是她想要的吗？

lines.en: Are you sure?
lines.zh: 你确定？

lines.en: Yes. Let's get to work!
lines.zh: 确定。我们开工吧！

lines.en: Good job, team. This is exactly what Ms. Weaver wants!
lines.zh: 干得好，团队。这正是韦弗女士想要的！

lines.en: Welcome to The Time Traveling Treehouse! Today you will learn about a very popular pet … cats!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到《时空旅行树屋》！今天你会了解一种很受欢迎的宠物……猫！

lines.en: Anna. Did I give you enough cats?
lines.zh: 安娜，我给你的猫够多吗？

lines.en: I don't know, MINDY. I think we need more cats!
lines.zh: 不知道，敏迪。我觉得我们还需要更多猫！

qs.q: Why does Ms. Weaver first think the audience is going down?
qs.why: "I think the chart is upside down."

qs.q: What does Ms. Weaver want?
qs.why: "I want to see these numbers go up."

qs.q: What is on all the idea posters?
qs.why: 每张海报上都是猫。

lessons.title: I Was Minding My Own Business
lessons.zh: 我当时只是在管自己的事：目击抢劫

lines.en: Hello. I'm Guy Newsman with News Channel XYZ. I'm here in Washington, D.C. at the scene of a crime.
lines.zh: 大家好，我是 XYZ 新闻台的盖伊·纽斯曼。我现在在华盛顿的案发现场。

lines.en: We are talking with this woman.
lines.zh: 我们正在采访这位女士。

lines.en: She saw the crime during her lunch break. It looks like she hurt herself while she was trying to stop the crime.
lines.zh: 她午休时目击了这起案件。看起来她是在试图阻止犯罪时受的伤。

lines.en: Tell us your name.
lines.zh: 请告诉我们你的名字。

lines.en: Hi, Guy. I'm Anna.
lines.zh: 嗨，盖伊，我叫安娜。

lines.en: Anna, what did you see and what happened to your arm?
lines.zh: 安娜，你看到了什么？你的胳膊怎么了？

lines.en: Guy, I was minding my own business. See, I work over there.
lines.zh: 盖伊，我当时只是在管自己的事。你看，我在那边上班。

lines.en: Um-hum
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: I left work to get some lunch. Then suddenly, I heard a woman yelling. She was yelling like this ... "Help! Help!"
lines.zh: 我下班出来买午饭，突然听到一个女人在喊，她是这么喊的……“救命！救命！”

lines.en: Um-hum
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: Two robbers were grabbing her bag like this. She was hitting them with her umbrella.
lines.zh: 两个劫匪像这样抢她的包，她用雨伞打他们。

lines.en: Is that when you hurt your arm?
lines.zh: 你是那时候弄伤胳膊的？

lines.en: No. At that time, I was not fighting the robbers.
lines.zh: 不是。那时我没在和劫匪打。

lines.en: Um-hum.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: See. I was too far away and I didn't have my own umbrella.
lines.zh: 你看，我离得太远，而且我自己没带伞。

lines.en: So, what happened next?
lines.zh: 然后发生了什么？

lines.en: They grabbed her bag and ran away! So, I grabbed her umbrella and ran after the robbers.
lines.zh: 他们抢了她的包就跑！于是我抓起她的雨伞去追劫匪。

lines.en: Then that is the time that you hurt your arm?
lines.zh: 那就是你弄伤胳膊的时候？

lines.en: No. I was yelling, "Stop, robbers! Stop!" She was yelling, "Hey, come back with my umbrella!"
lines.zh: 不是。我喊着：“站住，劫匪！站住！”她喊着：“嘿，把我的伞还回来！”

lines.en: Were you afraid?
lines.zh: 你害怕吗？

lines.en: I had no time to be afraid, Guy. Well, I had time while I was resting on a bench. I had a lot of time.
lines.zh: 我根本没时间害怕，盖伊。嗯，我坐在长椅上休息时倒是有时间，有很多时间。

lines.en: Then what happened?
lines.zh: 然后呢？

lines.en: The robbers got on a bus. So, I ran after the bus.
lines.zh: 劫匪上了一辆公交车，我就追公交车。

lines.en: While I was running, I tripped and fell.
lines.zh: （旁白）我跑着跑着，绊了一跤摔倒了。

lines.en: And that is the time that you hurt your arm?
lines.zh: 那就是你弄伤胳膊的时候？

lines.en: No. While I was lying on the ground, someone stepped on my arm!
lines.zh: 不是。我躺在地上时，有人踩了我的胳膊！

lines.en: Ouch. That's too bad.
lines.zh: 哎哟，真倒霉。

lines.en: Yeah. And they didn't apologize. Well, then the robbers got themselves kicked off the bus.
lines.zh: 是啊，他们还没道歉。嗯，后来劫匪自己被赶下了公交车。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: They didn't pay. You've got to pay when you get on a bus. The police came and took them away.
lines.zh: 他们没买票。上公交车得付钱。警察来把他们带走了。

lines.en: And that's when you hurt your arm!
lines.zh: 那就是你弄伤胳膊的时候！

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: Then, when did you hurt yourself?
lines.zh: 那你到底是什么时候受的伤？

lines.en: Well, Guy, by this time, I was feeling very hungry. So, I went to my office to get a snack.
lines.zh: 嗯，盖伊，这时我已经饿坏了，所以我回办公室去拿点零食。

lines.en: Anna, I'm calling for help right now.
lines.zh: 安娜，我这就叫人来帮忙。

lines.en: (on the phone) Hello? Yes, please come right away. My co-worker is stuck in a vending machine.
lines.zh: （打电话）喂？是的，请马上来。我同事卡在自动售货机里了。

lines.en: You hurt your arm in a vending machine buying a bag of chips?
lines.zh: 你是在自动售货机买薯片时弄伤胳膊的？

lines.en: I was really hungry and the bag was stuck. I had to -
lines.zh: 我真的饿坏了，薯片又卡住了，我只好——

lines.en: That's all from News Channel XYZ. This is Guy Newsman saying goodbye.
lines.zh: XYZ 新闻台就报道到这里。盖伊·纽斯曼向您道别。

lines.en: Okay, we have to find ourselves another story, guys.
lines.zh: 好了，伙计们，我们得另找个新闻了。

lines.en: Until next time! Hi Mom!
lines.zh: 下次见！嗨，妈妈！

qs.q: What was Anna doing when she saw the crime?
qs.why: "I left work to get some lunch."

qs.q: How did the robbers get caught?
opts: They didn't pay for the bus.
qs.a: They didn't pay for the bus.
qs.why: 他们没买公交票被赶下车，警察把他们带走了。

qs.q: How did Anna really hurt her arm?
qs.why: "You hurt your arm in a vending machine buying a bag of chips?"

lessons.title: Time for Plan B
lessons.zh: 该用 B 计划了：钱包丢了

lines.en: Hey there! Tonight, I am teaching my ukulele class. It is far away. So, I am going to ride the Metro. Oh, no! I lost my wallet! It has my Metro card, my credit card and my money! Oh, no!
lines.zh: 嘿，大家好！今晚我要教尤克里里课。地方很远，所以我要坐地铁。哦不！我的钱包丢了！里面有我的地铁卡、信用卡和钱！哦不！

lines.en: It's times like this I remember my father's important words. He said, "Anna, never … " No wait, "Always have emergency money." ." (Anna pulls an envelope out of her bag and looks inside) It's empty. Time for Plan B. 'Extra Emergency Money.' (Anna pulls another envelope out of her bag and looks inside)
lines.zh: 这种时候我就想起爸爸的重要叮嘱。他说：“安娜，永远不要……”不对，等等，“永远要备着应急钱。”（安娜从包里掏出一个信封往里看）空的。该用 B 计划了：“额外应急钱”。（安娜又掏出一个信封往里看）

lines.en: No! It's empty too! Anna, it's time for Plan C.
lines.zh: 不！这个也是空的！安娜，该用 C 计划了。

lines.en: Hi, Marsha!
lines.zh: 嗨，玛莎！

lines.en: Hi Anna. What's up?
lines.zh: 嗨，安娜。怎么了？

lines.en: I'm stuck downtown without any money. Would you be able to come downtown? Please?
lines.zh: 我被困在市中心，身上一分钱都没有。你能来市中心一趟吗？拜托？

lines.en: Anna, I can't. I'm too busy. I have to give a big presentation in one hour. Sorry!
lines.zh: 安娜，我去不了，我太忙了。一小时后我要做一个重要的演示。抱歉！

lines.en: That's ok. Good luck with your presentation!
lines.zh: 没关系。祝你演示顺利！

lines.en: Thanks!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.en: Time for Plan D.
lines.zh: 该用 D 计划了。

lines.en: Hi, Jonathan! How's it going?
lines.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！最近怎么样？

lines.en: Hey, Anna. Things are great. What's up?
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜，挺好的。怎么了？

lines.en: Well, I was wondering if you could give me some money.
lines.zh: 嗯，我在想你能不能给我点钱。

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: See, I lost my wallet and I'm stuck downtown and I --
lines.zh: 是这样，我钱包丢了，被困在市中心，我——

lines.en: Anna, I wish I could. I'm at the airport with my mother. Her flight leaves in two hours.
lines.zh: 安娜，我真希望能帮你。我在机场送我妈妈，她的航班两小时后起飞。

lines.en: That's okay. Tell your Mom to have a nice trip!
lines.zh: 没关系。替我祝你妈妈旅途愉快！

lines.en: I do wish I could help. Thanks.
lines.zh: 我真希望能帮上忙。谢谢。

lines.en: 'Bye.
lines.zh: 拜拜。

lines.en: This is serious. Time for … Plan E.
lines.zh: 这下严重了。该用……E 计划了。

lines.en: Hello.
lines.zh: 喂。

lines.en: Hi, Ashley! What are you doing?
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！你在干嘛？

lines.en: Oh! Hi Anna!
lines.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜！

lines.en: (Anna hears a child crying through the phone.) Ashley, I was wondering, uh, would you be able to come downtown? And could you give me $20?
lines.zh: （安娜从电话里听到小孩在哭）阿什莉，我在想，呃，你能来市中心一趟吗？能给我 20 美元吗？

lines.en: Anna, I can't.
lines.zh: 安娜，我去不了。

lines.en: I'll pay you back the money. I promise.
lines.zh: 我会还你钱的，我保证。

lines.en: Anna, I'm not worried about the money. I'm babysitting. (off-camera to niece) That was very, very, bad!
lines.zh: 安娜，我不是担心钱，我在看孩子。（对侄女）这样非常、非常不好！

lines.en: Well, losing your wallet is bad, but it's not the end of the world, Ashley.
lines.zh: 嗯，丢钱包是挺糟的，不过也不是世界末日，阿什莉。

lines.en: I was talking to my niece, Anna.
lines.zh: 我是在跟我侄女说话，安娜。

lines.en: Well, thanks anyway, Ashley!
lines.zh: 好吧，还是谢谢你，阿什莉！

lines.en: Good luck getting money.
lines.zh: 祝你弄到钱。

lines.en: Good luck babysitting!
lines.zh: 祝你看孩子顺利！

lines.en: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Well, Plans A, B, C, D and E did not work. Think, Anna, think. Time for Plan F.
lines.zh: 好吧，A、B、C、D、E 计划都不行。想想，安娜，想想。该用 F 计划了。

lines.en: (singing) Won't you give, could -- Thank you very much, sir! -- would you give me money, won't you give -- Thank you very much! -- could you give, won't you give me money -- until next time! -- won't you give me money?
lines.zh: （唱歌）你能不能给，能不能——太谢谢您了，先生！——你能给我点钱吗，能不能给——太谢谢了！——你能给，能不能给我点钱——下次见！——能不能给我点钱？

qs.q: What was in Anna's wallet?
opts: her Metro card, credit card and money
qs.a: her Metro card, credit card and money
qs.why: "It has my Metro card, my credit card and my money!"

qs.q: Why can't Jonathan help?
opts: He is at the airport with his mother.
qs.a: He is at the airport with his mother.
qs.why: "I'm at the airport with my mother."

qs.q: What is Plan F?
qs.why: 她唱歌请路人给钱。

lessons.title: Making Healthy Choices
lessons.zh: 做出健康的选择：健康食品和垃圾食品

lines.en: Hi there, Ashley!
lines.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

lines.en: Anna! Hi! Where are you going?
lines.zh: 安娜！嗨！你去哪儿？

lines.en: (Anna's stomach growls loudly)
lines.zh: （安娜的肚子咕咕叫）

lines.en: What was that?
lines.zh: 那是什么声音？

lines.en: I'm hungry. When I'm hungry, I only want to eat junk food! But I know I should eat healthy food. So, I fight with myself. One side says, 'You should eat healthy food.' The other side says, 'But I want to eat junk food!'
lines.zh: 我饿了。我一饿就只想吃垃圾食品！可我知道我应该吃健康食品。所以我跟自己打架。一边说：“你应该吃健康食品。”另一边说：“可我想吃垃圾食品！”

lines.en: Well, Anna, go to the Giant supermarket. You should be able to find all kinds of food there - for all of you.
lines.zh: 嗯，安娜，去 Giant 超市吧。在那儿你应该能找到各种吃的——满足所有的你。

lines.en: Good idea, Ashley. See you later!
lines.zh: 好主意，阿什莉。回头见！

lines.en: 'Bye, Anna.
lines.zh: 拜拜，安娜。

lines.en: Wow! This supermarket is huge! Look at all of these fruits and vegetables! I should eat more vegetables.
lines.zh: 哇！这超市好大！看这么多水果蔬菜！我应该多吃蔬菜。

lines.en: Good idea, Anna. You must eat more vegetables … like celery!
lines.zh: 好主意，安娜。你必须多吃蔬菜……比如芹菜！

lines.en: Celery?! Do you know what the web says about celery?
lines.zh: 芹菜？！你知道网上怎么说芹菜吗？

lines.en: No, what?
lines.zh: 不知道，怎么说？

lines.en: "Celery is 95 percent water - 100 percent NOT ice cream. I love the web!"
lines.zh: “芹菜 95% 是水——100% 不是冰淇淋。我爱网络！”

lines.en: Anna, you mustn't eat junk food. Junk food will kill you.
lines.zh: 安娜，你不能吃垃圾食品。垃圾食品会要了你的命。

lines.en: You are being silly.
lines.zh: 你真傻。

lines.en: No, you are!
lines.zh: 不，你才傻！

lines.en: No, you are.
lines.zh: 不，你才是。

lines.en: Will you two please be nice to each other? It is important to eat healthy foods. But, a little junk food will not kill me. Hmm, ice cream. Ice cream does sound good.
lines.zh: 你们俩能不能友好点？吃健康食品很重要。不过吃一点垃圾食品要不了我的命。嗯，冰淇淋。冰淇淋听起来不错。

lines.en: Take this cart to the frozen food aisle!
lines.zh: 推车去冷冻食品区！

lines.en: No wait, go back! Go back! We forgot fruit. Go back!!
lines.zh: 不，等等，回去！回去！我们忘了水果。回去！！

lines.en: Okay, we are in the frozen food aisle!
lines.zh: 好了，我们到冷冻食品区了！

lines.en: Mmm, ice cream!
lines.zh: 嗯，冰淇淋！

lines.en: Mmm, frozen peas!
lines.zh: 嗯，冷冻豌豆！

lines.en: Nobody says, 'Mmm, frozen peas. They say, 'Mmm, ice cream!
lines.zh: 没人会说“嗯，冷冻豌豆”，人们只会说“嗯，冰淇淋！”

lines.en: Mmm, frozen peas!!
lines.zh: 嗯，冷冻豌豆！！

lines.en: Mmm, ice cream!!
lines.zh: 嗯，冰淇淋！！

lines.en: I am not going to tell you two again! Stop fighting!
lines.zh: 我不想再说第二遍！别吵了！

lines.en: I smell fresh bread! I love the smells of a bakery!
lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜面包的味道了！我爱面包店的香味！

lines.en: Oh, Anna, let's buy a fresh loaf of whole wheat, organic bread!
lines.zh: 哦，安娜，我们买一条新鲜的有机全麦面包吧！

lines.en: You don't have to buy bread. Buy some donuts, Anna!
lines.zh: 你不用买面包。买点甜甜圈吧，安娜！

lines.en: You mustn't buy donuts. They are only fat and sugar.
lines.zh: 你不能买甜甜圈，那里面只有脂肪和糖。

lines.en: Exactly! You know, you are really no fun at all.
lines.zh: 没错！你知道吗，你真是一点都不好玩。

lines.en: And you must think having high cholesterol is fun.
lines.zh: 你肯定觉得胆固醇高很好玩。

lines.en: Everyone likes donuts! That is why you don't have friends!
lines.zh: 人人都爱甜甜圈！所以你才没朋友！

lines.en: And that is why your cholesterol is so high!
lines.zh: 所以你的胆固醇才那么高！

lines.en: My cholesterol is none of your business!!
lines.zh: 我的胆固醇不关你的事！！

lines.en: And I have lots of friends!!
lines.zh: 我朋友多得很！！

lines.en: Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! I am sick and tired of the both of you!!
lines.zh: 别吵了！别吵了！别吵了！我受够你们俩了！！

lines.en: I know what you two need!
lines.zh: 我知道你们俩需要什么！

lines.en: Anna! What are you doing?
lines.zh: 安娜！你干什么？

lines.en: Put me down!
lines.zh: 放我下来！

lines.en: You two need to cool off!
lines.zh: 你们俩需要冷静一下！

lines.en: I am going to go buy my healthy food and my junk food! Good bye!
lines.zh: 我要去买我的健康食品和垃圾食品了！再见！

lines.en: Until next time …
lines.zh: 下次见……

qs.q: What does Anna want to eat when she is hungry?
qs.why: "When I'm hungry, I only want to eat junk food!"

qs.q: Who are "Healthy" and "Junky"?
qs.why: “健康”和“垃圾”是安娜脑子里两种想法。

qs.q: What does Anna buy at the end?
qs.why: "I am going to go buy my healthy food and my junk food!"

lessons.title: This Land is Your Land
lessons.zh: 这片土地是你的土地：自驾游美国

lines.en: You know I love Washington, D.C. But I want to see more of the United States. My roommate Marsha and I will be on vacation at the same time. So, we are going on a road trip together!
lines.zh: 你知道我爱华盛顿，不过我想多看看美国。我的室友玛莎和我正好同时休假，所以我们要一起自驾游！

lines.en: Hi, Marsha!
lines.zh: 嗨，玛莎！

lines.en: Hi!
lines.zh: 嗨！

lines.en: I packed my bags and I am ready to go!
lines.zh: 我收拾好行李，准备出发了！

lines.en: Did you make a list of all the places you want to see?
lines.zh: 你把想去的地方都列成清单了吗？

lines.en: I did. I want to see New York City and the Statue of Liberty!
lines.zh: 列了。我想去纽约看自由女神像！

lines.en: And I want to see Mount Rushmore!
lines.zh: 我想去拉什莫尔山！

lines.en: (Anna writes) Mount Rushmore.
lines.zh: （安娜写下）拉什莫尔山。

lines.en: And don't forget the Grand Canyon!
lines.zh: 别忘了大峡谷！

lines.en: (Anna writes) Let's not forget California's redwood forest! There are so many places to see!
lines.zh: （安娜写下）也别忘了加州的红杉林！要看的地方太多了！

lines.en: We will be driving for a long time. So, we might get bored.
lines.zh: 我们要开很久的车，可能会无聊。

lines.en: Bored? No way! We can talk.
lines.zh: 无聊？不会的！我们可以聊天。

lines.en: Or not talk.
lines.zh: 或者不聊天。

lines.en: We can play word games. We can sing! You know, our trip is like that famous American song. (sings)
lines.zh: 我们可以玩文字游戏，可以唱歌！你知道吗，我们这趟旅行就像那首有名的美国歌。（唱起来）

lines.en: (sings the song)
lines.zh: （玛莎接着唱这首歌）

lines.en: (Anna and Marsha sing together)
lines.zh: （两人一起唱《This Land Is Your Land》）

lines.en: Will we be stopping soon?
lines.zh: 我们很快会停车吗？

lines.en: We won't be stopping soon.
lines.zh: 不会很快停。

lines.en: I'm hungry.
lines.zh: 我饿了。

lines.en: Marsha, we just left D.C.! We'll be eating lunch in about 2 hours. Can you wait?
lines.zh: 玛莎，我们才刚离开华盛顿！大概两小时后吃午饭，你能等吗？

lines.en: I guess.
lines.zh: 应该能吧。

lines.en: Here, have an apple. It's organic!
lines.zh: 给，吃个苹果。有机的！

lines.en: (Anna throws the apple. It goes out the window.)
lines.zh: （安娜扔苹果，苹果飞出了窗外）

lines.en: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Okay, we will be arriving in New York City very soon!
lines.zh: 好，我们马上就要到纽约了！

lines.en: I can't wait to see The Big Apple! Marsha, look! There she is!
lines.zh: 我等不及要看“大苹果”了！玛莎，看！她在那儿！

lines.en: The Statue of Liberty!
lines.zh: 自由女神像！

lines.en: She is awesome!
lines.zh: 她太棒了！

lines.en: Marsha, in ten minutes, guess what we'll be seeing?
lines.zh: 玛莎，猜猜十分钟后我们会看到什么？

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: The largest rocking chair in the world!
lines.zh: 世界上最大的摇椅！

lines.en: No, we won't be seeing that.
lines.zh: 不，我们不会去看那个。

lines.en: Marsha, it's on my other list -- Best Roadside Sights.
lines.zh: 玛莎，那在我的另一张清单上——最佳路边景点。

lines.en: (Marsha grabs the paper and throws it out the window.)
lines.zh: （玛莎抓过纸扔出窗外）

lines.en: Oh no! We littered! And my list is gone. Don't worry. I brought the book. (lifts up large book, starts reading)
lines.zh: 哦不！我们乱扔垃圾了！清单也没了。别担心，我带了书。（举起一本大书开始念）

lines.en: (Later)
lines.zh: （后来）

lines.en: … and that is why I am so afraid of sheep.
lines.zh: ……这就是我那么怕羊的原因。

lines.en: (snores a little)
lines.zh: （玛莎轻轻打鼾）

lines.en: Wow, I feel better. Marsha, you are a great listener.
lines.zh: 哇，我感觉好多了。玛莎，你真是个好听众。

lines.en: (waking up) Where are we?
lines.zh: （醒过来）我们在哪儿？

lines.en: We will be entering North Dakota any minute now!
lines.zh: 我们马上就要进入北达科他州了！

lines.en: North Dakota! We are going in the wrong direction! We want to go to South Dakota!
lines.zh: 北达科他！我们走反了！我们要去南达科他！

lines.en: No problem. I will just exit the highway. We will be going south … in just a minute. There. Done! We're going south! Okay, we will be stopping for gas and a bathroom break in about an hour.
lines.zh: 没问题。我下高速就行。我们马上……往南开。好了，搞定！我们在往南开！好，大概一小时后我们停车加油、上厕所。

lines.en: Then we will be very near to Mount Rushmore!
lines.zh: 那我们就离拉什莫尔山很近了！

lines.en: Yay! Dead presidents' heads on the side of a mountain!
lines.zh: 耶！山壁上的已故总统头像！

lines.en: We did it, Marsha! We made it to California! It's beautiful!
lines.zh: 我们做到了，玛莎！我们到加州了！真美！

lines.en: And we saw everything on the list!
lines.zh: 清单上的地方我们都看到了！

lines.en: Well, we saw everything on page 1 of the list.
lines.zh: 嗯，清单第 1 页上的我们都看到了。

lines.en: What do you mean "page 1?"
lines.zh: 什么叫“第 1 页”？

lines.en: Oh. Here are pages 2, 3 and 4! We'll be very busy driving back to Washington, D.C. Until next time … !
lines.zh: 哦，这是第 2、3、4 页！开车回华盛顿的路上我们会很忙的。下次见……！

qs.q: Where do Anna and Marsha go first?
qs.why: 他们先到纽约看自由女神像。

qs.q: Why do they go the wrong way?
opts: They drive to North Dakota, not South Dakota.
qs.a: They drive to North Dakota, not South Dakota.
qs.why: "We are going in the wrong direction! We want to go to South Dakota!"

qs.q: Did they see everything on Anna's list?
qs.why: "we saw everything on page 1 of the list."

lessons.title: May I Borrow That?
lessons.zh: 我能借用一下吗？办公用品生日礼物

lines.en: Have a nice day at work Marsha!
lines.zh: 上班愉快，玛莎！

lines.en: You too, Anna. Oh, wait. Do you have pen and paper I can borrow?
lines.zh: 你也是，安娜。哦，等等，你有纸和笔借我用一下吗？

lines.en: Of course.
lines.zh: 当然。

lines.en: We are meeting at this restaurant tonight.
lines.zh: 我们今晚在这家餐厅见。

lines.en: What is happening tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚有什么事？

lines.en: Today is my birthday. We are celebrating at 7pm tonight. Did you forget?
lines.zh: 今天是我生日。今晚 7 点我们庆祝。你忘了？

lines.en: Sorry, Marsha! I gotta go! See you later!
lines.zh: 对不起，玛莎！我得走了！回头见！

lines.en: Don't forget! Tonight … 7pm!
lines.zh: 别忘了！今晚……7 点！

lines.en: I forgot Marsha's birthday! And I don't get my paycheck until next week. I know. I'll make her a gift. I'll just have to borrow a couple of things.
lines.zh: 我忘了玛莎的生日！我的工资下周才发。有了，我给她做个礼物。我只需要借几样东西。

lines.en: Amelia, may I borrow your stapler?
lines.zh: 阿米莉亚，我能借你的订书机吗？

lines.en: Sure. I can lend you my stapler, Anna. But please return it. It's my favorite stapler.
lines.zh: 当然，我可以借给你订书机，安娜。不过请一定还我，这是我最喜欢的订书机。

lines.en: You can trust me. I understand. One time, I loaned my stapler to the wrong person.
lines.zh: 你可以信任我。我理解。有一次我把订书机借错了人。

lines.en: Thanks, Amelia.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，阿米莉亚。

lines.en: Don't mention it. Bye, stapler!
lines.zh: 别客气。再见，订书机！

lines.en: Jonathan! Can I borrow your scissors?
lines.zh: 乔纳森！我能借你的剪刀吗？

lines.en: Oh! Hi, Anna! What're you doing?
lines.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜！你在干什么？

lines.en: Can I borrow your scissors? Sorry to bother you.
lines.zh: 我能借你的剪刀吗？抱歉打扰你。

lines.en: Yes, I can lend them to you, but you must return them. These scissors -- they are the sharpest scissors in the office. Watch.
lines.zh: 能，我可以借给你，但你必须还回来。这把剪刀是全办公室最锋利的。看。

lines.en: Wow, those are sharp. I will be very careful.
lines.zh: 哇，真锋利。我会很小心的。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: And I'll bring them back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我明天就还回来。

lines.en: Good.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢你。

lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.zh: 不客气。

lines.en: Happy Birthday, Marsha! (gives Marsha a gift)
lines.zh: 生日快乐，玛莎！（递给玛莎礼物）

lines.en: Thanks, Anna! I love birthday gifts! Anna, it is … interesting. What is it?
lines.zh: 谢谢你，安娜！我爱生日礼物！安娜，这……挺特别的。这是什么？

lines.en: Well, I know you love hats. And you need office supplies. So, this is your own office supply hat!
lines.zh: 嗯，我知道你喜欢帽子，你又需要办公用品。所以，这是你专属的办公用品帽！

lines.en: Wow! That is a lot of office supplies!
lines.zh: 哇！好多办公用品啊！

lines.en: Many people loaned or shared their supplies with me. Some people really love their office supplies. It has paper, pens, tape, erasers, rubber bands, binder clips, paper clips, and a light!
lines.zh: 好多人把用品借给我或者分给我。有些人真的很爱他们的办公用品。上面有纸、笔、胶带、橡皮、橡皮筋、长尾夹、回形针，还有一盏灯！

lines.en: What is the balloon for?
lines.zh: 气球是干什么用的？

lines.en: The balloon will help your friends find you. Let's try it! You get a seat in the restaurant - I will find you!
lines.zh: 气球能让你的朋友找到你。我们试试！你去餐厅找个座位——我来找你！

lines.en: Sometimes all the money in the world can't buy the perfect gift. Until next time!
lines.zh: 有时候，花再多钱也买不到完美的礼物。下次见！

qs.q: Why is Anna worried?
qs.why: "I forgot Marsha's birthday!"

qs.q: What does Anna borrow from Jonathan?
qs.why: "Can I borrow your scissors?"

qs.q: What is Anna's gift?
qs.why: "this is your own office supply hat!"

lessons.title: How Can I help?
lessons.zh: 我能帮什么忙？帮皮特修车

lines.en: Hi, Pete. What are you doing?
lines.zh: 嗨，皮特。你在干什么？

lines.en: Oh! Hi, Anna. Right now, I am fixing my car.
lines.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜。我在修我的车。

lines.en: How's it going?
lines.zh: 修得怎么样？

lines.en: It's going … not so good.
lines.zh: 修得……不太好。

lines.en: How can I help? I was planning to visit some friends. But if you need help, I can help. I like helping.
lines.zh: 我能帮什么忙？我本来打算去看朋友，不过你需要的话我可以帮忙。我喜欢帮忙。

lines.en: Anna, I can fix it myself. But thanks.
lines.zh: 安娜，我自己能修好。不过谢谢。

lines.en: Pete, I think I found your problem. These are spark plugs. (holds them up)
lines.zh: 皮特，我想我找到你的问题了。这些是火花塞。（举起来）

lines.en: They start the engine.
lines.zh: 它们是用来启动发动机的。

lines.en: I know that, Anna. But there were too many spark plugs … in there. So I took out the extra ones.
lines.zh: 这我知道，安娜。可里面的火花塞……太多了，所以我把多余的拿出来了。

lines.en: There are no extras, Pete. You need all of them. Pete, can you fix a car yourself?
lines.zh: 没有多余的，皮特，你全都需要。皮特，你会自己修车吗？

lines.en: Well, Anna, last night I was watching the online video course, "You CAN Fix a Car Yourself!"
lines.zh: 嗯，安娜，昨晚我在看网课《你能自己修车！》。

lines.en: Yes, you CAN fix your car yourself!
lines.zh: 没错，你能自己修车！

lines.en: And I watched the first 10 lessons. So, I think I know what I'm doing.
lines.zh: 我看了前 10 课，所以我觉得我知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: How many lessons are there?
lines.zh: 一共多少课？

lines.en: Four hundred and fifty.
lines.zh: 四百五十课。

lines.en: 450! That'll take too long! If I fix your car, I'll have it running in 10 to 15 minutes.
lines.zh: 450 课！那太久了！要是我来修，10 到 15 分钟就能让它跑起来。

lines.en: Where're your tools?
lines.zh: 你的工具呢？

lines.en: I have this. (puts a useless tool in her hand). And this. (hands her another useless tool)
lines.zh: 我有这个。（把一件没用的工具放到她手里）还有这个。（又递给她一件没用的工具）

lines.en: Great. Um, I'll get my tools. I'll be back in a flash!
lines.zh: 很好。嗯，我去拿我的工具，马上回来！

lines.en: But, Anna, I don't need your ...
lines.zh: 可是，安娜，我不需要你的……

lines.en: (She goes and quickly comes back with tools.)
lines.zh: （她去拿了工具，很快就回来了）

lines.en: … help.
lines.zh: ……帮忙。

lines.en: Pete, when I was a teenager, I was fixing cars -- myself. I learned from a master.
lines.zh: 皮特，我十几岁时就在修车了——自己修。我跟大师学的。

lines.en: You can trust me.
lines.zh: 你可以相信我。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: Great! But we need teamwork. You sit in the car. When I say "go," you start the engine.
lines.zh: 太好了！不过我们需要团队合作。你坐到车里，我说“开”，你就启动发动机。

lines.en: Okay, go! ​
lines.zh: 好，开！

lines.en: Stop!
lines.zh: 停！

lines.en: Okay, go! Huh.
lines.zh: 好，开！嗯。

lines.en: It's not starting! It's not starting!
lines.zh: 启动不了！启动不了！

lines.en: What's wrong?
lines.zh: 怎么了？

lines.en: This car is stupid … stupid, stupid!
lines.zh: 这破车……破车，破车！

lines.en: Pete, kicking the tires will not help.
lines.zh: 皮特，踢轮胎没用。

lines.en: Well, you did not help, Anna. You did not help!!
lines.zh: 嗯，你也没帮上忙，安娜。你没帮上忙！！

lines.en: Pete, Pete! Pull yourself together, man. Give me the keys. I must feel the key in the ignition and turn it myself.
lines.zh: 皮特，皮特！振作点，伙计。把钥匙给我。我得自己感受钥匙插在点火开关里，自己拧。

lines.en: Use the key, Anna. Turn the key, Anna. What are you forgetting, Anna?
lines.zh: 用钥匙，安娜。拧钥匙，安娜。你忘了什么，安娜？

lines.en: Pete. Pete.
lines.zh: 皮特。皮特。

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: You are out of gas.
lines.zh: 你没油了。

lines.en: I can't be out of gas. (looks at gauge) I'm out of gas. Sorry, Anna. I'll go get some.
lines.zh: 不可能没油。（看油表）我没油了。对不起，安娜，我去加点。

lines.en: Pete. You relax. Clean your face. You can watch the rest of your online video course. It'll be faster if I go … in a flash. Until next time …
lines.zh: 皮特，你放松，洗洗脸，接着看你的网课吧。我去会快一些……一眨眼就回来。下次见……

qs.q: What is Pete doing?
qs.why: "Right now, I am fixing my car."

qs.q: How many lessons does Pete's online course have?
qs.why: "Four hundred and fifty."

qs.q: What is really wrong with the car?
qs.why: "You are out of gas."

lessons.title: Have You Ever ...?
lessons.zh: 你有没有……？给游客推荐博物馆

lines.en: Hello! I have lived in Washington, D.C. for a long time now. And I have done a lot. I feel that I know this city pretty well. (walks off and comes back) That's the wrong way. Where is it again?
lines.zh: 你好！我在华盛顿住了很久了，做了很多事。我觉得我对这座城市挺熟的。（走开又回来）走错了。到底在哪儿来着？

lines.en: (sees a tourist at a sign) Excuse me, can I help you? Have we met before?
lines.zh: （看到一位游客在指示牌前）打扰一下，需要帮忙吗？我们以前见过吗？

lines.en: I don't think so. I've just flown in from Boston. My name is Jean.
lines.zh: 我想没有。我刚从波士顿飞过来。我叫琼。

lines.en: Hi, Jean! I'm Anna. I really feel like we've met before. Anyway, how can I help?
lines.zh: 嗨，琼！我是安娜。我真觉得我们以前见过。总之，有什么能帮你的？

lines.en: I want to see an interesting museum but I don't know which one.
lines.zh: 我想去看一家有意思的博物馆，可我不知道去哪家。

lines.en: I can help with that. I've lived in Washington, D.C. a long time. I think I've seen all the museums.
lines.zh: 这我能帮上忙。我在华盛顿住了很久，我想所有博物馆我都去过了。

lines.en: Wow, thanks. So, tell me, which museums are good?
lines.zh: 哇，谢谢。那你说说，哪些博物馆好？

lines.en: Well, they are all good. But they're all different. There are science museums and history museums and art and culture museums.
lines.zh: 嗯，都很好，只是各不相同。有科学博物馆、历史博物馆，还有艺术和文化博物馆。

lines.en: I want to see an unusual museum.
lines.zh: 我想看一家不寻常的博物馆。

lines.en: I like the Sculpture Garden. Have you ever seen sculptures in a garden? It is really artistic!
lines.zh: 我喜欢雕塑园。你在花园里看过雕塑吗？很有艺术感！

lines.en: I have never seen a garden of sculptures! I'll write that on my list!
lines.zh: 我从没看过雕塑花园！我把它写在清单上！

lines.en: Have you been to the Museum of the American Indian? I've visited that museum many times. It is very peaceful.
lines.zh: 你去过美国印第安人博物馆吗？我去过好多次，那里很宁静。

lines.en: I have always liked American Indian culture.
lines.zh: 我一直很喜欢美洲印第安文化。

lines.en: I'll put that on my list. (writes on list) Do you have any other suggestions?
lines.zh: 我把它也写上。（写清单）你还有别的建议吗？

lines.en: Well, if you like plants, you can visit the U.S. Botanic Gardens. It's very organic.
lines.zh: 嗯，如果你喜欢植物，可以去美国植物园，那里很有自然气息。

lines.en: I have always loved plants. I'll write that on my list, too! Wow, you know so much about D.C.'s museums.
lines.zh: 我一直爱植物，这个也写上！哇，你对华盛顿的博物馆真了解。

lines.en: Well, I have lived here for over a year.
lines.zh: 嗯，我在这儿住了一年多了。

lines.en: You're so lucky to live in such a beautiful city filled with so many museums and a zoo!
lines.zh: 你真幸运，住在这么美的城市，有这么多博物馆，还有动物园！

lines.en: What? D.C. has a zoo?
lines.zh: 什么？华盛顿有动物园？

lines.en: Yes, and it's beautiful. You've lived here for so long and you haven't been to the zoo?
lines.zh: 是啊，而且很漂亮。你在这儿住了这么久，还没去过动物园？

lines.en: I've never been to D.C.'s zoo. I've never been to any zoos!
lines.zh: 我从没去过华盛顿的动物园。我哪个动物园都没去过！

lines.en: You have never seen zoo animals?
lines.zh: 你从没见过动物园里的动物？

lines.en: I grew up on a farm, Jean. I've known farm animals my whole life.
lines.zh: 琼，我是在农场长大的。我这辈子认识的都是农场动物。

lines.en: But the zoo has lions (makes sound of lion roaring) and elephants (makes sound of elephant trumpeting) and zebras (makes no sound)! If you have never seen a real, live elephant, you must. They are so majestic.
lines.zh: 可动物园有狮子（学狮子吼）、大象（学大象叫）、还有斑马（没出声）！你要是没见过活生生的大象，一定得去看看。它们太威风了。

lines.en: I will. I will! (writes list) There. I've written my own must-see zoo animal list!
lines.zh: 我会的，我会的！（写清单）好了，我写好了我必看的动物清单！

lines.en: Have fun at the zoo and thanks, Anna!
lines.zh: 在动物园玩得开心，谢谢你，安娜！

lines.en: Have fun at the museums, Jean! And thank YOU!
lines.zh: 在博物馆玩得开心，琼！也谢谢你！

lines.en: This has been awesome! And I have seen every animal on my list! Jean, the tourist, helped me see more of my city. But where have I seen her before?
lines.zh: 今天太棒了！我清单上的动物都看到了！游客琼帮我看到了我这座城市的更多地方。可我在哪儿见过她呢？

lines.en: Oh well. Until next time …
lines.zh: 算了。下次见……

qs.q: Where is Jean from?
qs.why: "I've just flown in from Boston."

qs.q: Which place does Anna NOT suggest?
qs.why: 她推荐了雕塑园、美国印第安人博物馆和植物园。

qs.q: What has Anna never done in D.C.?
qs.why: "I've never been to D.C.'s zoo."

lessons.title: Operation Spy!
lessons.zh: 间谍行动！参观国际间谍博物馆

lines.en: It is no secret that Washington, D.C. has spies. Well, it should be a secret because spying is secret. But it's not a secret. There's even a spy museum! The International Spy Museum has created an amazing collection of spy things! And today, we will see them! My boss, Ms. Weaver, has sent me here … on a mission!
lines.zh: 华盛顿有间谍，这不是秘密。嗯，这本该是秘密，因为间谍活动就是秘密的，可它不是秘密，这里甚至有一家间谍博物馆！国际间谍博物馆收藏了很多了不起的间谍物品！今天我们就去看看！我的上司韦弗女士派我来这儿……执行任务！

lines.en: Hello, Anna, are you there?
lines.zh: 你好，安娜，你在吗？

lines.en: That's her. Yes, Agent Peacock. This is Agent Flamingo, reporting for duty.
lines.zh: 是她。是的，孔雀特工。我是火烈鸟特工，前来报到。

lines.en: Agent what? Look, Anna … I mean, Agent Flamingo, I want you to learn all you can about spying.
lines.zh: 什么特工？听着，安娜……我是说火烈鸟特工，我要你尽可能多地了解间谍活动。

lines.en: You mean, collect intelligence?
lines.zh: 您是说，搜集情报？

lines.en: Yeah, it's for our new show -- "D.C. Secrets."
lines.zh: 对，是为我们的新节目——《华盛顿秘闻》。

lines.en: You've got it, Agent Peacock. The mission is safe with me.
lines.zh: 明白，孔雀特工。任务交给我放心吧。

lines.en: Oh, okay, great. Just be back by noon.
lines.zh: 哦，好，很好。中午前回来就行。

lines.en: Agent Peacock, I'm at an air duct!
lines.zh: 孔雀特工，我在一个通风管道前！

lines.en: Yes, spies sometimes sneak down air ducts.
lines.zh: 是的，间谍有时会偷偷钻通风管道。

lines.en: I have never snuck down an air duct. It's dark and small. I'm afraid of dark, small places.
lines.zh: 我从没钻过通风管道。又黑又窄，我怕又黑又窄的地方。

lines.en: You can do it, Agent Flamingo. You know, spies aren't afraid of a little darkness.
lines.zh: 你能行的，火烈鸟特工。你知道，间谍可不怕一点黑。

lines.en: Right. It's just an air duct -- a dark, small air duct. Okay. I'm doing it, Agent Peacock! I am sneaking down a long, dark, small air duct. I'm having a little trouble breathing.
lines.zh: 对，这只是个通风管道——一个又黑又窄的通风管道。好，我钻了，孔雀特工！我正偷偷钻过一条又长又黑又窄的通风管道。我有点喘不过气。

lines.en: Just keep going, Agent Flamingo. Think of the team!
lines.zh: 继续，火烈鸟特工。想想团队！

lines.en: Okay, I will think of the team. I'm thinking of the team, Agent Peacock! I did it! I did it! I sneaked down an air duct. That was a little uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 好，我想着团队。我在想着团队，孔雀特工！我做到了！我做到了！我钻过了通风管道。有点不舒服。

lines.en: Good!
lines.zh: 很好！

lines.en: What's the next mission?
lines.zh: 下一个任务是什么？

lines.en: Umm … have you ever cracked a code?
lines.zh: 嗯……你破解过密码吗？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: Well, go learn. Spies use their brains.
lines.zh: 那就去学。间谍要动脑子。

lines.en: Got it! I've never cracked a code before. Let's try, Agent Flamingo! This is really hard. I'm still trying to crack the code. I've cracked the code! I've cracked the code, Agent Peacock! My brain really hurts.
lines.zh: 明白！我从没破解过密码。试试吧，火烈鸟特工！这真难。我还在破解。我破解了！我破解了密码，孔雀特工！我的脑子好疼。

lines.en: Great. Umm, Agent Flamingo, now answer this question: Do spies have to be in good shape?
lines.zh: 很好。嗯，火烈鸟特工，现在回答这个问题：间谍必须身体好吗？

lines.en: "Yes," Agent Peacock! Spies have to be in really good shape! Can you hear me?
lines.zh: “是的”，孔雀特工！间谍必须身体非常好！你听得到我吗？

lines.en: You're breaking up, Flamingo.
lines.zh: 你的信号断断续续的，火烈鸟。

lines.en: The International Spy Museum is awesome! Agent Peacock, I completed the mission!
lines.zh: 国际间谍博物馆太棒了！孔雀特工，我完成任务了！

lines.en: Great. Great. Now, I have another very important mission for you.
lines.zh: 很好，很好。现在，我还有一个非常重要的任务给你。

lines.en: Got it. See you back at H.Q.!
lines.zh: 明白。总部见！

lines.en: Yummy! You brought my lunch! Thanks, Agent Flamingo!
lines.zh: 好吃！你把我的午饭带来了！谢谢你，火烈鸟特工！

lines.en: Mission completed. Agent Peacock!
lines.zh: 任务完成，孔雀特工！

lines.en: Don't ask.
lines.zh: 别问了。

qs.q: What is Anna's spy name?
qs.why: "This is Agent Flamingo, reporting for duty."

qs.q: Why is the air duct hard for Anna?
opts: She is afraid of dark, small places.
qs.a: She is afraid of dark, small places.
qs.why: "I'm afraid of dark, small places."

qs.q: What is Anna's last "very important mission"?
qs.why: "You brought my lunch!"

lessons.title: Back to School
lessons.zh: 回到学校：violins 还是 violence？

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Georgetown University in Washington, D.C.! I am going back to school! Georgetown is the oldest Catholic and Jesuit university in the United States. The Jesuits are a religious order known worldwide for their many colleges and universities. Students have been studying here since 1792!
lines.zh: 你好，欢迎来到华盛顿的乔治城大学！我要重返校园了！乔治城大学是美国最古老的天主教耶稣会大学。耶稣会是一个宗教团体，以创办众多学院和大学闻名世界。从 1792 年起学生们就在这里学习了！

lines.en: Hey, are you finished with your report?
lines.zh: 嘿，你的报告写完了吗？

lines.en: Almost. I have been writing and re-writing since last night! The subject is really interesting to me.
lines.zh: 快了。我从昨晚一直写写改改到现在！我对这个题目很感兴趣。

lines.en: Me too! I have been studying this topic for a long time.
lines.zh: 我也是！这个题目我研究很久了。

lines.en: Am I late?
lines.zh: 我迟到了吗？

lines.en: You're a little late. But don't worry. The professor isn't here yet.
lines.zh: 有点晚，不过别担心，教授还没来。

lines.en: How long has the class been waiting?
lines.zh: 大家等了多久了？

lines.en: We've only been waiting for about 10 minutes.
lines.zh: 我们只等了大概 10 分钟。

lines.en: Oh good. Oh, no! I forgot my pencil sharpener. Excuse me, do you have a pencil sharpener I can borrow?
lines.zh: 哦，那就好。哦不！我忘带卷笔刀了。打扰一下，你有卷笔刀借我用吗？

lines.en: No, sorry.
lines.zh: 没有，抱歉。

lines.en: Oh wait. I found my extra one! Whew, that was close.
lines.zh: 哦，等等，我找到我备用的了！呼，好险。

lines.en: So, how long have you been studying at Georgetown?
lines.zh: 那么，你在乔治城读多久了？

lines.en: I've been studying here since 2015.
lines.zh: 我从 2015 年开始在这儿读书。

lines.en: Awesome. You know, I've been wanting to go back to school for a long time. So, here I am!
lines.zh: 太棒了。你知道吗，我想重返校园想了很久了，所以我来了！

lines.en: Well, you picked a great school. I've been really happy here.
lines.zh: 嗯，你选了一所好学校。我在这儿一直很开心。

lines.en: Awesome. See, I've been working for several years now. So, going back to school makes me a little nervous.
lines.zh: 太好了。你看，我已经工作好几年了，所以重返校园让我有点紧张。

lines.en: Don't be nervous. Just pay attention and do your best!
lines.zh: 别紧张，认真听讲，尽力就好！

lines.en: That is great advice. You know, I have been paying attention. But sometimes I still feel like I don't understand. Like last week …
lines.zh: 这建议真好。你知道吗，我一直都认真听讲，可有时候还是觉得没听懂。比如上周……

lines.en: What's that?
lines.zh: 那是什么？

lines.en: This is my draft.
lines.zh: 这是我的草稿。
