lines.en: What draft?
lines.zh: 什么草稿？

lines.en: The professor told us to bring our drafts.
lines.zh: 教授让我们带草稿来。

lines.en: I think she said "giraffe."
lines.zh: 我以为她说的是“长颈鹿”。

lines.en: No. She didn't.
lines.zh: 不，她没说。

lines.en: Here comes the professor.
lines.zh: 教授来了。

lines.en: Hello class! Sorry I'm late, but the snow storm made getting here really difficult. I see you've been waiting very patiently. So, let's get started! Who wants to give their talk first?
lines.zh: 同学们好！抱歉我迟到了，暴风雪让我来这儿特别难。我看大家一直很耐心地在等。那我们开始吧！谁想第一个发言？

lines.en: Oh! Oh! Please, please pick me.
lines.zh: 哦！哦！请选我，请选我。

lines.en: Anna?
lines.zh: 安娜？

lines.en: Who me? Sure. Thanks.
lines.zh: 谁，我？好的，谢谢。

lines.en: Here is my report on "Violins in the City."
lines.zh: 这是我的报告：《城市里的小提琴》。

lines.en: People have been looking for a solution to the problem of violins in the city. I say stop! Stop! They are not the problem! In fact, violins are part of the solution!
lines.zh: 人们一直在为城市里的小提琴问题寻找解决办法。我说停！停！它们不是问题！事实上，小提琴是解决办法的一部分！

lines.en: Violins create beautiful music that can fill a city with hope.
lines.zh: 小提琴能奏出美妙的音乐，让城市充满希望。

lines.en: Anna …
lines.zh: 安娜……

lines.en: If we put a violin in the hands of every child …
lines.zh: 如果我们让每个孩子手里都有一把小提琴……

lines.en: Anna! The topic is "Violence in the city." Violence. Not violins.
lines.zh: 安娜！题目是“城市里的暴力”。是 violence（暴力），不是 violins（小提琴）。

lines.en: Until next time …Like I was saying, many people are saying that violence in the city is a problem. A very big problem.
lines.zh: 下次见……就像我刚才说的，很多人说城市暴力是个问题，一个非常大的问题。

qs.q: Where does Anna go back to school?
qs.why: "welcome to Georgetown University in Washington, D.C.!"

qs.q: Why is the professor late?
qs.why: "the snow storm made getting here really difficult."

qs.q: What was the real topic of the report?
qs.why: "The topic is 'Violence in the city.'"

lessons.title: A Good Habit
lessons.zh: 好习惯：跑马拉松

lines.en: D.C. is a popular city for marathons! A marathon is a long race. Many marathons raise money for charity, you know - good works. A marathon is a good fitness goal too. I want to challenge myself in a marathon and maybe win a medal! Hey, there's Ashley. Ashley! Wait for me! It's Anna!
lines.zh: 华盛顿是个很受欢迎的马拉松城市！马拉松是一种长跑比赛。很多马拉松为慈善筹款，也就是做好事。马拉松也是个很好的健身目标。我想参加一场马拉松挑战自己，说不定还能赢块奖牌！嘿，阿什莉在那儿。阿什莉！等等我！是我安娜！

lines.en: Ash … ley. Ash … ley.
lines.zh: 阿……什莉。阿……什莉。

lines.en: Are you okay, Anna?
lines.zh: 你没事吧，安娜？

lines.en: I just ran … from over there.
lines.zh: 我刚从……那边跑过来。

lines.en: Do you want to sit down, Anna? Do you want some water? (Anna takes the bottle and tries to return it.) No thanks. You keep it.
lines.zh: 你要坐一下吗，安娜？要喝点水吗？（安娜接过瓶子想还回去）不用了，谢谢，你留着吧。

lines.en: Thanks. I didn't know you like to run.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我不知道你喜欢跑步。

lines.en: I love running. In fact, this weekend, I will run in my first marathon.
lines.zh: 我爱跑步。其实这周末我要跑我的第一场马拉松。

lines.en: Me … too.
lines.zh: 我……也是。

lines.en: Really? You are running in a marathon?
lines.zh: 真的？你要跑马拉松？

lines.en: Yeah. In a couple of days. Why do you ask … like that?
lines.zh: 是啊，过两天。你为什么……那样问？

lines.en: What do you know about running in a marathon?
lines.zh: 你对跑马拉松了解多少？

lines.en: I know that there's a lot of running and sometimes you can win a medal.
lines.zh: 我知道要跑很多路，有时候还能赢奖牌。

lines.en: How long have you been training?
lines.zh: 你训练多久了？

lines.en: I started today. I've been training for an hour … no, an hour and seven minutes!
lines.zh: 我今天开始的。我训练了一小时……不，一小时零七分钟！

lines.en: Anna, training a little every day is a good habit to get into. Not all at once!
lines.zh: 安娜，每天训练一点是个好习惯，别一下子全做完！

lines.en: Thanks for the advice, Ashley. But I'm running in a special race.
lines.zh: 谢谢你的建议，阿什莉。不过我参加的是一场特别的比赛。

lines.en: What marathon is it?
lines.zh: 是哪场马拉松？

lines.en: I don't remember the name. But the website said everyone gets a medal.
lines.zh: 我不记得名字了。不过网站上说人人都有奖牌。

lines.en: Okay, well, good luck, Anna!
lines.zh: 好吧，那祝你好运，安娜！

lines.en: Thanks, Ashley. Good luck to you, too.
lines.zh: 谢谢，阿什莉。也祝你好运。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.en: Bye!
lines.zh: 拜拜！

lines.en: Bye, Anna!
lines.zh: 拜拜，安娜！

lines.en: See you!
lines.zh: 回头见！

lines.en: (At the race: an announcer calls out race information)
lines.zh: （比赛现场：播音员在播报比赛信息）

lines.en: Hello. I am here to enter the race!
lines.zh: 你好，我来报名参加比赛！

lines.en: But ma'am you can't enter the race.
lines.zh: 可是女士，您不能报名参加这场比赛。

lines.en: What? How am I going to meet my goal?
lines.zh: 什么？那我怎么实现我的目标？

lines.en: Ma'am, this race is for children. You can't run with the children.
lines.zh: 女士，这场比赛是给孩子们的。您不能和孩子们一起跑。

lines.en: Children? Children. That's perfect. I just might win!
lines.zh: 孩子？孩子们。那太好了，我说不定能赢！

lines.en: No, ma'am. You really can't run with the children.
lines.zh: 不，女士，您真的不能和孩子们一起跑。

lines.en: I'm sorry. Of course. I was only thinking of my goal.
lines.zh: 对不起，当然。我刚才只想着我的目标了。

lines.en: Well, you can help us with our goal, which is to raise money for sick children. Would you like to help us?
lines.zh: 嗯，您可以帮我们实现我们的目标——为生病的孩子筹款。您愿意帮忙吗？

lines.en: I've just found my new goal. And I get to wear a medal. (to child who finished race) Good job!
lines.zh: 我刚刚找到了我的新目标，而且我还能戴上奖牌。（对一个跑完的孩子）跑得好！

qs.q: How long has Anna been training?
qs.why: "an hour and seven minutes!"

qs.q: What is Ashley's advice?
qs.why: "training a little every day is a good habit."

qs.q: Why can't Anna run in the race?
opts: It is a race for children.
qs.a: It is a race for children.
qs.why: "this race is for children."

lessons.title: Taking Chances
lessons.zh: 敢于尝试：安娜的大新闻

lines.en: Hello, it's Anna! I did it - Washington, D.C. is my home. Looking back over the past year, I've done so many amazing things! I have met people from all over the world. I've made many good friends. And I have a great job! And I've taken a lot of chances. And now I have some really big news! Wait for it… and 3, 2, 1…
lines.zh: 你好，我是安娜！我做到了——华盛顿是我的家了。回顾过去这一年，我做了好多了不起的事！我认识了来自世界各地的人，交了很多好朋友，还有一份很棒的工作！我也冒了很多险。现在我有一个特别大的新闻！等着……3、2、1……

lines.en: Hello and welcome to "Around the Corner and Across the Street from the Actor's Studio!" Many people dream of becoming actors. But very often, those dreams don't come true.
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《演员工作室街角对面》！很多人梦想成为演员，可这些梦想往往实现不了。

lines.en: Well, today we will meet a woman and -- her acting career has really taken off. In fact, she acted in my play, "The Woods Are Alive!" Oh. She really brought the part of Tree Number 15 to life! Let's give a warm welcome to Anna Matteo!
lines.zh: 不过，今天我们要见一位女士——她的演艺事业已经起飞了。事实上，她演过我的戏《森林活了》！哦，她把 15 号树这个角色演得活灵活现！让我们热烈欢迎安娜·马泰奥！

lines.en: Thank you. Thank you so much for having me here.
lines.zh: 谢谢，非常感谢您邀请我来。

lines.en: Please, please, sit down. Here, here, let me help you.
lines.zh: 请，请坐。来，来，我帮你。

lines.en: Thanks. Thanks. Wow, it is great to see you again, Director Kelly!
lines.zh: 谢谢，谢谢。哇，能再见到您真好，凯莉导演！

lines.en: It's great to see you too, Anna. I see you are still wearing your tree costume. Does this have anything to do with your big news?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴再见到你，安娜。我看你还穿着你的树戏服。这和你的大新闻有关吗？

lines.en: Yes. Yes, it does.
lines.zh: 是的，是的，有关。

lines.en: Well, Anna, please share that news with us.
lines.zh: 那么，安娜，请和我们分享这个新闻吧。

lines.en: Kelly, I will be acting in three movies.
lines.zh: 凯莉，我要出演三部电影。

lines.en: That is amazing! Anna, tell us more.
lines.zh: 太了不起了！安娜，多讲讲。

lines.en: Well, the first is a science fiction movie. The second is a romantic comedy. And the third is an action movie.
lines.zh: 嗯，第一部是科幻片，第二部是浪漫喜剧，第三部是动作片。

lines.en: That is so great! Let me guess -- you're playing a tree in all of them!
lines.zh: 太棒了！让我猜猜——你在每部里都演一棵树！

lines.en: Yes! This is what happened. To prepare for your play, I had to find out what it was like to BE a tree in the world. I had to find out where to eat, where to shop, where to meet people and how to get around the city.
lines.zh: 对！事情是这样的。为了准备您的戏，我得弄清楚在这世上当一棵树是什么感觉。我得知道去哪儿吃饭、去哪儿购物、去哪儿认识人、怎么在城里转。

lines.en: Amazing. I think big things are going to happen for you, Anna. So, tell me, will you be moving to Hollywood for a career in movies?
lines.zh: 了不起。我觉得你会大有作为，安娜。那么，告诉我，你会搬到好莱坞去拍电影吗？

lines.en: No. I'll make the movies and then come back. Washington, D.C. is my home.
lines.zh: 不会。我拍完电影就回来。华盛顿是我的家。

lines.en: I'm sure your family is very proud.
lines.zh: 我相信你的家人一定很为你骄傲。

lines.en: Yes, they are. You know, Kelly, not too long ago, I didn't feel very good about my life. I had to make a change. So, I took some chances. Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed. But I will never stop trying.
lines.zh: 是的，他们很骄傲。你知道吗，凯莉，不久前我对自己的生活还不太满意。我得做出改变，所以我冒了些险。有时我成功了，有时我失败了，但我永远不会停止尝试。

lines.en: Well, thank you for sharing your news and so much more with us, Anna.
lines.zh: 谢谢你和我们分享你的新闻，还有这么多别的东西，安娜。

lines.en: Until next time …
lines.zh: 下次见……

qs.q: What is Anna's big news?
opts: She will act in three movies.
qs.a: She will act in three movies.
qs.why: "I will be acting in three movies."

qs.q: What part does Anna play in the movies?
qs.why: "you're playing a tree in all of them!" "Yes!"

qs.q: What does Anna say about trying?
qs.why: "But I will never stop trying."
